raw.excerpt: Blavity, Inc.  is a venture-funded media and technology company, founded in 2014 around a simple idea: enable Black millennials to tell their own stories.
raw.description:
Blavity, Inc. is a venture-funded media and technology company, founded in 2014 around a simple idea: enable Black millennials to tell their own stories. Today, we are home to the largest network of platforms and lifestyle brands serving the multifaceted lives of Black millennials & Gen Z through original content, video, unique experiences, and product solutions. Blavity Inc. has evolved into a market leader for Black media, reaching 250 million users per month through our growing brand portfolio, including Blavity, AfroTech, Talent Infusion, Travel Noire, HealthStack, and Blavity House Party. Our Blavity, Inc. employee community is composed of passionate, energetic, and culturally conscious individuals working together to deliver value to each other, the company, and our clients. We are always searching for new additions to our community that will help us continue to scale, contribute meaningfully to our culture, and advance our strategic direction.

Job Summary:
Blavity Inc. is seeking a dynamic, results-driven Accounts Director to join our high-performing Media and Experiential Sales team. This hybrid role is designed for a leader who excels not only at deeply cultivating and expanding relationships with our existing clients but also at helping build new agency-level relationships. The ideal candidate is a master of both the "hunt" and the "farm," leveraging their deep product knowledge and exceptional rapport-building skills to drive significant revenue growth across the entire client lifecycle.
This role will report directly to the CRO, Blavity, Inc.

Responsibilities:
  • Client Relationship Management: Conduct virtual and face-to-face meetings with key clients to build meaningful, long-term strategic partnerships.
  • Revenue Growth & Retention: Secure partnership renewals with existing clients and drive incremental revenue inside named accounts by uncovering net new opportunities and use cases.
  • New Business Acquisition: Work with the CRO to assist with new business acquisition. Join meetings with the CRO and help with the follow-up and proposal ideas. Help build relationships with key decision- makers in untapped accounts by effectively introducing them to Blavity's product offerings.
  • Strategic Consultative Selling: Act as a trusted advisor by mapping client business challenges and objectives to Blavity solutions, including digital advertising, branded content, and live events.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Utilize Salesforce (CRM) to meticulously manage your sales pipeline, prepare accurate monthly sales reports and forecasts, and communicate performance clearly to senior management and executives.
  • Performance: Consistently meet or exceed assigned retention and upsell revenue goals on a quarterly basis.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work seamlessly with internal teams (e.g., Marketing, Content, Events, Ad Operations) to ensure client success and campaign excellence.

Qualifications:
  • Education: Preferred MBA
  • Required Experience:
    • 6+ years of media sales experience and an established track record for meeting and/or exceeding quotas, or experience in media organizations within marketing or operations functionalities managing a large volume of accounts.
    • Selling branded content / social creator campaigns and experience with selling Live Events / IRL sponsorships.
    • Additional bonus if you have experience with Healthcare / Pharmaceutical agency/client direct experience.
    • Experience managing high performing direct reports
    • Experience closing business with Fortune 500 businesses and agencies.
  • Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience working in consulting, finance, media, or related high-growth start-up
  • Technologies: Fluent in Microsoft Office, Google Suite, Claude and Salesforce or equivalent CRM platform
  • Additional Qualifications:
    • Independent, entrepreneurial self-starter who is comfortable taking on a high level of responsibility
    • High-energy, company-first, positive attitude; must be motivated to work hard in a fast-paced environment
    • Excellent verbal and written communication and active listening skills; research, problem-solving, & time management skills
    • A healthy appreciation of GIFs and Black culture
Details:
  • This is a fully remote role; occasional travel may be required.
  • Candidates must be available to work in 50% alignment with the Central Time Zone.
  • The salary range for this role is $145-160k/year + discretionary performance bonus based on sales targets

raw.description:
Company:

AHI agilon health, inc.

Job Posting Location:

Remote - USA

Job Title: ​

Actuarial Manager, Medicare Value-Based Care

Job Description: ​

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.


agilon health partners with primary care physicians to transform how care is delivered to seniors, taking on full-risk, total-cost-of-care arrangements. The actuarial team's work sits at the center of that model.

The Actuarial Manager, Medicare Value-Based Care is a senior individual contributor on the Markets actuarial team who will own the monthly results process for agilon's ACO REACH/ACO LEAD and MSSP populations, support payer settlement reconciliations, and produce supplemental exhibits for the month-end close. Operating in a consulting-style capacity, the Manager will also deliver high-priority analyses and project work, both individually and leading analysts from across the team, without direct people-management responsibility.


This role is ideal for an experienced actuary who enjoys variety: roughly 40% of time is dedicated to CMS value-based program results, 40% to ad hoc projects and analyst coaching, and the remaining 20% to annual payer financial settlement work and select MA close deliverables. The Manager will also help incorporate AI support into the team's processes and co-lead project management across the actuarial organization.

This is a fully remote position with minimal required travel.


This newly established role reports to the Sr. Director for the Markets Actuarial team. The Markets team collaborates extensively with counterparts throughout the company, while peers on the Central team develop models, tools, and methodology. The role carries strong visibility with senior leaders across the organization, and the breadth of ownership is designed to build toward future leadership opportunities on the actuarial team.


Essential Job Functions:

  • Value-Based Program Results (ACO REACH/LEAD and MSSP)
  • Own the end-to-end monthly results process: coordinate membership and revenue data intake from partner teams, run the retrospective trend adjustment (RTA) model, and oversee claims reserving and projection process
  • Guide the team through the CMS transition from ACO REACH to ACO LEAD: partner with the Central actuarial team (tools/methodology) on new requirements, and the VP of Direct Contracting on strategy
  • Consolidate results into clear summaries and lead the monthly results presentation to the Regional CFOs on the Market Finance team

Payer Settlement Reconciliation

  • Review payer contract terms to establish how final settlements should be calculated
  • Reconcile payer settlement calculations against contract terms and underlying claims and revenue data; identify discrepancies and build the analytical case to challenge settlements that are not handled correctly, contributing to the team's annual savings targets
  • Represent the finance organization directly with payer counterparts in a polished and professional manner to raise questions and request the detail needed for our review

Medicare Advantage Month-End Close Support

  • Build and maintain supplemental close exhibits, such as schedules of revenue accrual assumptions and accrual amounts by payor and market
  • Transform the actuarial team outputs into the required inputs for the FP&A team
  • Quantify and present drivers of claims prior period development, separating natural month-over-month runout from methodology updates and other one-time considerations

Special Projects and Analyst Coaching

  • Lead project intake, prioritization, and progress tracking across the actuarial team
  • Lead high-priority ad hoc analyses end-to-end, flexing across markets and topics based on team needs
  • Coach and mentor analysts through project work, providing technical direction and review to expand team capacity and enhance the quality of the work product
  • Represent actuarial leadership in cross-functional forums and working groups, carrying decisions back to the actuarial team and ensuring completion of takeaway deliverables

Process Innovation

  • Act as a thought leader on AI adoption within the actuarial organization — exemplifying thoughtful, practical use of new tools, sharing what works, and building the team's fluency and confidence in applying them
  • Apply AI tools to claims analysis, automation of financial reporting, enablement of strategic decision-making, and review of payor contracts and financial statements
  • Support build-out of improved actuarial team processes

Other Job Functions:

  • Develop talent through coaching, mentorship, and technical review
  • Collaborate with Market Finance, FP&A, Accounting, Medical Economics, Payer Contracting, and Regional Presidents
  • Identify critical issues and recommend solutions to business problems
  • Exemplify the core values of agilon health


Required Qualifications:

Minimum Experience

  • 6+ years of actuarial experience (8+ years preferred)
  • Demonstrated leadership via project ownership and cross-functional initiatives, mentoring analysts, serving as a trusted delegate for a senior leader, and/or prior people management

Education/Licensure

  • ASA or FSA designation
  • Bachelor's degree

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent ability to communicate and present a financial narrative, both written and verbal
  • Strong understanding of Medicare Advantage and Value-Based Care concepts; experience with other CMS value-based arrangements (ACO REACH or MSSP) is a plus
  • Understanding of MA health plan data (Claims, MMR, MAO-004, etc.)
  • Ability to read and interpret payer contracts and translate terms into settlement expectations
  • Experience with reserving and/or forecasting, and ability to lead work in these competencies
  • Skilled in interpreting and manipulating large datasets, especially medical claims
  • Proficiency with Excel and SQL; experience applying AI tools to actuarial work is a plus
  • Comfortable operating as a player-coach: delivering hands-on analysis while guiding others
  • Advanced problem-solving skills (identification of issue, causes, solution, implementation plan)
  • Proven ability to influence, grow, and motivate others

Protect yourself: agilon health will never send unsolicited job offers or request payments or financial information. Such communications are fraudulent. Learn how to spot them

$129,700.00 - $162,100.00

Employees have room to grow, and many of Health Advocate's supervisors are promoted from within the company. Join our award winning team!

As part of Teleperformance in the US, we were also named #95 in the 2024 ‘Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®’ in the USA by Great Places to Work (GPTW®)

About the role

The EAP Care Manager is a mental health professional who provides telephonic and/or live chat support to members accessing the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). This role delivers brief clinical assessment, crisis intervention, solution-focused support, referral coordination, and workplace consultation services. The Care Manager ensures high-quality member experience while adhering to clinical best practices, confidentiality standards, and organizational workflows.

This position is full-time (40 hours/week) Monday - Friday. Applicants must be able to work the schedule below.

Monday - Friday 11:30am-8pm EST

Pay Rate:

$28-35 per hour, commensurate with experience.

Job Summary

  • Provide telephonic and/or live chat needs assessment and screening while managing an inbound EAP phone/chat queue.
  • Deliver brief, solution-focused, in-the-moment supportive interventions and psychoeducation for concerns including stress, anxiety, grief, relationship issues, and substance use.
  • Conduct risk assessments for members presenting with concerns such as: suicidal ideation; thoughts of harm to others; substance use issues; risk for abuse or violence.
  • Provide crisis intervention and stabilization, including safety planning and connection to urgent or emergent resources when indicated.
  • Explain EAP clinical and work/life benefits and provide individualized recommendations to meet each member’s needs and goals.
  • Connect members to EAP services and/or health insurance or community resources and follow up to support successful engagement and connection to services, as clinically appropriate.
  • May provide consultation and support to HR and Managers regarding employee performance concerns, crisis support, or other issues within EAP scope, while maintaining professional boundaries and confidentiality.
  • May assist with Critical Incident Response following a Disruptive Event in the workplace, providing telephonic in-the-moment support to members and/or assisting with arranging onsite or virtual counseling at the worksite.
  • Document all interactions and activities accurately and timely in the electronic case management system.
  • Adhere to ethical standards, clinical best practices, and confidentiality requirements, including HIPAA and applicable regulations.
  • Participate in individual supervision, team meetings, and case consultation.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues to ensure high-quality member care.
  • Maintain reliable attendance and availability for scheduled shifts and caseload responsibilities.
  • Complete required trainings and maintain competency in EAP protocols and procedures.
  • Participate in the EAP on-call rotation to provide after-hours coverage (evenings, weekends, and holidays), typically assigned approximately two weeks per calendar year.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or a related behavioral health or human services field.
  • Two (2) years of clinical experience, preferably in Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), crisis intervention, behavioral health assessment, care management, or brief/solution-focused counseling settings.
  • Active professional licensure in good standing (e.g., LCSW, LMSW, LPC, LMFT, LSW, or equivalent state credential.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, queue-based environment while utilizing multiple digital platforms and electronic case management systems.
  • Strong cultural competence and ability to work effectively with diverse populations across workplace settings.
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to complete timely, accurate clinical documentation.

Physical Requirements:
This position is primarily sedentary, requiring prolonged sitting while performing administrative tasks. The role involves extensive use of a computer for typing, mouse navigation, and reading information on a screen for extended periods. Frequent phone use is required for communication with team members, clients, or external parties. Essential physical functions include fingering, grasping, pulling hand-over-hand, and repetitive motions necessary for navigating software, entering data, and interacting with electronic documents.

Mental and Cognitive Requirements:
The role requires strong concentration, attention to detail, and the ability to complete tasks accurately. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential to address issues that may arise in day-to-day duties. Effective verbal and written communication skills are needed for responding to inquiries and collaborating with others.

Work Environment:
This position is fully remote and requires a home office environment with appropriate lighting, a computer, and phone access. The workspace should be free from distractions to ensure effective focus and productivity during work hours.

Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.

raw.excerpt: Anticipated Contract End Date/Length: 6 months Work Set Up: Remote (100% remote) Our client in the Information Technology and Services industry is looking for a Senior DevOps / Automation Engineer (IBM Z & Hybrid Platform) to lead automation and DevOps modernisation across IBM Z and distributed platforms.
raw.description:
Anticipated Contract End Date/Length: 6 months
Work Set Up: Remote (100% remote)

Our client in the Information Technology and Services industry is looking for a Senior DevOps / Automation Engineer (IBM Z & Hybrid Platform) to lead automation and DevOps modernisation across IBM Z and distributed platforms. This role will involve designing and implementing production-grade automation, CI/CD pipelines, compliance controls, observability solutions, and secure orchestration capabilities across a global enterprise environment.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive DevOps engineering experience, strong technical leadership skills, and hands-on expertise in enterprise automation and platform integration. The successful candidate will drive engineering best practices, strengthen governance and compliance, and mentor engineers in delivering resilient, secure, auditable, and scalable automation solutions across complex enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, conduct design reviews, and promote DevOps engineering best practices.
  • Design and develop production-grade automation using Python and YAML, incorporating testing, logging, error handling, and operational resilience.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise-scale automation workflows using Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) across IBM Z and distributed platforms.
  • Build idempotent, restartable, and state-aware workflows with appropriate failure handling, retry logic, and operational safeguards.
  • Develop and maintain GitHub workflows and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, including Groovy-based pipeline development and Git-based release practices.
  • Integrate automated compliance checks, quality gates, evidence capture, and artefact management through Nexus Repository or equivalent tools.
  • Design and optimise PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and automation state tracking to support operational reliability and audit requirements.
  • Develop Grafana dashboards and observability pipelines, integrating logging and metrics with enterprise monitoring platforms such as Splunk.
  • Implement secure secrets management using HashiCorp Vault, applying least-privilege principles and integrating secure credentials into CI/CD and AAP workflows.
  • Design and maintain REST API integrations and enterprise service interfaces.
  • Support configuration drift detection, automated remediation, compliance governance, and secure engineering standards.
  • Document reusable automation patterns and operational procedures, collaborate across mainframe and infrastructure teams, and support risk, audit, and regulatory requirements.
  • At least 10 years of demonstrable DevOps engineering experience, including solution design, governance, compliance, and implementation of DevOps best practices.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience working within an IBM Z environment.
  • Strong technical leadership experience, including mentoring engineers, providing technical guidance, and promoting engineering excellence.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub, Jenkins, Ansible Automation Platform (AAP), Nexus Repository, Python, HashiCorp Vault, and API integration.
  • Strong Python development skills, including production-quality code, testing, logging, error handling, and modular design.
  • Experience with Jenkins pipeline development using Groovy, Git-based CI/CD practices, and YAML automation.
  • Practical knowledge of PostgreSQL schema design, query optimisation, and operational data management.
  • Experience developing Grafana dashboards and supporting monitoring, metrics, and observability initiatives.
  • Knowledge of secure secrets management, credential lifecycle management, compliance verification, and configuration drift management.
  • Familiarity with IBM Z and z/OS concepts, including JCL and batch scheduling.
  • Ability to design resilient, restartable automation workflows and operate effectively in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong documentation, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to engage technical, infrastructure, risk, and audit stakeholders.
  • Experience in regulated financial services environments is preferred.
  • Familiarity with IBM z/OSMF and zOAU is highly advantageous; experience with IWS, Infrastructure-as-Code governance, and observability tooling is desirable.

Candidates must be legally authorized to live and work in the country where the position is based, without requiring employer sponsorship.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience practicing law in the trusts and estates field and the ability to analyze complex estate planning documents, identify planning opportunities and gaps, and communicate sophisticated concepts in a practical and actionable manner to financial advisors. As part of a team of 25 professionals, one of the largest teams of its kind in the industry, this individual will collaborate with internal planning specialists and business partners to support complex client situations. This role will also play a key part in advisor education, internal training, thought leadership, and the development of planning resources for the broader advisor population.

Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required.
  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) required.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a trusted estate planning resource for financial advisors supporting high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.
  • Review, analyze, and summarize complex estate planning and related documents, including wills, revocable and irrevocable trusts, powers of attorney, healthcare directives, individual and corporate tax returns, buy-sell agreements, and other planning instruments.
  • Identify estate planning opportunities, risks, inconsistencies, and potential gaps within clients’ existing estate plans.
  • Collaborate with internal planning specialists and business partners to support complex client situations and coordinate integrated planning recommendations.
  • Collaborate with financial advisors to identify planning strategies related to wealth transfer, trust planning, charitable giving, business succession, gifting, and estate tax mitigation.
  • Develop concise, accessible, and actionable estate plan summaries and planning observations for financial advisors and their clients.
  • Educate financial advisors on estate planning concepts, strategies, and emerging trends through consultations, training programs, webinars, written resources, and other learning opportunities.
  • Monitor and analyze legislative, regulatory, and tax law developments affecting estate planning and wealth transfer strategies.
  • Produce timely briefs, articles, and internal guidance on estate planning, tax, and legislative developments for the High Net Worth Planning Services team and the broader advisor population.
  • Represent Osaic as an estate planning subject matter expert through presentations at advisor conferences, events, webinars, and team training programs.
  • Contribute to the development of estate planning resources, tools, and best practices that enhance advisor effectiveness and client outcomes.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Basic Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience practicing law with a primary focus on trusts and estates.
  • Extensive experience drafting, reviewing, and interpreting estate planning documents.
  • Deep understanding of federal estate, gift, and generation-skipping transfer tax concepts.
  • Strong knowledge of trust structures, wealth transfer strategies, charitable planning techniques, and business succession planning.
  • Experience reviewing corporate tax returns and interpreting business ownership and governance documents, including buy-sell agreements.
  • Experience researching and interpreting legislative, regulatory, and tax law developments.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex estate planning concepts to non-attorney audiences.
  • Experience developing educational content and presenting to diverse audiences.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and research skills.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Prior experience presenting at industry conferences, advisor events, or continuing education programs.

raw.description:
We are seeking a Travel Business Development Manager (Nebraska/Iowa-REMOTE) for a full time and direct hire role for one of our amazing partners in the travel & tour industry. This role is remote, but you MUST be living in the United States and specifically in the state you are working in. You MUST be a US Citizen or Green Card Holder. This role does NOT offer sponsorship, it's NOT a consulting role, and we do NOT work with 3rd parties!

Overview:

Outside Sales | Business Development | Travel & Group Experiences

We are partnering with a growing company in the travel industry to identify a Business Development Manager who will be responsible for growing an assigned territory through new account development, relationship building, and repeat business. This is a hands-on, field-based sales role for a self-motivated hunter who enjoys building a territory from the ground up. You'll identify and develop new business opportunities, establish relationships with organizational decision-makers and group leaders, present travel programs to prospective travelers, and ultimately grow revenue through new and repeat group bookings. You should be comfortable generating your own opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, referrals, networking, scheduled appointments, and in-person prospecting. You'll need to be equally comfortable having a one-on-one conversation with a decision-maker and presenting to a room full of potential travelers.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced outside sales professional who enjoys travel, relationship development, and owning the results of their territory. A proactive, relationship-driven outside sales professional who enjoys finding their own opportunities, getting in front of customers, and building a territory over time. You should be comfortable hearing no, making the next call, walking into a new organization, giving a presentation, and continuing to build relationships until the right opportunity develops. A genuine interest in travel and working with people is a plus, but proven sales ability, persistence, organization, and ownership are the most important qualities.

Responsibilities:

New Business Development

  • Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective accounts within an assigned territory
  • Identify organizations and groups with the potential to generate recurring travel business
  • Prospect through cold calling, email, referrals, networking, online research, scheduled appointments, and in-person visits
  • Develop relationships with decision-makers, group leaders, community organizations, travel professionals, and other potential referral sources
  • Create and maintain a consistent prospecting and field-visit schedule
  • Qualify prospects based on audience, travel interest, timing, budget, and potential for long-term business

Sales & Business Development

  • Manage the sales process from initial prospecting through proposal, booking, and confirmation
  • Understand each prospect's goals and recommend travel programs that align with their audience and needs
  • Present the value of available travel programs, address questions and objections, and confidently ask for the business
  • Develop new group business while working toward territory revenue and passenger goals
  • Maintain consistent follow-up throughout potentially long sales cycles
  • Partner with internal teams to ensure opportunities move smoothly from sales through fulfillment

Presentations & Customer Engagement

  • Conduct engaging presentations and travel programs for groups and prospective travelers
  • Present to both small groups and larger audiences, creating excitement and confidence around travel opportunities
  • Clearly communicate trip details, itineraries, expectations, and value
  • Address traveler questions and concerns in a professional and personable manner
  • Work with group leaders to develop strategies for promoting and filling trips
  • Monitor booking activity and take proactive steps when additional support is needed

Account Growth & Retention

  • Build strong, long-term relationships with existing accounts and group leaders
  • Identify opportunities for repeat business, additional departures, new destinations, and referrals
  • Stay engaged with customers throughout the travel lifecycle and follow up after completed programs
  • Work collaboratively with internal teams to address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Take ownership of the customer relationship and follow through on commitments

Territory Management

  • Independently manage your calendar, priorities, travel schedule, prospecting activity, and follow-up
  • Maintain an accurate and active pipeline of qualified prospects
  • Keep CRM records current, including contacts, activities, opportunities, next steps, and expected timing
  • Maintain an accurate sales forecast and communicate potential risks or changes early
  • Participate in sales meetings, pipeline reviews, coaching, and training
  • Use data and feedback to continuously improve territory performance

Requirements:

  • Proven success in outside sales, territory sales, business development, or a similar new-business-focused role
  • Demonstrated experience prospecting for new business and consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals
  • Strong track record of developing new accounts and growing repeat business
  • Comfortable with cold calling, prospecting, networking, and in-person business development
  • Highly self-motivated and able to independently manage a territory without relying on a steady flow of inbound leads
  • Persistent and resilient with the ability to handle rejection while maintaining a professional, relationship-oriented approach
  • Excellent communication, listening, and relationship-building skills
  • Strong presentation and public-speaking abilities
  • Comfortable presenting to both individual decision-makers and larger groups
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple prospects, accounts, sales cycles, deadlines, and travel commitments simultaneously
  • Experience using a CRM and standard business technology, including email, spreadsheets, video conferencing, and presentation tools
  • Coachable, accountable, and willing to take ownership of results
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively throughout the assigned territory, including overnight travel approximately 2–3 nights per week.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in travel, tourism, hospitality, group travel, or related industries
  • Experience selling escorted tours, cruises, vacation packages, or other group experiences
  • Existing relationships with organizations that coordinate group activities or travel
  • Experience working with community organizations, membership-based organizations, professional associations, religious organizations, educational/alumni groups, financial institutions, clubs, or travel advisors
  • Experience selling to mature or senior audiences
  • Existing relationships within the assigned territory
  • Experience conducting group presentations, seminars, informational sessions, or sales events
  • Experience managing a large geographic territory with significant field travel
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, or military or veteran status. You must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

You’ll serve as an advocate for these members, coordinating care and ensuring they have the necessary resources and support to achieve better health outcomes. As a TOC Associate your goal will be to support members in safely recovering at home and to prevent hospital readmissions. Our ideal TOC Associate is caring, compassionate, energetic, and genuinely enjoys connecting with people.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

raw.description:
Who We Are

Heritage is building the Modern Investment Office, supporting some of the most prominent families globally to achieve their capital enhancement and preservation goals.

Our vision is to help clients build enduring wealth across generations by combining institutional-grade investment sourcing with personalized portfolio construction, cutting-edge technology, and deep sector expertise. We aim to make sophisticated private market opportunities and modern wealth solutions more transparent, connected, and actionable.

Our team comprises a diverse international group of individuals from leading organizations and with diverse backgrounds, including private equity, venture capital, banking, software development, law, and entrepreneurship. We are committed to attracting top-notch talent and providing opportunities for growth and development based on their individual strengths and interests.

Your Role

Your role as Portfolio Manager is part of our Portfolio Management team. The mission of the role is to ensure that the portfolios of our UHNW clients are actively monitored, well-constructed and aligned with their objectives.

The Associate is allocated to a defined group of European client relationships, covering OCIO and portfolio advisory mandates. Portfolios are multi-asset, spanning liquid and semi-liquid investments, often across multiple banks and counterparties. The role carries direct ownership of portfolio oversight, from asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk to the quality of the investments proposed to clients.

The role reports to Head of Portfolio Management, and cross-reports to the Relationship Managers. It works in close collaboration with both, providing RMs with timely, high-quality investment input and the confidence that their clients are being taken care of even when they are not looking.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee client portfolios for OCIO and portfolio advisory clients, playing an active role in shaping clients’ portfolios across a range of asset classes (fixed income, public equity, alternative assets...)
  • Maintain clear visibility on asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk across client portfolios
  • Monitor performance, attribution and risk metrics, identifying portfolio drift, concentration risks and misalignment with client objectives
  • Assess investments and opportunities proposed by banks and other counterparties (funds, structured products, discretionary mandates, alternatives), forming clear and well-reasoned views
  • Identify sub-optimal products (fees, quality, overlap) and propose better alternatives
  • Support Relationship Managers with timely, high-quality investment input ahead of and following client discussions
  • Track transactions, changes and next steps, so that monitoring and follow-up actions are not missed
  • Support business development meetings with prospective clients
  • Work closely with the Portfolio Management team on portfolio construction and investment decisions, with a view to contributing to the continuous improvement of our investment process

What We Are Looking For

  • Outstanding academic background with a master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or related disciplines
  • Solid experience in portfolio management or advisory, ideally for UHNW individuals, within a Multi-Family Office, OCIO, Private Bank or Wealth Manager
  • Strong grasp of portfolio construction and asset allocation, including strategic vs tactical allocation and diversification principles, and the ability to assess multi-asset portfolios (liquid and semi-liquid)
  • Ability to analyze investment products proposed by banks and asset managers, with a solid understanding of fees (explicit and implicit), liquidity terms and risk drivers
  • Experience monitoring portfolio performance, attribution and risk metrics
  • Comfortable interacting with sophisticated UHNW clients and Relationship Managers, and able to explain investment concepts clearly and credibly, both verbally and in writing
  • Strong attention to detail in portfolio reviews, transaction monitoring and documentation, and ability to work in a structured, process-driven environment
  • Experience in manager selection or due diligence is a plus
  • Basic financial modelling and portfolio analytics skills are a plus
  • International exposure or experience working with non-Italian institutions is a plus
  • Tech-savvy, with experience in a portfolio analytics or wealth reporting platform (Addepar is a plus)
  • Effective communicator with a collaborative and multicultural mindset
  • Highly motivated and proactive, with a hands-on and flexible attitude
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-growing environment
  • Fluent in English. Other languages constitute a plus

Location: Remote work is fine, but being based at a Heritage office is a plus.

What We Offer

  • An exceptional team and environment: You will work alongside highly talented professionals from leading global institutions such as Carlyle, CD&R, McKinsey, Bain, Goldman Sachs, and top technology companies. We operate with a high talent bar, intellectual rigor, and a strong focus on excellence.
  • High ownership and client-facing scope: You will take ownership of the oversight of UHNW client portfolios, working closely with senior stakeholders, Relationship Managers and clients. You will have significant responsibility in assessing investment opportunities and shaping the quality of the portfolios we manage and advise on.
  • Exposure to the intersection of wealth management and technology: You will work on complex multi-asset portfolios and sophisticated wealth structures, using Heritage's proprietary platform to consolidate and analyze portfolio data, and contribute to the continuous evolution of a technology-driven wealth management offering.
  • International scope and strong culture: You will operate in a diverse, international team representing 15+ nationalities, with hiring across multiple geographies. We foster a collaborative and ambitious culture, supported by regular team offsites and opportunities to build strong relationships.

At Heritage, we are proud to have a diverse team representing over 15 nationalities, with all communication conducted in English. We are deeply committed to providing equal opportunities and work actively to remove potential biases in our hiring process by involving a Hiring Committee in all decision-making.

We are a small frontend team building a web platform for ML data annotation. We are looking for an intern with solid TypeScript fundamentals who is eager to learn Svelte and modern frontend conventions. In this role you'll start with well-scoped tasks: UI components, component book entries, tests, small bug fixes in legacy projects under a mentor's review, and grow toward owning small features end to end. You will work with a modern stack (Svelte 5, TypeScript, Tailwind, Bun), practice AI-assisted development as a standard workflow, and ship to production behind strict quality gates in a team small enough for your work to make an immediate impact.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Add component book entries and write unit/browser tests for new and existing components
  • Fix well-scoped bugs in the new platform and in legacy projects
  • Integrate simple REST endpoints under guidance
  • Participate in code review (receive feedback, and gradually review others' PRs)
  • Keep type checks, lint and tests green on your changes
  • Improve documentation and conventions where you find gaps
  • Learn and apply AI-assisted development responsibly

Qualifications and Skills

  • At least 1 year of experience and/or a GitHub profile with pet projects available for the team review
  • Solid TypeScript fundamentals
  • HTML/CSS knowledge
  • Familiarity with at least one modern frontend framework (any — Svelte, React, Vue)
  • Good understanding of client-server communication
  • Git basics
  • Ability to understand technical documentation and follow engineering guidelines
  • Good written and spoken English (preferably B1+)

Nice to have

  • Solid knowledge of Svelte/SvelteKit and Tailwind
  • Experience with unit testing (Vitest/Jest)
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:
  • Design, build and implement security and hardening features for enterprise users: Design, implement, test, and ship cutting-edge security features that strengthen Firefox’s security posture.
  • Advance Firefox’s security architecture across multiple operating systems: Contribute to and drive cutting-edge improvements to Firefox’s core security posture, by building privilege isolation and moving trust boundaries or Strengthen Firefox’s security architecture: Improve Firefox’s core security mechanisms including cryptographic protocols, WebPKI, and security-sensitive web APIs.
  • Contribute to our security initiatives: Work across teams to investigate security issues, identify root causes, and deliver robust, maintainable fixes.
  • Improve browser reliability and performance: Diagnose and resolve issues affecting stability, correctness, performance, and memory usage in a complex, multithreaded environment.

What you’ll bring:

  • Systems programming experience and security knowledge: 3+ years of experience in low-level software engineering, strong proficiency in C and/or C++, and a solid understanding of security fundamentals.
  • Debugging and problem-solving skills: Experience diagnosing and resolving issues in multithreaded, cross-platform native applications, including memory and performance challenges.
  • Web platform and modern systems experience: Familiarity with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and interest or experience in Rust; ability to work effectively within large, complex, multi-language codebases.
  • Effective collaboration and communication: Experience working with distributed teams and communicating technical ideas clearly in writing and conversation.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend

  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Clean Air Task Force (CATF) is a global nonprofit organization working to safeguard against the worst impacts of climate change by catalyzing the rapid development and deployment of low-carbon energy and other climate-protecting technologies. With 30 years of internationally recognized expertise on climate policy and a fierce commitment to exploring all potential solutions, CATF is a pragmatic, non-ideological advocacy group with the bold ideas needed to address climate change. CATF has offices in Boston, Washington D.C., and Brussels, with staff working virtually around the world.

What You’ll Do

CATF’s Talent team supports an engaged, effective, and inclusive global workforce by developing thoughtful and consistent people practices across the employee lifecycle. As CATF continues to work across countries, functions, and time zones, managers and employees need practical HR partnership that reflects organizational values and responds to evolving needs.

The Manager, Talent and Performance will provide day-to-day HR guidance while leading programs and projects that strengthen performance, engagement, employee experience, and organizational health. Working closely with the Senior Director, Global Talent and Total Rewards and other members of the Talent team, this role will translate People strategy into practical solutions and help ensure employees and managers receive thoughtful, consistent support.

Responsibilities

  • HR Partnership & Employee Support – Build trusted relationships with employees and managers, providing consistent guidance on employee relations, performance, policies, workplace concerns, and other people matters.

  • Manager Coaching & Development – Coach managers on feedback, performance expectations, employee development, difficult conversations, conflict resolution, and team dynamics.

  • Performance Management – Support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of performance practices, including goal setting, feedback, development planning, and performance conversations.

  • Employee Experience & Engagement – Strengthen the employee experience across the employee lifecycle by supporting engagement initiatives, identifying retention considerations, and translating employee feedback into practical action.

  • Talent Program & Project Leadership – Lead assigned Talent initiatives from planning through implementation, coordinating stakeholders, communicating changes, measuring outcomes, and supporting adoption.

  • Policy, Process & Operational Excellence – Develop and improve HR policies, processes, tools, and resources while identifying opportunities to simplify work and strengthen the consistency of People practices.

  • Global Collaboration & Organizational Health – Partner across regions, functions, and external providers to support effective Talent practices within CATF’s global and remote environment.

  • Data-Informed Decision-Making & Communication – Use HR data, employee feedback, and organizational themes to inform recommendations and develop clear communications for employees and managers.

What You’ll Bring

You combine sound judgment with a practical and human-centered approach to HR partnership. You can build trust across organizational levels, navigate sensitive matters with discretion, and turn complex or evolving needs into clear, workable solutions. You are comfortable balancing day-to-day employee and manager support with ownership of broader programs and projects.

Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, cultural studies, or a related field.

  • 5–7 years of HR experience across multiple areas of the employee lifecycle, including employee relations, performance management, HR programs, policy, and manager support.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships and provide effective coaching and guidance to employees and managers at multiple organizational levels.

  • Strong judgment and experience handling sensitive and confidential matters with discretion.

  • Experience independently leading HR projects or programs from development through implementation.

  • Strong communication, problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and organizational skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and navigate ambiguity.

  • Ability to use HR data and employee feedback to identify trends, evaluate programs, and develop practical recommendations.

  • HR experience supporting employees and managers outside the U.S., along with experience working in a global organization with employees in multiple countries.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting performance management practices, employee engagement initiatives, or employee development programs.

  • Familiarity with global employment matters and working with employer-of-record or professional employer organization partners and external advisors.

  • Experience developing or improving HR policies, processes, tools, and employee resources.

  • Exposure to organizational health, talent management, learning and development, culture, or reward and recognition initiatives.

What We Provide

This is an opportunity to strengthen the employee experience and people practices that enable CATF’s global team to advance practical solutions to climate change.

  • A mission-driven role supporting an engaged, effective, and inclusive global workforce.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with employees, managers, Talent colleagues, and partners across functions, cultures, geographies, and time zones.

  • A collaborative and intellectually curious culture where diverse perspectives are valued and bold, practical climate solutions are encouraged.

  • A full-time, remote working environment with occasional travel as needed.

  • CATF provides U.S.-based employees with a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; retirement benefits; paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays; and other benefits and programs available to eligible employees. Additional details about eligibility and coverage are provided during the hiring process.

Compensation & Pay Transparency

CATF believes candidates should have clear information about compensation so they can make informed decisions about opportunities with us. Because our team works across multiple countries, compensation is structured using CATF’s established salary ranges for the role and country of employment.

The expected base salary range for this position is:

  • United States: USD $98,091–$122,614 per year

Actual compensation will be determined using relevant, job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, role scope, internal equity, and country of employment. Benefits and other terms of employment will be based on the applicable country of employment and employing arrangement.

Ready to Apply?

If you’ve made it this far, you should go ahead and apply.

You don’t need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If this role aligns with how you like to work and the kind of impact you want to have, we encourage you to submit your application.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Clean Air Task Force is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or ethnic origin, age, disability, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Job Title: Technical Sales Engineer

Learn more about our company and how we support you:

The surgical robot that assists a surgeon. The autonomous vehicle that navigates a warehouse floor. The train control system that keeps thousands of commuters on schedule. Somewhere inside that technology is an ADLINK product.

Ampro ADLINK Technology designs and manufactures embedded computing hardware for industries where failure is not an option. Industrial automation, robotics, autonomous vehicles, healthcare, and intelligent transportation are just some of the markets we serve. Our products sit at the edge of these systems, processing data and providing real-time control where it happens, when it happens, not in a distant cloud.

Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Taiwan, we operate across the US, UK, Singapore, China, Japan, Korea, and Germany with products deployed in more than 40 countries. Our San Jose office drives our business across the Americas and works closely with technology partners, including Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, and NXP.

If you want to work on hardware or software that ships into real-world applications — not prototypes, not demos — and grow alongside a team that has been leading-edge computing for three decades, we want to hear from you.

Whether you are a seasoned engineer or early in your career, what you build here will end up in the real world.

How will you make an impact:
Work closely with the ADLINK sales team on new opportunities and drive solutions to meet customers’ needs which may include carrier designs, semi-custom based ADLINK standard products, and full custom system level solutions. Provide architectural ideas and solutions to meet customers’ requirements. Learn the customers pain points. Lead engineering teams responsible for the design of these products from concept through to production launch. This role also requires strong technical program management skills. The types of designs will vary based on customer, market and company needs but in general can include leading edge next generation x86 processor, ARM based tablets, COM Express, SMARC, and NVIDIA Jetson, carriers, products, or systems.

The Technical Sales Engineer position is remote.

raw.excerpt: About Agero:Wherever drivers go, we’re leading the way.
raw.description:
About Agero:

Wherever drivers go, we’re leading the way. Agero’s mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients’ relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we’re pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit .

Note: For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.

Role Description and Mission: The Job & Why It Matters

Are you a quick-thinking problem solver who thrives on helping others in their time of need? Do you want to make a real difference and have a lasting impact on customers?

Agero is actively seeking Remote Response Associates to join our Roadside Assistance department, where you will help rescue stranded customers off the side of the road. When a vehicle breaks down, you are the driver's first point of contact. Taking real-time inbound calls from motorists across the U.S., you will be the calming voice that turns an unpredictable, highly stressful situation into a solved problem. You will provide a clear roadmap of what they can expect next, guiding them through an urgent and unplanned event. Just like an everyday superhero, you are stepping in to save their day and get their plans back on track!

As a Remote Response Associate, you serve as a lifeline for customers facing roadside emergencies such as flat tires, lockouts, dead batteries, fuel deliveries, and towing due to mechanical failures. Because customers often reach out feeling overwhelmed or unsafe on the side of the road, in dark parking lots, or while traveling in unfamiliar areas, you will manage these high-stress situations with calm, empathetic guidance and consistent reassurance.

Leading with a customer-first mindset, you will coordinate directly with external service providers to ensure the accurate and rapid dispatch of tow trucks and service vehicles. Your ability to stay calm and make quick decisions under pressure directly impacts customer safety, satisfaction, and our reputation for service excellence as a trusted, industry-leading roadside provider.

Key Outcomes: What you'll do

  • Handle High-Volume Calls: Gather essential details regarding location and vehicle issues to dispatch assistance quickly for stranded motorists in real-time.
  • Dispatch with Accuracy: Coordinate efficiently with external service providers to ensure the right help arrives at the right time.
  • De-escalate & Support: Use active listening and empathy to calm frustrated or anxious customers, navigating heightened emotions during uncertain situations.
  • Navigate Digital Tools: Utilize multiple web-based systems and dispatch tools simultaneously to track service progress accurately.
  • Excel in a Virtual Team: Thrive in a performance-driven remote environment, collaborating with peers and managers via Zoom and Google Chat.

Skills, Education, & Experience: What We’re Looking For

This isn’t your typical, script-reading customer service role. We have a high bar for talent because our drivers need real help in real-time. Every single call involves a stressful situation - some customers will be panicking, others might be crying, and many won't even know exactly where they are stranded. To succeed here, you need to bring your A-game every shift, every call.

Here are the skills you'll bring to the team:

  • Empathy in Action: You have a natural ability to genuinely understand what a stranded driver is going through. You can authentically connect with people, stay patient, validate their fears, and give them the real reassurance they need when they are stuck in a dark parking lot or on a busy highway.
  • Effective Communication & Listening: True communication starts with listening. You need to actively listen to absorb the critical details from a worried caller, ask the right questions, and probe for missing information. From there, you'll use a steady, confident voice to give clear directions to our roadside partners and explain the next steps to the customer so they feel completely guided.
  • Sound Judgment Under Pressure: You don’t fold when things get chaotic. You can keep a cool head, think clearly, and make smart, fast decisions during unpredictable events. You are comfortable thinking outside the box to solve problems safely, but you also have the awareness to know exactly when a situation needs to be escalated for extra help.
  • Problem-Solving & De-escalation: You bring a calm, professional attitude to every interaction. You have a knack for turning a stressful, negative situation into a smooth, positive experience by focused problem-solving.
  • Multitasking Mastery: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two calls are identical. You can comfortably talk to a stranded driver or a tow provider while simultaneously typing detailed notes, navigating multiple screens, and pulling resources from our system without breaking your focus.

The Business Intelligence (BI) Developer supports Business Intelligence solutions that enable data-informed decision-making for assigned stakeholders. This role partners with internal business partners to translate business needs into dashboards, reports, and insights while ensuring data accuracy, usability, and consistency. The BI Developer role combines technical expertise, analytical thinking, collaboration, and a focus on continuous improvement to deliver reliable and actionable reporting solutions.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Performs a combination of duties in accordance with departmental guidelines:

  • Create compelling and actionable visualizations and stories using Tableau to support business insights.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, uncover insights, and become a key resource for data questions and exploration.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify hidden trends, outliers, and actionable opportunities within datasets.
  • Use multiple SQL dialects to trace reporting data back to source systems, validating data lineage and ensuring the integrity of all reported information.
  • Design and build aggregates and semantic layers that support high-performance reporting.
  • Apply best practices for dashboard design, performance tuning, and user experience in Tableau.
  • Understand the underlying architecture of our data environment, including data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse concepts.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and senior business Intelligence engineers to ensure data models and pipelines are optimized for reporting.
  • Play an integral role in the migration from legacy software reporting to Tableau, ensuring consistency, data accuracy, and modernization of reporting standards.
  • Validate data quality, reconcile reporting outputs with source data, and troubleshoot discrepancies.
  • Document data flows, metrics definitions, and dashboards to support governance and scalability.
  • Provide training or guidance to business users on reporting capabilities and best practices.

Performs additional duties as assigned.

​

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • Proficient in SQL, with the ability to analyze, aggregate, and troubleshoot data across multiple dialects.
  • Knowledge of Tableau for dashboard creation, storytelling through data, and embedded visualization.
  • Working understanding of data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse architecture and how they support analytics.
  • Experience creating aggregates, semantic layers, and optimized schemas for reporting performance.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating reporting workloads within them.
  • Understanding of dashboard performance optimization, data-model best practices, and visualization standards.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills to translate data insights into business recommendations.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of three years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data-reporting roles.

Our people set us apart. We offer a collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can grow your skills, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.


Our success is recognized across the industry, with honors including MOTOR Top 20 Awards, a Gold American Business Award, and 22 #1 rankings in the Dealers’ Choice Awards. We’re also proud to be among the few companies recognized by J.D. Power for “Highest Overall Dealer Satisfaction.”


As part of CNA Financial, you’ll benefit from the strength of a leading insurer with over $60 billion in assets—combined with the growth and energy of a forward-moving organization.

Grow your career. Make an impact. Join CNA National.

Category: Pharma/Biotech/Clinical Research

Location:


The Clinical Research Manager (CRM) is responsible for the strategic and operational oversight of clinical trials conducted across various phases. This role ensures that studies are executed in compliance with regulatory requirements, GCP/ICH guidelines, and internal SOPs. The CRM manages cross-functional teams, monitors timelines and budgets, and acts as the primary liaison between investigators, CROs, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead the planning, execution, and management of clinical trials across multiple therapeutic areas and phases.
Oversee site selection, study start-up, patient recruitment, data collection, and close-out activities.
Ensure compliance with FDA, ICH-GCP, and other applicable regulatory standards.
Develop and maintain project timelines, budgets, and resource plans.
Supervise and mentor Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), Clinical Trial Assistants (CTAs), and study coordinators.
Review and approve study documentation including protocols, CRFs, informed consent forms, and monitoring reports.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams including regulatory affairs, data management, biostatistics, and medical writing.
Manage vendor and CRO relationships, including contract negotiations and performance monitoring.
Track and report on study metrics and provide regular updates to senior leadership.
Oversee the preparation and conduct of audits and regulatory inspections.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, or related field (Master’s or Ph.D. preferred).
Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in clinical research, including 2+ years in a managerial or supervisory role.
In-depth knowledge of clinical trial processes, ICH-GCP guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
Proven experience managing Phase I-IV trials across multiple therapeutic areas.
Strong project management, leadership, and team coordination skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Proficiency with clinical trial software (e.g., CTMS, EDC, eTMF platforms).
Ability to travel up to 20% as needed.

In addition to a dynamic and collaborative work environment, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees' well-being. Our benefits include paid holidays, Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, and medical insurance to ensure our team members have the flexibility and coverage they need. The Key Accounts Technical Solution Consultant plays a critical role within Intuitive’s Digital Implementation team. This role is responsible for the successful technical engagement, deployment, and long-term integration of Intuitive’s digital solutions across Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) and other strategic key accounts.

Working in close partnership with Intuitive’s Key Account Directors, this individual will serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise-level IT.

This individual is accountable for ensuring strategic alignment and a scalable implementation framework that advances customer digital adoption across Intuitive platforms and deepens Intuitive’s relationship with key enterprise accounts. About the job

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.

You will:

- Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
- Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
- Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
- Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
- Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

Requirements

  • Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.

  • Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.

  • Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.

  • Experience working with a remote team

  • Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.

  • Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

Zayo is seeking a Manager, Design Engineering - Optical to lead a team of Optical Design Engineers that are responsible for designing, capital allocation, link engineering, project managing, and implementing new optical services on DWDM network.

Our mission is to create the Experience of a Lifetime for our employees, so they can, in turn, create the Experience of a Lifetime for our guests. We own and operate the most renowned destination resorts in the world as well as regional and local ski areas outside major cities, and connect them all through one unrivaled network. We are looking for ambitious leaders, innovators and creators to join our talented team. If you’re ready to pursue your fullest potential, we want to get to know you!

Candidates for year-round positions are reviewed on a rolling basis. Applications will be accepted up to 90 days after the posting date, or until the position is filled (whichever is first).

Job Summary:

We are looking for a curious, driven, innovative machine learning engineer who takes initiative to solve problems and create environments that accelerate the development, deployment, and usage of data science models and AI to drive greater organizational impact.

The Data Science & Data Engineering team within the Enterprise Analytics organization builds data assets, predictive models, analytical applications, and platforms across the organization. Our team collaborates with business stakeholders, analysts, and technology teams to tackle high-impact use cases with state-of-the-art models and tools to grow the business, streamline costs, and improve guest experiences.

Job Specifications:

  • Starting Wage: $140,000 - $185,000 + Annual Bonus

  • Employment Type: Year Round

  • Shift Type: Full Time hours

  • Minimum Age: At least 18 years of age

  • Housing Availability: No

Job Responsibilities:

  • Productionize ML models developed by data science into reliable, monitored, maintainable systems.
  • Build model data foundations that ensure training, inference, monitoring, and analytics data are trustworthy and scalable.
  • Architect ML platform patterns in Databricks that bring reliability, consistency, governance, performance, and cost discipline to ML and data workflows.
  • Identify and scope opportunities for ML engineering across the business for high-impact.
  • Develop reusable tools, libraries, standards, documentation, and production-readiness practices to enable data science and data engineering teams.
  • Develop analytical and model-powered applications that turn data and ML outputs into usable business workflows for end users.
  • Prepare the platform for future AI engineering, including LLM and agent-based systems, as the organization matures.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring across engineering, architecture, and development including design and code reviews.

Job Requirements:

Technical Skills:

  • Quantitative Foundation: B.S. degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering).
  • Software Engineering Fundamentals: write clean, modular, testable, maintainable code and understand how to structure production-grade systems rather than one-off notebooks or scripts.
  • Python and SQL Proficiency: strong in Python and SQL for building data pipelines, automation, model integrations, analytical workflows, and production services.
  • Data Modeling and Pipeline Design: understand how to design reliable, well-structured data assets, including curated tables, feature datasets, batch pipelines, orchestration, data quality checks, and lineage.
  • ML Lifecycle Fluency: understand the full model lifecycle: data collection, exploration, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement.
  • Production ML Patterns: understand core MLOps patterns such as model registries, feature/data versioning, reproducible environments, testing/validation, monitoring, and rollback.
  • Cloud and Platform Engineering: You are comfortable working in cloud-based data and ML environments and understand the foundations of permissions, environments, jobs, services, storage, networking, and cost-aware architecture.
  • Databricks Expertise: You’re familiar and experienced with the core parts of Spark, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, MLflow, model registry patterns, job/cluster optimization, and governance.
  • DevOps Practices: You use modern engineering practices such as Git, CI/CD, automated testing, code review, dependency management, environment management, and observability.
  • Application Development: You can build applications, APIs, dashboards, or workflow tools that sit on top of data and model outputs.
  • System Design: You can reason through tradeoffs across reliability, latency, scale, cost, governance, maintainability, and ease of use.

Soft Skills:

  • Curious: bring intellectual curiosity, an inquisitive nature, and a desire to deepen your knowledge and continue learning.
  • Ownership: take responsibility to proactively advance projects, contribute to the organization, and develop the best solutions.
  • Communication: explain technical concepts, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaboration: work effectively cross-functionally with data scientists, data engineers, analysts, application engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders.
  • Pragmatism: You know how to balance ideal architecture with business urgency, team maturity, operational constraints, and the need to ship.

Preferred qualifications:

  • A graduate degree (Masters or PhD) in a quantitative field
  • Experience with dbt (Core) for modular data modeling, including testing, documentation, and dependency management
  • Experience with AI engineer to use, build, and monitor agentic solutions

  • MORE employee discounts on lodging, food, gear, and mountain shuttles
