raw.description:
About Artemis

At Artemis (artemispower.com), we're on a mission to accelerate the adoption of solar, storage, EV charging, and home improvements by making them more accessible, transparent, and affordable. Founded in 2022, we're a venture-backed climate tech company using machine learning and AI to reinvent how homeowners upgrade their homes — a market orders of magnitude bigger than solar alone. Our platform generates instant, accurate proposals and streamlines the sales process for homeowners and installers alike.

We're a fast-growing, dynamic startup moving quickly — shipping new products, entering adjacent categories, and expanding the platform every quarter. If you want broad surface area, fast feedback loops, and real ownership, this is the place.

Our values

  • Challenge Assumptions. Creatively find better ways of working.
  • Stop, Look, Listen, and Smell. Pay attention before you act — gather context, read the room.
  • Move Fast. Thoughtfully prioritize work.
  • Be Scrappy. View problems as opportunities; stay lean.
  • Always be Learning. Stay curious; invest in your craft.
  • Do the Right Thing. Keep commitments, close the loop.

The role

Support Engineers sit at L2 in our support stack — L1 (Technical Support Representatives) handle direct customer contact, you're the technical responder they lean on, and L3 (senior engineers) is where you escalate when a problem needs deeper investigation. You'll run technical investigations, ship bug fixes, and keep L1 unblocked so customers stay unblocked. Because support touches every part of the product, you'll build broad familiarity across the codebase and work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.

The shift for this position is 3PM-11PM ET weekdays, with on-call every other Saturday 10am-3pm ET.

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical responder on your assigned support shifts — this is an L2 role, so most tickets reach you via escalation from L1, not directly from customers.
  • Support our L1 Technical Support Representatives with technical context, reproduction steps, and answers that unblock their customer conversations.
  • Run technical investigations on escalated issues and ship bug fixes end-to-end — scrappy, not sloppy.
  • Escalate to L3 (senior engineers) when a problem needs deeper investigation, and time-box your own digs.
  • Identify recurring issues across tickets, propose broader fixes, and suggest metrics that improve visibility on high-impact problems.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Product to turn customer context into the right fix.
  • Document findings, write knowledge-base articles, and leave the code better than you found it.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in an engineering or technical support role in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Comfortable in a modern web stack — Next.js, React, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and a scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar).
  • Hands-on with testing and monitoring tools like Postman, PostHog, CloudWatch, Sentry, or equivalents.
  • Experience with support ticketing systems (Zendesk, Jira, Linear, or similar).
  • Strong written communication — you can explain a technical problem to both a customer and a senior engineer.
  • Thrives in a fast-moving, dynamic startup environment — comfortable with shifting priorities and ambiguity.
  • Hands-on experience with AI development tools and workflow (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) for investigation, debugging, and shipping fixes faster.

What we offer

  • Fully remote work.
  • Stock options.
  • Health benefits.
  • Paid time off and vacations.
  • Annual tech allowance.
  • Professional development through courses, seminars, and certifications.

Interested? Email your resume to — a short note on why you're drawn to the role helps us move fast.

Artemis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Operational Technologies (OT) Engineer

Remote, United States | Up to 25% Travel (U.S. & Canada)

Advance Life Around the World with Dura-Line

Join Dura‑Line, an Orbia Connectivity Solutions business, where we create solutions that connect people and information across the globe. As a leading global manufacturer of conduit products and accessories, Dura‑Line creates the pathways that power connectivity across a wide range of markets worldwide. Quality, safety, and sustainability are at the core of everything we do, with environmentally responsible practices embedded throughout our manufacturing processes. Be part of our shared mission with Orbia to Advance Life Around the World.

About the Role

Dura-Line is seeking an experienced Operational Technologies (OT) Engineer to support and expand connectivity across our manufacturing operations.

This role serves as the bridge between manufacturing equipment, Operational Technology (OT) systems, and enterprise IT infrastructure. You will be responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and accurate production data flows from the shop floor into the systems used by Engineering, Operations, and business leaders to drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Success in this role requires a combination of technical expertise and strong collaboration skills. You'll work closely with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, IT, and external equipment vendors to implement and support manufacturing connectivity solutions across multiple facilities.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving manufacturing data challenges, improving operational visibility, and supporting digital transformation initiatives in a multi-site manufacturing environment.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and support communications between manufacturing equipment, OT systems, and enterprise IT infrastructure.

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Ignition applications and integrations.

  • Administer and support manufacturing historian platforms, including Canary Labs and similar technologies.

  • Ensure manufacturing data is accurate, available, and reliable across OT systems and connected applications.

  • Select and implement I/O and connectivity hardware to support manufacturing data acquisition requirements.

  • Support integration and troubleshooting of PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment.

  • Develop and maintain OT standards, documentation, and best practices to improve system sustainability and scalability.

  • Partner with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, IT teams, and equipment vendors to support manufacturing connectivity initiatives.

Voor deze functie zoeken we een ervaren professional met een sterke achtergrond in workplace engineering, endpoint management en systeembeheer.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen workplacebeheer of endpoint management.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Customer experience:

Customer experience at Nebius AI Cloud involves tackling customers’ challenges and directly impacting their success by solving real-world AI and ML problems at massive GPU cloud scale. You’ll not only resolve issues, but play a key role in shaping clients’ business success by optimizing their AI solutions. Working with advanced GPUs such as H200, B200 and GB200, as well as modern ML frameworks, you’ll influence the development of the Nebius AI Cloud and gain experience at the intersection of infrastructure and AI. With minimal bureaucracy, you’ll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership and drive change. Opportunities for growth are abundant in this vibrant and supportive professional community.

The role

We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused professional to join our team as a Solutions Architect specializing in Cloud infrastructure and MLOps. As a Cloud Solutions Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing cutting-edge solutions for our clients, leveraging cloud technologies for ML/AI teams and becoming a trusted technical advisor for building their pipelines.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to our clients, providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the engagement. Conduct PoC, workshops, presentations, and training sessions to educate clients on GPU cloud technologies and best practices.
  • Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and develop solution architecture that align with their needs: design and document Infrastructure as code solutions, documentation and technical how-tos in collaboration with support engineers and technical writers.
  • Help customers to optimize pipeline performance and scalability to ensure efficient utilization of cloud resources and services powered by Nebius AI.
  • Act as a single point of expertise of customer scenarios for product, technical support, marketing teams.
  • Assist to Marketing department efforts during events (Hackathons, conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.)

We expect you to have:

  • 5 - 10 + years of experience as a cloud solutions architect, system/network engineer, developer or a similar technical role with a focus on cloud computing
  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with IaC and configuration management tools (preferably Terraform/Ansible), Kubernetes, skills of writing code in Python
  • Solid understanding of GPU computing practices for ML training and inference workloads, GPU software stack components, including drivers, libraries (e.g. CUDA, OpenCL)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Customer-centric mindset

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Hands-on experience with HPC/ML orchestration frameworks (e.g. Slurm, Kubeflow)
  • Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch)
  • Solid understanding of cloud ML tools landscape from industry leaders (NVIDIA, AWS, Azure, Google)

Key Employee Benefits:

  • Health Insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
  • 401(k) Plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
  • Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
  • Remote Work Reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
  • Disability & Life Insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term, and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

On Target Earnings Range
$250,000—$320,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Are you ready to join Kyndryl’s CIO Hire‑to‑Retire organization as a Senior Lead, Software Engineering Specialist - Workday Benefits? We are seeking an experienced, independently driven Workday practitioner to design, configure, and support Benefits solutions with Workday as the system of record.

In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert for Workday Benefits, owning solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment across global business requirements. You will partner closely with HR, Payroll, and downstream teams to deliver accurate, compliant, and scalable solutions that support both day‑to‑day operations and evolving business needs.

You will be responsible for translating business requirements into Workday configuration solutions, advising on best practices, identifying impacts across related domains, and ensuring solutions are sustainable and supportable. This role requires the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion with limited oversight.

You will collaborate with integration partners and technical teams where needed, but your primary focus will be on functional configuration, solution quality, and business outcomes, rather than custom development. This role offers the opportunity to be a key contributor to a business‑critical HR platform supporting Kyndryl’s global workforce, supporting cross‑functional solution and assessing end‑to‑end impacts across the Hire‑to‑Retire lifecycle.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands‑on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • 7+ years of hands‑on Workday configuration experience, with deep expertise in Benefits
  • Proven ability to independently design and deliver Workday configuration solutions, from requirements through deployment
  • Strong understanding of benefits, and payroll‑related business processes, including downstream impacts
  • Experience supporting production Workday environments, including troubleshooting and configuration changes in live systems
  • Experience supporting global or multi‑country Workday deployments
  • Familiarity with Workday business process frameworks, security considerations, and reporting impacts related to Time and Absence
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, supportable Workday solutions using best‑practice configuration approaches
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills in an enterprise, cross‑functional environment

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • Experience configuring one or more additional Workday functional areas, such as Compensation, Absence, Time Tracking, or Projects
  • Experience working in a matrixed or global team
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, HRIS, or a related field

Workplace: Brazil (remote)


Working hours: From 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM - Monday to Friday.

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

Description

We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to join the infrastructure team to build and maintain the infrastructure that powers reliable product delivery at scale. You will help ensure that engineering teams can ship faster, systems stay stable, and customers receive a seamless experience.

In this role, you will own and improve the platforms, automation, and processes behind our development lifecycle — from deployment pipelines and infrastructure reliability to monitoring and operational excellence. Your will work closely with client team and impact for delivering new features and how confidently we can run our products in production.

We are actively integrating AI and automation into all areas of the business and are looking for candidates with a mindset focused on improving efficiency, automating repetitive processes, and delivering a better user experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Own and operate CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and the self-hosted runner fleet (Linux/macOS/Windows); keep deploys and rollbacks reliable and fast.
  • Operate Kubernetes (Hetzner) and Helm-managed services; containerize and ship services with Docker.
  • Operate and recover the data layer: MySQL/Percona XtraDB (multi-region replication), ClickHouse, Redis/Memcached, Kafka.
  • Own the network/edge layer: nginx load balancing, Cloudflare/CDN, DNS, TLS certificates.
  • Maintain the observability stack (self-hosted Sentry, Prometheus/Grafana, Graylog) and run its migrations.
  • Maintain build infrastructure for mobile/desktop apps
  • Serve as infrastructure on-call: incident response, coordination, and root-cause analysis.
  • Use AI tooling to accelerate configuration, automation, diagnostics, and documentation.

Requirements

  • Production CI/CD: Jenkins + GitHub Actions.
  • Kubernetes + Helm; Docker.
  • Strong Linux administration; nginx; operating PHP/php-fpm applications.
  • MySQL/Percona XtraDB: replication, recovery, troubleshooting.
  • Configuration management with Ansible.
  • Scripting: Bash + (Python or PHP).
  • CDN/Cloudflare or other S3-compatible storage experience.
  • MacOS/iOS builds (fastlane, certificates, provisioning, DSYM), Android builds.
  • Nexus or other private registries.
  • On-call / incident-management experience.
  • Practical, daily use of AI coding/ops assistants.

Nice to have

  • ClickHouse, Redis/Memcached, Kafka, ZooKeeper.
  • Self-hosted Sentry, Prometheus/Grafana, DataDog
  • Multi-region infrastructure; Go (for tooling/exporters)

Blueland is reimagining everyday cleaning essentials with safe, products that are free from single-use plastic and eliminate the need to choose between what’s safe for your family, good for the planet, and proven to work. With 45 patents granted & 39 patents pending worldwide, Blueland’s innovative products have diverted over 1 billion single-use plastic bottles from landfills and oceans and 7.5 million pounds of CO2 from the atmosphere since 2019. While traditional cleaners are packaged in plastic and may contain up to 95% water, all Blueland products utilize tablet or powder formats, designed to be used directly or mixed with household tap water, and come in compostable or recyclable packaging. From the kitchen sink to the laundry room, we create products families can trust and afford to use over and over (and over) again. Available on Blueland.com and nationwide at Target, Costco, Whole Foods and select local retailers.
In a world where half of the planet’s carbon emissions come from just 36 companies, we believe that business should be a force for good and that mission and profit are not mutually exclusive—in fact, we’re proof of it. We’re committed to holding ourselves to the highest parental and environmental standards—which includes ongoing and unbiased certifications from trusted third-party organizations like Cradle to Cradle, EPA Safer Choice, USDA BioPreferred, Leaping Bunny, and EWG Verified. We’re also a Certified Climate Neutral business and certified B Corp “Best for the World.”
Blueland was featured on the Season 11 premiere of Shark Tank and successfully secured an investment. We’re also well-funded by top tier venture capital firms as well as notable investors including Gwyneth Paltrow, Justin Timberlake and founders of Sweetgreen, Thrive Market, Honest Company, Rent the Runway, and Bonobos. Our products have been featured across top tier outlets including the New York Times, Fast Company, TechCrunch, VOGUE, Wall Street Journal, Inc., and more.

About the Role

    As Director of Sales, you will play a key role in Blueland’s disruptive growth in Retail. This is a unique opportunity to change the landscape of many categories on retail shelves, making it easy for people to make sustainable choices with Blueland’s innovative products that prioritize people and planet. You will play a critical role in the company’s future growth as Blueland continues to scale and significantly broaden brand awareness.

    We are looking for an exceptional executor and well-rounded strategic leader who can inspire and make waves both internally and externally. The ideal candidate will champion a “go farther together” mentality and style, working extremely well across all of Blueland’s functional teams to bring our retail vision to life while exceeding customer expectations. This role reports to the VP of Retail.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the successful development and execution of Blueland’s retail business with partners, including Grocery, E-commerce, Specialty, and Discount classes of trade.
  • Responsible for strategy and execution across our customer accounts.
  • Own the customer P&L, including shopper marketing & trade.
  • Work closely with the Retail Sales Planning Manager on forecasting and the Retail Category Manager on analytics and insights.
  • Create and own the annual business plans for retail customers to achieve top-line revenue and profitability goals while also ensuring alignment with Blueland’s overall brand strategy and mission.
  • Successfully collaborate with cross-functional teams to support go-to-market strategy and demand-building initiatives across our retail customers.
  • Share data-backed, compelling solutions and ideas for retail internally.
  • Foster exceptionally strong relationships with our retail customers, including buying, marketing, and leadership, to drive fully aligned partnerships that support outsized outcomes for Blueland.
  • Manage broker relationships and drive accountability for their role in delivering outstanding results.
  • Report directly to the VP of Retail on a regular basis regarding key account priorities, goals, strategy, and initiatives.
  • Lead the charge on all new item/innovation presentations to retailers, in line with channel and overall company strategies.

Qualifications

  • Passionate about sustainability and Blueland’s mission.
  • Demonstrated sales experience with distribution channels of business, including conventional grocery, natural/specialty grocery, and discount retailers.
  • 5-8 years of experience in sales with a working knowledge within the CPG industry; startup experience preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills to work effectively and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strategic, professional, and energized by doing the work everyone else thinks is impossible
    Customer-obsessed and motivated by fostering genuine partnerships that lead to industry-defining success at retail.
  • Willingness to think outside the box to deliver optimized execution at retail on a start-up budget.
  • A desire and humility to always improve, learn, and grow.
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets and Powerpoint/Google Slides is required. Experience with Slack, Google Suite, Looker, and Notion is preferred.
  • Eager to leverage AI and automation to drive customer insights and build data-based selling stories.
  • Comfortable and capable of responsibly using AI resources to optimize work.
  • Travel is required (1-2x per month).

Salary

    The salary range for this position is $188,000-200,000 per year.
We prioritize our planet and our people. In addition to salary compensation, we offer various other benefits to ensure our team members can be their best self, both in and outside of work. Benefits for full time roles include: health benefits, stock options, generous paid time off, paid holidays, paid civic engagement days, paid parental leave, 401k (employee contribution), professional development stipends, remote work reimbursements, various discounts to like-minded companies and more.

Collaboration on Complex Projects:

In accordance with Achieve’s Lead Forward Rubric, this Director position requires demonstrated excellence across four foundational leadership pillars:

1. Trusted, Steady Leadership

Maintains composure and steady communication during high-pressure pivots. Instills trust across teams through consistency, fairness, and transparent communication. Bridges the competing stakeholder priorities, using credibility and relationships to align divergent teams around shared goals.

2. Focused & Agile

Sets high-impact objectives that streamline cross-team execution and remove low-value work. Actively leads teams through change by providing context, engaging managers, addressing resistance, and adjusting plans as needed. Navigates complex ambiguity with confidence, evaluating options and providing sufficient clarity for teams to act while remaining flexible.

3. Own the Outcome

Drives consistently high performance through disciplined execution and clear, transparent accountability practices. Standardizes core cross-team workflows so execution remains dependable without relying on crisis management or individual heroics. Actively identifies where workflows break down between managers, replacing manual workarounds with repeatable, scalable procedures.

4. Grow People & Capability

Identifies key talent, holds managers accountable for developing their teams, and supports active coaching. Drives strong leadership development across teams and builds capable managers. Invests in coaching, feedback, and growth opportunities to elevate capability and consistency across the function.

  • A safe place to connect and a commitment to diversity and inclusion through our six employee resource groups

Note: We will be unable to facilitate H1-B Visa transfer or sponsorship, along with STEM-OPT Visa.

Work from home/hybrid:

We are proudly offering hybrid options in the Phoenix, AZ and San Francisco, CA metro market. We are offering 100% remote work in other approved PST, MST, CST locations.

Salary Range: $220,000 to $250,000 salary + bonus + benefits.

This information represents the expected salary range for this role. Should we decide to make an offer for employment, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

Join Achieve, change the future.

At Achieve, we’re changing millions of lives.
From the single parent trying to catch up on bills to the entrepreneur needing a loan for the next phase of growth, you’ll get to be a part of their journey to a better financial future. We’re proud to have over 3,000 employees in mostly hybrid and 100% remote roles across the United States with hubs in Arizona, California, and Texas. We are strategically growing our teams with more remote, work-from-home opportunities every day to better serve our members. A career at Achieve is more than a job—it’s a place where you can make a true impact, have a sense of belonging, establish a fulfilling career, and put your well-being first.

All inquiries should be directed to Talent Acquisition only. We reserve the right to hire any candidates sent unsolicited and will not pay any fees without a contract signed by Achieve’s Talent Acquisition leader.

Every day, we get to help our members move their finances forward with care, compassion, and empathetic touch. We put people first and treat them like humans, not account numbers.

We Are:

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue.


You Are:

You are a senior SAP Manufacturing leader with deep experience designing and delivering SAP Digital Manufacturing, SAP PP, and manufacturing execution solutions. You bring the ability to shape client manufacturing transformation agendas, lead complex S/4HANA-to-shop-floor solution design, guide executive-level key design decisions, and build high-performing Accenture delivery teams across global manufacturing programs.


The Work:

  • Lead strategic assessment of client manufacturing, production, quality, execution, and shop-floor processes to define future-state SAP Manufacturing and SAP Digital Manufacturing solutions.
  • Own end-to-end solution architecture across SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing, SAP PP, SAP Digital Manufacturing, MES, quality, inventory, warehouse, and shop-floor integration domains.
  • Lead large SAP Manufacturing implementation programs, from design and configuration through build, integration testing, deployment, cutover, hypercare, and stabilization.
  • Facilitate executive and cross-functional design workshops, driving key design decisions with clear recommendations, standard SAP leading practices, and fit-to-standard guidance.
  • Direct the design, configuration, extension, testing, and deployment of SAP Digital Manufacturing capabilities including production execution, resource orchestration, POD design, production process design, quality execution, traceability, and analytics.
  • Design and govern integrations between SAP S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, SAP EWM, SAP QM, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, shop-floor equipment, PLCs, SCADA, historians, and automation systems.
  • Provide senior-level oversight for production connector, PCo, OPC, MQTT, API, and equipment integration patterns to enable real-time data capture, operational visibility, and automation.
  • Advise clients on SAP ME/MII/legacy MES modernization, cloud MES adoption, global template strategy, multi-plant rollout planning, and sustainable support models.
  • Collaborate with project teams, delivery leads, client executives, architects, and Accenture capability leaders to create differentiated SAP Manufacturing offerings and delivery assets.
  • Coach and mentor consultants, solution architects, and client teams while maintaining delivery quality, risk management, and alignment to business outcomes.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need:

  • Minimum of 12 years of hands-on SAP Manufacturing experience, including SAP Production Planning (PP), SAP Digital Manufacturing, SAP Manufacturing Execution, SAP MII, Plant Connectivity (PCo), and manufacturing integration solutions.
  • Experience leading multiple full-lifecycle SAP Manufacturing or MES implementations in a solution lead, functional lead, architect, or program leadership capacity.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with SAP Digital Manufacturing execution and insights, including configuration, Production Process Designer modeling, POD design, APIs, manufacturing data objects, extensions, reports, and analytics.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience and understanding of SAP S/4HANA manufacturing master data and transaction data, including materials, BOMs, routings, work centers, production/process orders, confirmations, goods movements, and quality integration.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience designing integrations between SAP S/4HANA and SAP Digital Manufacturing using standard interfaces, APIs, IDocs/BAPIs, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, Cloud Connector, and shop-floor connectivity patterns.
  • Experience leading client workshops, define key design decisions, manage senior stakeholders, and translate manufacturing business objectives into scalable SAP solution designs.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Equivalent experience requires a minimum of 12 years total work experience.

Bonus Points If:

  • You have experience with SAP Quality Management, including quality master data, inspection planning, results recording, nonconformance management, usage decision, and integration with SAP Digital Manufacturing.
  • You have experience with SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) and its integration with manufacturing processes including staging, floor stock, component consumption, goods issue, and goods receipt.
  • You have experience with manufacturing analytics, OEE, KPI design, operational reporting, SAP Analytics Cloud, manufacturing data objects, and insight-driven performance improvement.
  • You have an understanding of OPC servers, OPC UA/DA, MQTT, PLCs, SCADA, historians, SAP Production Connector, and integration with shop-floor automation systems.
  • You have experience with SAP ME/MII modernization, global MES templates, multi-site rollouts, regulated manufacturing environments, or cloud-based MES transformation.\

U.S. Consular Services - Senior Associate


Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private, and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.


To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.


Our U.S. Consular Services team supports corporate clients and their employees with business visa and consular service needs. As a Senior Associate, you will manage business visa and consular matters from initial assessment through completion, providing thoughtful, consultative guidance and exceptional client service throughout the process. You will work closely with clients, embassies and consulates, global colleagues, and external service providers to support successful case outcomes.


This position is ideal for an experienced business visa professional looking to expand their client exposure, advisory responsibilities, and technical leadership within a collaborative and consultative environment.


Responsibilities

  • Manage an active portfolio of business visa and consular matters from initiation through completion.
  • Assess business visa requirements and provide appropriate guidance based on traveler circumstances and destination requirements.
  • Prepare, coordinate, review, and monitor business visa applications and supporting documentation.
  • Serve as a point of contact for clients, providing timely updates, issue resolution, and proactive guidance throughout the case lifecycle.
  • Coordinate visa appointment scheduling and consular processing activities.
  • Liaise directly with embassies and consulates to support business visa and consular matters.
  • Partner with Vialto colleagues globally to support cross-border business visa and consular services.
  • Monitor government and consular updates and communicate relevant changes internally and externally.
  • Maintain accurate case records and adhere to Vialto quality standards and operational procedures.
  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and quality review support to junior team members.
  • Support larger client projects and contribute to process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Contribute to client advisory discussions and help strengthen long-term client relationships through a consultative service approach.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of directly relevant business visa experience.
  • Hands-on experience preparing and managing business visa applications.
  • Strong case management experience supporting matters from initiation through completion.
  • Experience coordinating visa appointments and managing consular processing requirements.
  • Experience liaising directly with embassies and consulates in support of business visa and consular matters.
  • Strong understanding of corporate business visa processes and outbound travel authorization requirements.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong client service orientation and relationship management capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams.
  • High attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with legalizations and apostilles.
  • Experience supporting passport services.
  • Experience mentoring, reviewing work, or providing technical guidance to junior colleagues.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

  • Exposure to consultative client advisory work rather than purely transactional processing.
  • Opportunity to review work, mentor others, and expand leadership capabilities.
  • Strong visibility within a growing practice.
  • Long-term career growth opportunities as the team expands.
  • Ability to build meaningful client relationships and contribute to thoughtful, solutions-focused service delivery.

Additional Information:


Location: Remote, U.S.-based. Candidates located on the West Coast are preferred, but location is not a requirement.

Employment Type: Regular / Full Time

Salary Range: $50,000–$80,000


Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, education, professional qualifications, and overall capabilities.


We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on any legally protected status.


Please note that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used as part of the application process.


Life at Vialto

At Vialto, we believe our best work happens when people collaborate in a culture of belonging, respect, and inclusion. We encourage employees to bring their authentic selves, share their unique talents and expertise, and make a positive impact on the clients and communities we serve.


If you are looking to deepen your business visa and consular expertise, build meaningful client relationships, and contribute to the future of global mobility, we would love to hear from you.

Director of Marketing

Parsley Health · Marketing · Remote US, with a preference for Eastern or Central time zones and NYC metro · Full-time

About Parsley Health

Parsley Health is rebuilding primary care around root-cause, whole-person medicine. Our members get board-certified clinicians, health coaches, advanced testing, and a care platform that connects the dots across all of it.

We are a mostly virtual medical practice with care available across the country, and we recently expanded in-network access nationwide. As we grow, we are continuing to improve how we connect growth, care delivery, member experience, and financial performance so we can make better decisions and scale sustainably.

About the role

The Director of Marketing owns Parsley's full growth engine with the goal of acquiring more members efficiently. This is a high-visibility role in the driver's seat of Parsley's growth. Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you'll run the channels that drive acquisition today and make sure brand investment shows up in conversion, CAC, and LTV.

We’re looking for a growth marketer with proven results, and with a strong track record of leveraging brand, trust, and storytelling lower acquisition cost and lift conversion, and who manages them accordingly.

What you’ll own

You'll lead a team of in-house specialists, agencies, and contractors to deliver on:

  • Growth channels: Own paid media (our primary channel), SEO, lifecycle, and affiliate. Set strategy, budget allocation, and testing priorities, and manage our paid media agency to CAC and payback targets.
  • Membership join flow and CRO: Partner with the Growth Product Manager on join-flow and site conversion, and align on a shared testing roadmap.
  • Brand, content, and PR: Partner with the Brand Manager on brand strategy and content, and with our PR agency on earned media, so all of it builds demand and trust that show up in conversion and CAC.
  • Measurement and planning: Own the marketing plan, budget, and forecast by channel. Define how the brand contributes to growth, report weekly on funnel performance, and make clear reallocation calls.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years in growth marketing, with 3+ years leading a multi-channel team at a DTC, subscription, or consumer health company.
  • Hands-on ownership of paid media budgets and agency management against CAC and payback targets.
  • Direct experience scaling affiliate, SEO, and/or lifecycle/CRM.
  • A track record of using brand, content, or PR to move growth metrics
  • Strong data fluency, including using AI tools to self-serve and scale both campaigns and analytics.
  • Comfortable being both strategist and operator on a lean team
  • Healthcare, telehealth, or wellness experience preferred
  • Experience marketing insurance-covered services preferred
  • Experience partnering with a sales team on lead-to-purchase conversion

Compensation & Benefits

Parsley Health is committed to providing an equitable, fair, and transparent compensation program for all employees.

The starting salary for this role is between $160,000 and $190,000, depending on skills and experience. We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, scope, and internal equity relative to peers at the company.

Benefits include

  • Equity stake for all employees based on role level
  • 401(k) + employer matching program
  • Hybrid opportunity with remote work and time on site at our NYC HQ
  • Complimentary Parsley Health Complete Care membership
  • Subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options
  • Generous flexible time off plan
  • Annual professional development stipend
  • Annual wellness stipend

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Parsley Health we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

The more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members.

Important note

In light of the recent increase in hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you directly from an @parsleyhealth.com email address to guide you through our interview process.

Please note:

  • We will never communicate with you via Microsoft Teams
  • We will never ask for your bank account information at any point during the recruitment process
  • We will never send you a check, electronic or physical, to purchase home office equipment

We look forward to connecting.

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture

As a Customer Operations Specialist on our International RSS team, you will provide end-to-end operational and administrative support for our international customer base. You will play a crucial role in managing configuration setups, and maintaining high-quality account data. Working collaboratively across cross-functional teams, you will drive process improvements, and leverage modern tools for automation. This position offers an exciting opportunity to take ownership of operational projects while growing within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct continuous quality assurance checks, data audits, and record validations to ensure systemic accuracy across all restaurant, hotel, customer, and group accounts.
  • Build, analyze, and distribute standard and ad-hoc operational reports and promotional management templates for key stakeholders.
  • Identify process bottlenecks and implement operational enhancements, utilizing modern AI and automation tools to optimize workflow efficiency.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to manage business projects, refine team documentation, and support the development and communication of team processes.
  • Identify data discrepancies and work with relevant teams to resolve issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Provide high-quality administrative support, completing data entry, documentation, and routine tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Manage competing priorities to ensure all operational deliverables meet established quality standards and deadlines.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 1 year of experience in an administrative, operational, customer support, implementation, or hospitality-related role.
  • Experience managing data entry, maintaining customer records, and using CRM or administrative software systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a track record of effective stakeholder collaboration.
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Office or Google Workspace suite.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the restaurant, hospitality, or SaaS technology industry.
  • Prior background onboarding customers, delivering software training, or conducting quality assurance audits.

raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Opportunity for a TX licensed Behavioral Health Professional (LPC, LMSW, or LCSW) to join Molina to work with our Medicaid members who have Behavioral Health needs that may include moderate to complex cases requiring care coordination. Applicants should have experience caring for people with serious emotional disturbances, or severe and persistent mental health conditions, including substance abuse disorders. Most of the responsibilities will be managed telephonically, but there may be rare instances where meeting with a member in person may be needed. We are accepting applications from qualified candidates who reside anywhere in Texas; applicants who have previous experience working as a case manager within a managed care organization (MCO) like Molina are preferred. Hours are M – F, 8 AM – 5 PM in your time zone.

Solid experience with Microsoft Office Suite is necessary, especially with Outlook, Excel, Teams, and One Note as well as experience using a clinical documentation software program.

Job Summary

Provides support for care management/care coordination activities and collaborates with multidisciplinary team coordinating integrated delivery of member care across the continuum. Strives to ensure member progress toward desired outcomes and contributes to overarching strategy to provide quality and cost-effective member care.

Essential Job Duties

  • Completes comprehensive behavioral health assessments of members per regulated timelines and determines who may qualify for care coordination/case management based on clinical judgment, changes in member health or psychosocial wellness and triggers identified in assessments.
    • Develops and implements care plan in collaboration with member, caregiver, physician and/or other appropriate healthcare professionals and member support network to address member needs and goals.
    • Conducts telephonic, face-to-face or home visits as required.
    • Performs ongoing monitoring of care plan to evaluate effectiveness, document interventions and goal achievement, and suggest changes accordingly.
    • Maintains ongoing member caseload for regular outreach and management.
    • Promotes integration of services for members including behavioral health, long-term services and supports (LTSS), and home and community resources to enhance continuity of care.
    • Facilitates interdisciplinary care team meetings and informal ICT collaboration.
    • Uses motivational interviewing and Molina clinical guideposts to educate, support and motivate change during member contacts.
    • Assesses for barriers to care, provides care coordination and assistance to member to address concerns.
    • May provide consultation, resources and recommendations to peers as needed.
    • 25-40% estimated local travel may be required (based upon state/contractual requirements).

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years health care experience, preferably in behavioral health, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
    • Licensed behavioral health clinician to include: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Licensed Master Social Worker (LMSW), Advanced Practice Social Worker (APSW), Certified Health Education Specialist (CHES), Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC), Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC), Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT, Doctor of Psychology (PhD or PsyD) or equivalency based on state contract, regulation, or state board licensing mandate. If licensed, license must be active and unrestricted in state of practice.
    • Valid and unrestricted driver's license, reliable transportation, and adequate auto insurance for job related travel requirements, unless otherwise required by law.
    • Experience with working with persons with severe and persistent mental health concerns and serious emotional disturbances, to include substance use disorder and foster care.
    • Knowledge and experience related to whole person care principles, chronic health conditions, and discharge planning coordination.
    • Data entry skills and previous experience utilizing a clinical platform.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Microsoft Office suite/applicable software program(s) proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certified Case Manager (CCM).

  • Experience in behavioral health care management.
    • Field-based care management or home health experience.

    To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.

    Molina Healthcare offers a competitive benefits and compensation package. Molina Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) M/F/D/V

About Pinterest:

At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

About Pinterest

Millions of people across the world come to Pinterest to find new ideas every day. It’s where they get inspiration, dream about new possibilities and plan for what matters most. Our mission is to help those people find their inspiration and create a life they love. As a Pinterest employee, you’ll be challenged to take on work that upholds this mission and pushes Pinterest forward. You’ll grow as a person and leader in your field, all the while helping users make their lives better in the positive corner of the internet.

Our new progressive work model is called PinFlex, a term that’s uniquely Pinterest to describe our flexible approach to living and working. Visit our PinFlex landing page to learn more.

Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Applied Science

As part of Pinterest Labs, you'll work on tackling new challenges in machine learning and artificial intelligence along with a world-class team of research scientists and machine learning engineers. In this role, you will play a central part in transforming how content is discovered on Pinterest by driving the research, architecture, scale and production deployment of Generative Recommendation System (GenRec) and Reinforcement Learning solutions. You will conduct research that directly applies across Pinterest engineering teams, engage in external collaborations and mentoring, and perform research in the intersection of recommendation systems, LLMs, VLMs, and reinforcement learning.

What you’ll do:

  • Contribute to cutting-edge AI/ML research that can be applied to Pinterest challenges across Ads, Discovery, Growth, and Search.
  • Identify, scope, architect, build, and deliver full, novel ML solutions from 0 to 1 at scale. Identify timelines and obtain resources needed.
  • Identify new and upcoming research opportunities by interacting with external and internal collaborators. Own long-term research strategy and plans to expand the impact of Applied Science.
  • Act as a technical leader in the applied AI space. partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to translate complex engineering solutions into product impact.

What we’re looking for:

  • MS/PhD in Computer Science, or equivalent industry experience
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant industry experience
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale recommendation system and reinforcement learning applications; experience with LLM/VLM post-training is a plus
  • Technical leadership and experience in driving ambiguous research problems into production deliverables
  • Publications at top ML conferences (e.g. KDD, NeurIPS, RecSys, etc.)
  • Cross-functional collaborator and strong communicator

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

US based applicants only
$227,871—$469,147 USD

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. About The Role

The Resale Advisor, New Business (LS) drives new business by prospecting and closing leads within an assigned territory in a fully remote, quota-driven sales environment. This role focuses on high-volume outreach, converting marketing-generated leads, and generating new consignor relationships. The LS delivers a strong first-touch client experience, confidently reviews contracts, sets pricing expectations, and maintains disciplined pipeline management to consistently meet performance goals.

What You Get To Do Everyday

  • Prospect new opportunities within assigned territory

  • Follow up and close leads generated by marketing team

  • Leverage strong consignor relationships to gain referrals for new consignors

  • Outreach daily via phone and text (50-100 per day)

  • Provide an outstanding customer experience

  • Review contract with consignors

  • Set pricing expectations through deep knowledge of luxury

What Great Looks Like (Performance)

  • Executes high-volume outreach with consistency and discipline

  • Converts leads effectively

  • Handles objections confidently

  • Maintains CRM hygiene and pipeline visibility

Core Competencies (Baseline)

  • Entrepreneurial drive and ownership mindset

  • Coachability & learning agility

  • High-Volume Outreach Discipline

  • CRM & Pipeline Management Discipline

  • Self-Management & Resilience

What You Bring To The Role

Minimum Requirements:

  • Ability to quickly build rapport with prospective clients and close

  • Proficiency and comfortability using software such as G-Suite, Email, SalesForce, CRM

  • Ability to commit to full-time hours (40 hours per week)

  • Self-motivation and drive to achieve results

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organization skills

  • A solutions-focused mentality with a growth mindset

  • Adaptability and openness to change

  • Professional appearance and demeanor

  • Must be available to work Tuesday through Saturday

Preferred Requirements:

  • Previous experience selling luxury goods and/or services

  • Ability to discuss and advise customers on general fashion trends and developments in the luxury market

Compensation, Benefits, + Perks

  • Base pay plus uncapped commission

  • Annual Elite Club Trip for top performers

  • Monthly sales competitions (i.e. cash | prizes | site credit)

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • 401K with Company Match

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • 9 Paid Company Holidays

About the job

About Us

Patch is defined, more than anything, by the people who work here. We're a diverse team of professional editors and salespeople on a mission to support local businesses and strengthen communities through trusted local content.

Patch started in 2007 and today, is the country's leading local news and information creator, serving more than 1,200 towns across America.

About You

You are a smart, dynamic thinker who is competitive and passionate about sales. As a Local Sales Account Executive, you are enthusiastic about reaching, and exceeding monthly quotas, as well as maintaining a high-level of daily activity to properly maintain a robust pipeline. Our sales team is competitive and energetic, and as a member of the team, you will be eager to grow within the nation’s number one regional site for creating original content.

Responsibilities

  • Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue goals on a consistent basis
  • Manage the full sales-cycle, from setting the meeting to pitching to the close
  • Conducting outbound sales calls to assigned prospects
  • Consistent daily call and email activity that continues to build a plentiful pipeline
  • Focus on being a Patch ambassador while building a rapport with prospects in a transactional sales environment
  • Provide exemplary customer service/relationship management by working with your account manager

Qualifications

Our client is a high-capability federal government contracting firm operating in the defense and civil sectors. The Chief Executive Officer is seeking a grounded, disciplined, and exceptionally sharp Executive Assistant to serve as a high-level force multiplier.

This is not a traditional administrative or task-oriented VA role. You will act as the CEO’s operational proxy—maintaining control, keeping the executive engine running, auditing internal processes, and ensuring project managers and proposal teams execute critical strategy without dropping the ball or relying on superficial answers. You will be responsible for enforcing accountability across key meetings, tracking compliance, and protecting executive bandwidth so the CEO can focus on scaling capital and strategic growth.

  • Team & Time Tracking Audit: Ensure global team members accurately log daily hours and deliverables in Clockify to meet federal compliance standards.

  • Executive Proxy & SOP Maintenance: Maintain operational momentum when the CEO is engaged in investor meetings, while keeping Standard Operating Procedures up to date as the company scales.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Non-Negotiables (Must-Haves):

  • Exceptional Critical Thinking (#1 Requirement): Ability to analyze and synthesize complex technical/RFP documents, quickly separating high-value strategic details from surface-level commentary or filler.

  • Proactive Problem Solver: Takes initiative to bring actionable options and solutions to the table rather than passing open-ended problems back to the CEO.

  • Process & Audit Mindset: Uncompromising attention to detail with zero tolerance for missed deadlines, unlogged hours, or glossed-over requirements.

  • Fluent English Communication: Flawless written and verbal English suitable for direct CEO and executive-level interactions.

🌟 Nice-to-Haves:

  • Federal Contracting & RFP Familiarity: Basic understanding of government bid/proposal workflows (RFPs, task orders, compliance matrices, or working with Subject Matter Experts).

  • AI & Automation Tools: Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for workflow creation, drafting, or operational support.

  • Systems & Workflow Tracking: Familiarity with process frameworks (e.g., RACI/ROSI), performance metrics, or task-based tracking systems.

  • Tool Proficiency: Prior experience using Clockify (tied to task-based time tracking) or Slack/Google Workspace in a fast-paced remote environment.

💻 Tech Stack & Tools

  • AI & LLM Tools: Claude, ChatGPT (used for operational workflow building and custom tools).

  • Time & Expense Tracking: Clockify (tied to gate-step-task tracking and federal audit/DCAA compliance).

raw.excerpt: SummaryAt Design Shopp, we don’t just create visually stunning websites and marketing campaigns—we build meaningful connections, embrace challenges, and foster a culture of innovation.
raw.description:
Summary

At Design Shopp, we don’t just create visually stunning websites and marketing campaigns—we build meaningful connections, embrace challenges, and foster a culture of innovation.

Our international team spans Canada, France, Brazil and the Philippines, with our creative heart in Montreal. We value collaboration, accountability, curiosity, and people who are motivated to continuously improve.

We’re looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Specialist to help manage, optimize, and grow paid digital campaigns across multiple client accounts.

This is not simply a campaign monitoring role. We’re looking for someone who can analyze performance, identify opportunities, recommend next steps, and take ownership of results.

What We Really Value

Performance & Results Mindset

You look beyond impressions, clicks, and surface-level metrics. You understand how campaigns contribute to leads, conversions, revenue, CPA, ROAS, and overall client objectives.

Analytical Thinking

You can interpret campaign data, recognize trends, diagnose performance issues, and turn numbers into clear recommendations and actionable next steps.

Proactive Optimization

You don't wait for someone to tell you what to optimize. You regularly review campaigns, identify opportunities, test improvements, and communicate what you are doing and why.

Ownership & Accountability

You take responsibility for the accounts and tasks assigned to you. You monitor budgets, campaign health, tracking, disapproved ads, and performance—and raise concerns before they become bigger problems.

Clear Communication

You can clearly explain performance, recommendations, and challenges to project managers and other team members. You communicate early when something requires attention.

Collaborative Mindset

You work well with project managers, coordinators, designers, developers, SEO specialists, and other marketers to achieve client goals.

What We're Looking For

We are especially interested in someone who can look at a campaign report and go beyond:

"Conversions increased by 15% this month."

We want someone who can explain:

Why did conversions increase? What changed? What worked? What didn't? What opportunities do you see? What should we test or change next month?

We value specialists who bring recommendations and solutions—not just reports and numbers.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

As our Performance Marketing Specialist, you will:

  • Manage and optimize Google Ads, Meta Ads, Pinterest Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Launch and manage Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, Video, Demand Gen, and paid social campaigns
  • Conduct keyword, audience, competitor, and campaign research
  • Monitor campaign budgets and ensure accounts remain within approved monthly spending
  • Regularly review campaign performance and make optimization decisions
  • Analyze key metrics including CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rate, CPA, CPL, ROAS, and conversion value
  • Identify underperforming campaigns, ads, audiences, keywords, and placements
  • Recommend opportunities to improve campaign performance and efficiency
  • Conduct ongoing A/B testing of ads, audiences, bidding strategies, landing pages, and campaign structures
  • Review search terms, negative keywords, targeting, placements, and audience performance
  • Monitor and address disapproved ads, policy issues, tracking problems, and other account health concerns
  • Support conversion tracking implementation and troubleshooting using Google Tag Manager and GA4
  • Verify that campaign conversions and key events are tracking accurately
  • Review landing-page performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates
  • Prepare clear performance reports that explain not only what happened, but why it happened and what should be done next
  • Provide actionable recommendations, opportunities, and next steps during reporting
  • Stay informed about platform updates, advertising best practices, and new optimization opportunities

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing paid digital advertising campaigns
  • Strong working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager is strongly preferred
  • Experience managing multiple campaigns or client accounts simultaneously
  • Strong understanding of campaign optimization and budget management
  • Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Google Search Console
  • Nice to have Google Data Studio experience
  • Understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, UTM parameters, and digital marketing analytics
  • Comfortable analyzing data and translating it into actionable recommendations
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

- Excellent written and spoken English

  • Ability to work independently while communicating consistently with the team

- Agency experience is an asset

Benefits

Why Join Design Shopp?

  • Work with real client campaigns across multiple industries
  • Manage campaigns across several major advertising platforms
  • Collaborate with an international digital marketing team
  • Opportunity to contribute ideas and recommendations, not just execute tasks
  • Exposure to strategy, analytics, tracking, creative, and conversion optimization
  • Supportive environment that values learning and continuous improvement
  • Opportunity for a long-term working relationship and increased responsibilities based on performance

raw.description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

About the Role

The Pre-Sales Manager (Individual Contributor) is a critical part of Keyloop's revenue organisation, partnering directly with Account Managers and the wider sales team to win, retain, and grow enterprise automotive retail accounts. Operating as a trusted technical and commercial advisor, the Pre-Sales Manager owns the solution narrative from first discovery through to contract signature — leading demonstrations, building business cases, managing proof-of-concept engagements, and positioning Keyloop's Fusion platform compellingly against the market.

This is a senior individual contributor role. The Pre-Sales Manager does not carry a direct quota but is accountable for deal influence, win rate within their aligned territory, and the quality and consistency of the Keyloop buying experience.

Key Responsibilities

    Sales Partnership & Deal Influence

  • Act as co-pilot on strategic opportunities from qualification through to close, challenging poor qualification early and co-owning the deal strategy with the Account Manager.
  • Apply KWoS and MEDDIC frameworks to assess deal health, identify decision criteria, and map the path to signature.
  • Lead the technical and solution track of complex, multi-stakeholder deals across OEM, dealer group, and fleet segments.

    • Discovery & Qualification

  • Conduct structured, insight-led discovery using the SPIN framework — surfacing customer pain, quantifying impact, and connecting needs to Keyloop outcomes.
  • Translate discovery findings into a clear value narrative that anchors the commercial conversation.
  • Qualify technical requirements, integration complexity, and data migration scope to inform accurate solution design.

    • Demo & Presentation Delivery

  • Deliver outcome-led demonstrations of the Fusion platform or individual solutions at a technical level— moving beyond feature walkthroughs to customer-specific business scenarios and measurable outcomes.
  • Tailor presentations and demos to audience level, from operational users to C-suite and board stakeholders.
  • Manage Storylane and demo automation tooling to support scalable, consistent demonstration capability across the team.

    • Business Case & ROI Development

  • Build and present full commercial models that connect Keyloop capability to customer KPIs — including efficiency gains, revenue uplift, cost reduction, and risk mitigation.
  • Lead the ROI conversation at executive level, adapting the narrative for Finance, Operations, and IT stakeholders.
  • Own the written solution response for RFPs and RFIs using Loopio, ensuring accuracy, differentiation, and on-brand positioning.

    • Objection Handling & Competitive Positioning

  • Handle technical and commercial objections confidently — including pricing challenges, integration concerns, and competitive pushback from vendors including Eva/Eva+, CDK, and others.
  • Maintain current competitive intelligence on DMS and platform competitors to position Keyloop's differentiation effectively in live deals.
  • Partner with Product and Marketing to feed deal-level insights back into battlecard and messaging development.

    • Proof of Concept & Pilot Management

  • Design and manage PoC and pilot engagements — defining success criteria with the customer, managing timelines, and presenting outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  • Ensure PoC outcomes are documented and translated into compelling evidence for the broader sales process.

    • Peer Coaching & Team Enablement

  • Share deal learnings, demo best practice, and competitive insights with the wider SE Pre-Sales team.
  • Support onboarding of new Pre-Sales team members and contribute to capability development across the function.
  • Champion consistent use of the SE Engagement Model and Keyloop's Pre-Sales standards.

Skills & Experience

    Essential

  • Proven track record in a Pre-Sales, Solutions Consulting, or Technical Sales role within a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills — ideally trained in SPIN, MEDDIC, or an equivalent structured methodology.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and deliver outcome-led demos and executive-level presentations.
  • Experience building commercial business cases and ROI models for C-suite audiences.
  • Comfortable operating across multi-stakeholder, complex sales cycles of 6–18 months.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; confident presenting at board level.

    • Desirable

  • Experience in the automotive retail sector — understanding of OEM, dealer group, or fleet operations.
  • Familiarity with DMS, retail platform, or automotive technology solutions.
  • Knowledge of Keyloop's Fusion platform or adjacent products (DMS, Service Hub, Sales Hub, Vehicle Hub, AI-AIME).
  • Experience working with RFP/RFI processes and formal procurement cycles.

Why join us?

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

An inclusive environment to thrive

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

Be rewarded for your efforts

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."
