We are seeking a detail-oriented Virtual Med-Legal P&S Report Reviewer to support a physician specializing in California Workers’ Compensation. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing, quality-assuring, and editing Permanent & Stationary (P&S) and supplemental reports to ensure they are complete, internally consistent, accurately documented, and ready for final physician sign-off.

Key Responsibilities:

P&S & Supplemental Report QA (Primary):

  • Verify demographics, claim details, dates of injury, and body parts across report sections.
  • Cross-check injury history, objective exam findings, diagnoses, and narrative descriptions for internal consistency.
  • Review supplemental reports to ensure they address new medical records, questions, or legal issues.
  • Identify and flag missing, conflicting, or incomplete report sections prior to finalization.
  • Proofread medical terminology, spelling, grammar, and ensure adherence to physician formatting templates.

WC Med-Legal Content Auditing:

  • Review core components of P&S reports, including P&S/MMI status, mechanism of injury, accepted vs. disputed body parts, subjective/objective findings, diagnoses, WPI, apportionment, work restrictions, and future medical care.
  • Ensure Whole Person Impairment (WPI) and apportionment entries are clearly documented and consistent.

Medical Records Review & Case Prep:

  • Prepare case fact sheets prior to upcoming examinations.
  • Compare report statements against supporting clinical records (dates, treatment history, diagnostics).
  • Track and request missing medical records, maintain report templates/checklists, and document required corrections.

Requirements

Direct experience reviewing or editing Workers' Compensation med-legal reports (P&S, MMI, or impairment reports from any state).

Strong command of WC terminology, including P&S/MMI, WPI, apportionment, causation, work restrictions, and future medical care.

Working knowledge of the AMA Guides (5th Edition preferred).

Proven track record in clinical documentation review and medical records comparison.

Exceptional written English, medical proofreading skills, attention to detail, and independence.

Please note that this is a full-time contractor position (40 hours per week) with a starting pay rate of $6 per hour depending on skillset and experience. The schedule is Monday through Friday, 8am-5pm PST.

We are looking for a Compliance Officer based in Senegal to join our global team.   • Fluency in French is required; proficiency in English is a significant advantage; knowledge of Wolof or another local language is appreciated.

micro1 is engaging Litigation Attorneys to contribute expertise to a customer's project focused on managing and resolving complex legal disputes. Scope of Work

  1. Analyze legal disputes and develop comprehensive litigation strategies based on case specifics and applicable law.

  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity and precision.
  6. Strong organizational abilities and attention to detail in managing multiple case assignments or deliverables.
  7. Experience providing consultation or training on litigation topics is a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24 – 48 hours of completing onboarding.

Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: asynchronous, estimated 20 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Design and build the projects students work on end to end — scope, learning goals, technical infrastructure, environments, and supporting databases or datasets.
  • Write clear submission guidelines and assessment criteria (rubrics) that reviewers can apply consistently.
  • Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to make projects and lessons educationally sound and engaging: refining wording, pacing, and difficulty calibration across the course.
  • Research, evaluate, and sign off on technical solutions and tooling so the curriculum stays current and relevant to what employers actually use.
  • Contribute to sales and marketing enablement — training commercial teams on what the course covers and what graduates can do.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).
  • Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.
  • Strong written communication in English — you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.
  • Comfort collaborating cross-functionally with instructional design, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring, teaching, tutoring, or reviewing others' code.

Preferred experience:

  • Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Product Analyst (PA) plays a critical role in advancing LifeStance’s patient experience strategy by helping design and deliver product solutions that improve access, engagement, and outcomes across the patient journey. Partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, Clinical Operations, and Data teams, this role translates patient and caregiver needs into actionable product requirements, insights, and delivery support.

This position sits at the intersection of product development and patient experience, contributing directly to initiatives that enhance patient access (e.g., scheduling, intake), engagement (e.g., digital touchpoints, communication), and continuity of care. The Product Analyst ensures that product decisions are grounded in data, informed by real patient workflows and behaviors, and aligned to measurable outcomes such as access, satisfaction, and care quality.

Success in this role means enabling teams to deliver intuitive, scalable, and compliant digital experiences that make it easier for patients to find, access, and stay engaged in care—while supporting LifeStance’s broader mission to improve access to high-quality mental healthcare.

    • Query and analyze EHR, operational, and engagement data to inform product decisions

    • Partner with Data/BI teams to define and validate KPIs tied to product performance

  • Subject Matter Expertise

    • Develop working knowledge of patient workflows (e.g., scheduling, documentation, billing, care coordination)

    • Participate in workflow observation, user interviews, and stakeholder discovery sessions

  • Collaboration & Delivery Support

    • Act as a liaison between Engineering, Clinical Operations, Compliance, and IT

    • Support agile ceremonies (backlog grooming, sprint planning, retrospectives)

    • Track and communicate dependencies, risks, and action items across workstreams

  • Documentation & Communication

    • Maintain product documentation (process maps, decision logs, data dictionaries, system diagrams)

We hold long-standing, leading market positions in many of the markets we serve. The underwriting organization is responsible for underwriting new life applications with a focus on delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Underwriting team members provide medical and financial risk assessment on applications for individual life insurance applications.

The primary responsibility of the Director, Life Underwriting is to accurately assess medical and financial risk, protecting the mortality results of the organization while also supporting sales. Underwriting team members interact frequently with our customers and therefore the role requires a customer centric and relationship focused attitude, excellent communication skills as well as accountability for accurate and prompt processing.

• Underwrite complex formal applications and informal quote applications with the ability to evaluate and take final action in an independent manner within approval authority guidelines.

• Able to take a cross-functional view of work processes and understand the ramifications to other areas of actions taken and decisions made.

Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.


Job Description

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

THE OPPORTUNITY

Silvus is seeking aSenior Business Development Engineer, US Armywho will report to the Director of Applications Engineering on the Applications Engineering team. The successful individual in this role will work closely with the Engineering and Business Development teams to provide US Army acquisition stakeholders with tailored solutions to meet their needs. The primary focus of this role is to be forward-looking: The successful individual in this role will leverage deep technical expertise in Software-Defined Radios (SDRs), emerging industry solutions, and tactical network architectures to translate Army operational requirements into winnable technical solutions. This individual is responsible for demonstrating the technical superiority, interoperability, and field-readiness of our tactical communications portfolio to Army evaluation teams. This opportunity is well-suited to a forward-thinking technologist who enjoys interacting with customers, thinking outside of the box to solve emerging issues, and enjoys traveling; up to 50% of the time for meetings, events, and demonstrations.

This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyze US Army Capability Set requirements and Mission Command network design goals to map operational gaps to our tactical radio capabilities.

  • Conduct market research to identify full product solutions and synergies with emerging industry partners, collaborating with the Applications Engineering team to test and evaluate these end-to-end architectures.

  • Design and build high-impact, "art-of-the-possible" demonstrations tailored to the unique operational needs of the Army, highlighting future tactical edge network possibilities.

  • Lead the technical planning, network configuration, and live-on-the-air execution of field trials, modernizations, and user evaluations in conjunction with the BD and Applications Engineering teams.

  • Collaborate with the Applications Engineering team to leverage continuous large-scale testing and competitive benchmarking data, ensuring all proposed architectures are structurally sound and unassailable.

  • Partner with the Business Development team to engage early with Army program managers, Science and Technology (S&T) leads, and warfare centers to write advanced technology capabilities into upcoming 3-to-5-year program requirements.

  • Remain closely aligned with the Business Development team, setting strategic priorities and supporting their technical needs.

  • Serve as the technical anchor for the RFI/RFP response team, providing strategic technical direction, defining nuanced product capabilities, and performing expert reviews to ensure proposal accuracy and alignment.

  • Build trusted-advisor relationships with Chief Engineers, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical evaluators across the Army.

  • Act as the internal voice of the soldier, translating complex Army field feedback and emerging requirements into actionable product roadmaps, and actively track engineering progress to ensure the final deliverables precisely meet the soldier's operational needs.

  • Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.

  • Travel Requirement – 50%; frequent travel for meetings, events, and demonstrations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related C5ISR technical field with at least 5 years of demonstrated experience in systems engineering, technical business development, or forward-looking defense technology roles; OR High School Diploma/GED with at least 9 years of relevant experience.

  • Minimum of 5 years of engineering experience working directly with Software-Defined Radios (SDRs), IP-based tactical routing protocols, and tactical communication systems.

  • Strong knowledge of US Army tactical procurement pathways and the network modernization priorities outlined by the Army Futures Command.

  • Proficiency with radio frequency instruments such as signal generators and spectrum analyzers.

  • Willingness to travel frequently (50%) to customer sites, DoD research laboratories, and strategic field-testing environments.

  • Security Clearance: Active U.S. Government SECRET clearance or the ability to obtain one within 15 months of hire.

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen due to clients under U.S. government contracts.

  • All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted-advisor relationships with DoD technical stakeholders and translate complex operational capability gaps into engineering roadmaps.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the proven ability to author technical white papers and deliver compelling "art-of-the-possible" presentations to senior military leadership.

  • Advanced proficiency with TCP/IP protocols, tactical networking architectures, and Linux environments.

  • Deep knowledge of wireless communication systems, radio frequency signal propagation, and digital communication technologies.

  • Proficiency with programming or scripting languages (such as C/C++ or Python) to assist in rapid prototyping and test automation.

  • Demonstrated success operating autonomously in a 100% remote environment, with a proven ability to self-manage long-term strategic initiatives and seamlessly collaborate with distributed, cross-functional teams (including R&D, Product Management, and Sales).

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Conferences, technical symposiums, and trade shows.

  • Outdoor environment for large-scale field trials and tactical demonstrations.

  • Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in rugged field environments.

Department Overview

Hyper, a Motorola Solutions Company, a leader in conversational, agentic AI designed to reduce the burden on understaffed public safety answering points (PSAPs) by handling non-emergency calls. It is revolutionizing emergency response systems through cutting-edge AI technologies. Our first product is reducing 911 wait times by alleviating administrative work from highly trained 911 telecommunicators.


Job Description

We’re looking for a Sr Software Engineer to set technical direction for the AI Agent Platform team behind Hyper’s emergency response products (Motorola Solutions announced that it acquired Hyper on April 9, 2026).

You’ll be a senior technical leader responsible for the architecture of our most critical systems. You’ll shape long-term technical strategy, mentor engineers across the team, and own the toughest cross-cutting problems — from real-time AI pipelines and telephony to backend infrastructure and product surfaces. We expect engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships — and as a Sr Engineer, you set the bar for what “good” looks like.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design and operation of real-time voice AI systems that support human 911 telecommunicators at scale.

  • Identify and solve the hardest problems in our stack: low-latency audio, streaming, telephony, LLM orchestration, and human-in-the-loop AI workflows.

  • Drive engineering excellence across reliability, availability, security, and performance — defining the standards the team operates by.

  • Partner with product, design, and operations leadership to translate ambiguous customer and operational problems into technical strategy.

  • Mentor engineers; raise the floor and the ceiling of the team’s technical work through reviews, design feedback, and pairing.

  • Build and evolve evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks for AI-assisted systems.

  • Lead incident response and post-incident reviews; own runbook quality and on-call health for the systems the team is responsible for.

  • Represent engineering in conversations with public safety customers, partners, and Motorola Solutions stakeholders when deep technical credibility is required.

You Might Be a Fit If

  • You have production software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership.

  • You’ve designed, shipped, and operated large, complex systems in high-stakes domains

  • You are comfortable working across backend, infrastructure, AI pipelines, and product surfaces.

  • You can turn ambiguous product or operational problems into clear technical plans for the team.

  • You use AI tools daily, but you set the standard for how your team uses them responsibly — speed without compromising quality.

  • You raise the engineering bar around tests, observability, code review, security, and clean abstractions.

  • You mentor effectively. Engineers around you get better because of how you work.

  • You have strong product judgment and care deeply about the humans using what you build.

  • You thrive in a small, fast-moving team with high ownership and low ego, and you can scale that culture as we grow.

  • You want to work on AI systems that matter beyond demos.

Relevant Experience

We do not expect every candidate to have all of these. We care more about strong engineering judgment, learning velocity, and ownership than exact keyword matches.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Architecting LLM, agentic, or RAG systems in production, including evals and prompt test harnesses at scale.

  • Deep expertise in Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Voice Activity Detection, endpointing, interruption handling, noise filtering, diarization, or audio streaming.

  • Telephony and voice infrastructure: PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.

  • Real-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low-latency audio transport — including operating these systems under production load.

  • Real-time, concurrent, or distributed systems using Elixir, Go, Python, Rust or similar languages.

  • PostgreSQL and strong data modeling fundamentals at scale.

  • Cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Containerized application environments operated in production.

  • Technical leadership in public safety, govtech, healthcare, defense, infrastructure, fintech, or other high-trust domains.


Basic Requirements

7+ years of experience in Realtime communication systems with deep expertise in Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Voice Activity Detection and architecting LLM, agentic, or RAG systems in production, including evals and prompt test harnesses at scale.

Under 10%

Does the idea of working for an established company with a start-up culture excite you? Is being on a diverse team with a focus on work life balance important to you? Are you a self-starter eager to make a name for yourself in a fast growing company that rewards good ideas? If you answered yes to these questions, NielsenIQ may be the company for you.

NielsenIQ is seeking a talented Pre-Sales Enablement Specialist to play a key role in enabling sellers to be more efficient and stay focused on winning business. Reporting to Pre-Sales Enablement Manager or Director, this role will work with cross functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Product, Customer Success) to identify and manage the right mix of tools and processes to move opportunities to close faster.

An ideal candidate is a proactive, deadline driven task manager with an eye for process improvement and establishing new processes. You are motivated by making an impact on your workplace and thrive on recognizing a challenge, implementing a solution, monitoring success and continuously thinking outside the box to optimize new or existing processes. You have desire to help sellers succeed and your team members develop. Must be passionate about ensuring a positive customer experience and understand how to personalize messaging to ensure buyers have the right information at the right time to make decisions quickly and confidently. The ideal candidate is detail oriented with excellent communication, active listening and time management skills with familiarity with the sales process.

  • Successfully manage and execute independent Pre-Sales activities to priority business group(s) and accommodating non-primary teams where applicable.

  • Become familiar in all critical support areas bound by SLA coverage, working as a cross-functional business partner being able to accommodate various account-based non-specialty requests for multiple business verticals.

  • Engage with pilot program opportunities where/when applicable to evangelize the Pre-Sales Enablement team offerings to unsupported teams.

  • Become an SME in specific Pre-Sales Enablement team offering(s) and NielsenIQ product/solution(s).

  • Serve as an expert on internal sales processes and CRM utilization to guide sellers on best practices and ensure adherence. Work to become proficient in all RMS services (Discover, Byzzer, Data Analysis) and stay up-to-date on best practices using the tools effectively.

  • Utilize reports to identify bottlenecks in the sales cycle and alert sellers of at-risk opportunities, highly skilled at leveraging CRM for pricing, contracting, and process efficiency and project tracking. Work to become a Pre-Sales SME with Revenue Intelligence for BI reporting and forecasting.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve the sales process, resolve inconsistencies and give insightful feedback to cross functional stakeholders in an effort to improve efficiency across the sales cycle.

Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of related work experience in Sales or Sales Operations, Bachelor’s degree required

  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically through identification of problems and implement successful, tactical solutions

  • Self-motivated with a strong attention to detail and keen ability to prioritize tasks to ensure business critical objectives are met

  • Skilled at building strong working relationships with team members in varying departments and/or levels of management

  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines

  • Understanding of the sales cycle and common pain points sellers encounter with a desire to drive improvements

  • Experience building and / or using sales performance reporting in a CRM, PowerBI or similar software

  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening skills

  • Prior exposure to SaaS technology

  • Ability to drive productivity working in a remote, fast paced environment

raw.description:
We are seeking two dependable, experienced Patient Care Coordinatorsto join our clinical team as Biopsy Care Coordinators (2 Slots Available). In this vital patient-care role, you will lead biopsy follow-up communications—reviewing lab results, delivering clear clinical information to patients, and providing compassionate guidance.

The ideal candidates possess outstanding English communication skills with minimal-to-no accent, strong clinical judgment, and prior experience in dermatology or outpatient procedures.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Openings: 2 Slots Available
  • Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (US Eastern Standard Time)
  • Camera-On Shift Requirement: Agreement and ability to maintain an active, camera-on presence throughout the entire 8-hour shift—required for efficiency, real-time communication, and seamless collaboration with the team of virtual assistants supporting the practice.

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  1. Lab & Pathology Review: Review incoming biopsy reports and diagnostic lab results for accuracy and clinical urgency.
  2. Patient Results Outreach: Conduct outbound patient calls to clearly communicate test results and answer clinical questions.
  3. Care Coordination: Document call outcomes in the EMR, schedule necessary follow-up care, and escalate complex findings to the provider.

Core Responsibilities

  • Perform daily audits of incoming pathology and biopsy lab reports.
  • Contact patients via phone to deliver lab results, explain clinical next steps, and provide reassurance.
  • Document all clinical interactions, test results, and care plans accurately within the EMR system.
  • Coordinate with clinical providers regarding abnormal or urgent biopsy findings.

Requirements

  • Licensure: Active USRN License (Highly Preffered)
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal English skills with clear, neutral pronunciation (no accent) for seamless patient phone interactions.
  • Clinical Background: Previous experience in Dermatology, outpatient surgery, or clinical triage preferred.
  • EMR Experience: Hands-on experience with ModMed (EMA) or a similar specialty EMR is a strong plus.
  • Remote Setup: HIPAA-compliant private workspace, quiet environment, reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a clear headset.
  • Camera & Team Presence: Commitment to maintaining an active camera-on presence for the full 8-hour shift to collaborate with the team.

raw.description:
Faculty, Teacher of an Indigenous Language (TIL) Program

Position Type: Contract

Position Status: New Position

Location: Remote, with potential for in-person delivery

Reports To: Dean, FNTI Programs

Hourly Rate: $50.00/hour ($48.08 plus 4% vacation pay) for 140 instructional hours; a total compensation of $7,000 per course

About FNTI (First Nations Technical Institute)

Established in 1985, First Nations Technical Institute (FNTI) is an Indigenous-owned and governed post-secondary institution accredited by the Indigenous Advanced Education and Skills Council (IAESC). Operating from Tyendinaga on the Bay of Quinte and virtually, FNTI delivers community-driven programs grounded in Indigenous knowledge, connecting learners to their communities while pursuing meaningful education.

Position Summary

Under the direction of the Dean, FNTI Programs, the Faculty Member plays a key role in teaching and knowledge dissemination; providing cultural support to learners; and contributing to administration, coordination, research, and community engagement. In all aspects of program development and delivery, the Faculty Member will privilege Indigenous Knowledge, Indigenous languages, and Indigenous ways of knowing and being.

The Faculty Member is responsible for meeting expectations across all phases of delivery, including orientation, preparation, instruction, learner support, assessment, and program evaluation. The successful candidate will support the preparation and development of Indigenous language teachers and language revitalization initiatives while ensuring culturally grounded and learner-centered educational experiences.

The Faculty Member supports the Institute's strategic priorities and adheres to the Values, Mission, and Vision of FNTI.

Key Responsibilities

Teaching, Program Development & Quality Assurance

Curriculum & Outcomes

  • Develop curriculum that supports vocational, course, and Indigenous learning outcomes and responds to learner needs.
  • Support learners in developing competencies related to Indigenous language acquisition, language teaching methodologies, curriculum development, and language revitalization.
  • Design and implement teaching and assessment strategies that align with program outcomes.
  • Ensure Indigenous language, culture, knowledge systems, and community perspectives are appropriately integrated throughout program delivery.

Instruction & Delivery

  • Prepare, instruct, and deliver courses within a cultural framework, adhering to FNTI's "braided healing with learning" approach.
  • Incorporate Indigenous pedagogies, worldviews, and ways of knowing and being into course planning and delivery.
  • Deliver 45 total contact hours over the course cycle, ensuring learner engagement through a mix of synchronous and asynchronous activities.
  • Provide academic support and mentorship to learners throughout their studies.
  • Evaluate learner progress and achievement and maintain
    accurate academic records.
  • Be responsible for the overall assessment of learner work within assigned courses

Cultural Framework & Protocols

  • Facilitate space for Indigenous language use, cultural teachings, medicines, and traditional practices within the learning environment.
  • Collaborate with Cultural Advisors, Elders, Knowledge Keepers, and community members to support Indigenous learning outcomes.
  • Implement appropriate Indigenous protocols and cultural practices within the classroom.
  • Ensure Indigenous Pedagogy and Andragogy practices are integrated wherever possible.

Learner Support

  • Provide culturally responsive academic support and mentorship.
  • Monitor learner progress and connect learners with appropriate supports and resources.
  • Provide ongoing support throughout the 4-week cycle, including up to 6 office hours over the 45-hour course (outside instructional hours) for additional academic assistance.
  • Foster a positive learning environment that promotes learner engagement, success, and well-being.
  • Participate in learner follow-up and retention initiatives as required.

Administration & Coordination

  • Support program implementation planning, admissions processes, and program evaluations.
  • Utilize the Learning Management System (LMS) for course delivery, learner communication, and instructional materials.
  • Participate in program development, delivery, assessment, and revision activities with faculty, staff, students, alumni, community organizations, and Knowledge Keepers.
  • Attend faculty meetings, program meetings, and cross-functional team meetings as required.
  • Debriefing/Program Evaluation: Following instructional activities and/or throughout the semester/academic year, participate in debriefing/program evaluation sessions with the teaching team and program leadership to review outcomes, address challenges, and contribute to ongoing course and program development.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in education, Indigenous Education, Language Education, Linguistics, Indigenous Studies, or a closely related field.
  • Member in good standing with the Ontario College of Teachers (OCT), or eligible for OCT membership.
  • Minimum five (5) years of successful teaching experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Indigenous learners, communities, and/or language revitalization initiatives.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Indigenous histories, cultures, languages, and communities.
  • Experience in delivering high-quality teaching and curriculum development at the post-secondary level is considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of Indigenous language acquisition, immersion methodologies, language revitalization practices, and culturally responsive teaching approaches is preferred.

Other Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to perform in a complex, fast-paced environment while maintaining a high degree of confidentiality.
  • Strong leadership skills in educational settings.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with Indigenous communities and organizations.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships in cross-cultural settings.
  • Familiarity with online learning platforms and educational technology.
  • Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours when required.

Conditions of Employment

  • Participation in FNTI orientation and faculty onboarding activities.
  • Participation in mandatory faculty and program meetings.
  • Participation in FNTI's Wise Practices training and other required professional learning opportunities.
  • Willing and able to travel occasionally and work overtime as required.
  • Successful candidates must provide a satisfactory Vulnerable Sector Check
  • Must be legally entitled to work in Ontario, Canada

Equity, Inclusion & Accessibility

FNTI is an inclusive employer. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and the Ontario Human Rights Code (OHRC), applicants may request accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process.

To request accommodation during the application process, please contact with the job title and accommodation details.

FNTI provides preference to qualified applicants of Indigenous ancestry who self-identify.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to apply by submitting:

  • A cover letter outlining interest and qualification
  • A current resume
  • Proof of Ontario College of Teachers membership or eligibility

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Posting Date:

October 14, 2026

Application Deadline:

Open until Filled

Salary: $48.08 plus 4% vacation pay

raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Customer experience:

Customer experience at Nebius AI Cloud involves tackling customers’ challenges and directly impacting their success by solving real-world AI and ML problems at massive GPU cloud scale. You’ll not only resolve issues, but play a key role in shaping clients’ business success by optimizing their AI solutions. Working with advanced GPUs such as H200, B200 and GB200, as well as modern ML frameworks, you’ll influence the development of the Nebius AI Cloud and gain experience at the intersection of infrastructure and AI. With minimal bureaucracy, you’ll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership and drive change. Opportunities for growth are abundant in this vibrant and supportive professional community.

The role

We are looking for a Partner Solutions Architect to serve as the technical interface between Nebius and our strategic technology partners, ranging from data platforms and MLOps vendors to AI frameworks and ISVs that build on GPU infrastructure.

This is a hands-on engineering and integration role. You will design and develop integrated solutions, build reference implementations, enable partner engineering teams, and ensure joint customers succeed with combined offerings. You will influence Nebius’ product roadmap and drive deep technical collaboration across partner ecosystems.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the Canada.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the technical relationship with strategic partners as the primary interface to Nebius engineering and product
  • Design and architect high-impact integration solutions, delivering clear joint customer value
  • Build and maintain reference implementations and production-grade integrations
  • Define enterprise-ready integration patterns (networking, security, compliance, observability)
  • Translate partner and customer feedback into actionable product and roadmap requirements
  • Enable partner teams through technical documentation, training, and demo environments
  • Provide technical leadership in joint customer deployments, architecture reviews, and complex troubleshooting

We expect you to have:

  • 5 - 10 + years in solutions architecture, partner engineering, or technical pre-sales at cloud or data platform companies
  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Deep cloud infrastructure expertise, with specialist experience in large-scale Kubernetes deployments and containerized environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, especially Terraform
  • Hands-on experience deploying production AI workloads, particularly inference, and architecting or implementing agentic solutions
  • Proven background in integration architecture, including API design, data pipelines, security, and observability, with experience in Python
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with HPC environments and large-scale GPU clusters
  • Hands-on experience across the ML lifecycle, including training, fine-tuning, and RAG
  • Practical experience building AI agents, particularly with LangChain
  • Experience with partner technical programs, major cloud or data platforms, or enterprise compliance standards
  • Deep understanding of advanced Kubernetes infrastructure concepts beyond the abstraction of managed Kubernetes services.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

On Target Earnings Range

$235k - $300k CAD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

Intro

Solving the most complex technology and business challenges is what Appficiency is about. As the top partner for creating the new industry benchmarks in the ERP Services, Appficiency is an Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner with over 7 different industry and partner awards. We are a leader in both construction and manufacturing and as a top 5 Alliance Partner, we go to work each day solving the hardest industry problems and sharing these news-worthy achievements to set a higher bar for the professional services and software industry.

The Value

At Appficiency, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We invest in continuous learning, career development, and opportunities to innovate and lead. Our culture is built on integrity, collaboration, and growth, empowering individuals to contribute meaningfully while expanding their expertise.

As part of our global organization, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with international teams and clients, supporting initiatives that drive both regional and global success.

The Grind

We operate at the intersection of business and technology, requiring curiosity, analytical thinking, and a strong sense of ownership. As a Sales Operations Analyst, you will play a critical role in enabling the sales organization through data, process optimization, and operational support.

You will work across sales, marketing, and delivery teams, supporting opportunities of varying sizes and complexity while helping drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in our sales processes.

The Talent

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Sales Operations Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

You bring strong organizational skills, a passion for improving processes, and the ability to translate data into actionable insights that support revenue growth and operational excellence.

The Commitment

  • Provide actionable insights on sales performance, pipeline health, and conversion trends to drive revenue growth.
  • Track and report monthly conversion rates, pipeline progression, and key sales metrics.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support Sales, Marketing, and Delivery teams.
  • Serve as the primary administrator for NetSuite CRM, ensuring data accuracy, system integrity, and process adherence.
  • Design and enhance NetSuite dashboards and reporting frameworks to improve visibility and decision-making.
  • Implement and maintain lead tracking systems to measure marketing performance and campaign effectiveness.
  • Monitor sales pipeline activity and forecast accuracy, ensuring proper stage progression and data hygiene.
  • Track 100% of inbound inquiries and sales activities, ensuring accurate data capture and reporting.
  • Support knowledge transfer from sales to delivery teams, ensuring smooth transitions and complete documentation.
  • Assist in the preparation of proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and client-facing materials, ensuring accuracy and alignment with client requirements.
  • Support the creation and validation of “As Sold” documentation, ensuring completeness of scope, pricing, and supporting analysis where required.
  • Coordinate with sales, consulting, and technical teams to gather inputs for proposals and solution documentation.
  • Accurately calculate and manage sales commissions and incentive programs, including bonuses for the Software Strategy team.
  • Ensure timely and transparent reporting of compensation metrics and payouts.
  • Support sales enablement initiatives, tools, and content to improve team effectiveness.
  • Assist in managing client testimonials and reviews, targeting consistent monthly acquisition.
  • Collaborate with marketing to analyze campaign performance and optimize lead generation efforts

The Essentials

  • Bachelor's degree in business, data analytics, finance, marketing or a related field.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, external partners, and customers.
  • Possess strong skills in critical thinking, analytical thinking, problem-solving, data analysis, and strategic planning.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluency with Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) and Google Sheets
  • Proficiency with CRM, ERP, and database software
  • Knowledge of NetSuite products and services is a plus.

The Add-Ons

  • Experience with NetSuite or within the NetSuite partner community
  • We are a global company, so international experience is a plus
  • Thrives in an entrepreneurial environment where personal drive and judgment need to be exercised daily
  • Experience working closely with C-suite and executive leadership
  • Bonus points: enjoys hard work and harder play

Description

We're looking for a Social Media Manager who plays guitar and lives and breathes music culture to own our voice across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook, and Reddit — turning Ultimate Guitar's massive, passionate community of players and fans into an even bigger, louder one.

We are actively integrating AI automation into relevant areas of the business and expect candidates with mindset focused on improving efficiency and deliver a better user experience. Regarding this role, we encourage AI-use to ideate or refine final pieces, but not generate content from scratch.

﻿What's in it for you?

You'll be the voice of one of the world's biggest platforms for guitarists and musicians, working directly with product owners on campaigns that reach a global community of players. It's a role built for someone who wants to shape culture, not just schedule posts — with an AI-native toolkit designed to speed up the busywork so you can spend more time on strategy and creative.

Key responsibilities

  • Own Ultimate Guitar social strategy and execution across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook and Reddit
  • Create, adapt and schedule content per platform, in Ultimate Guitar brand voice
  • Build and maintain channel strategy per platform, in collaboration with the Ultimate Guitar Product Owner, continuing the Q3/Q4 IG + TikTok growth plan
  • Support GTM campaigns with Product Owner's and stakeholders, from brief to published social
  • Manage community engagement and moderation across Ultimate Guitar channels; escalate sensitive issues
  • Secure music licensing and rights clearance before publishing
  • Run social listening and react to trends and community sentiment in real time
  • Report on engagement, channel growth and campaign ROI; establish UTM tracking + keep it clean and consistent
  • Provide interim AU/ social coverage until the net-new SoMe Manager is hired
  • Use the team's AI stack (Claude, Coda, Jitter, Metricool, Later) to speed ideation, scheduling and reporting

Requirements

  • 4–5 years managing brand social across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook and Reddit
  • Short-form video literacy (concepting and light editing); full video production if we keep that scope
  • Strong copywriting and the ability to flex tone by platform and product
  • Community management, including moderation and de-escalation
  • Fluency in music, guitar and creator culture (the UG audience is players and fans, not a generic consumer)
  • Analytics: native platform analytics plus Metricool / Later; comfortable with UTM tracking
  • AI-native workflow: Claude, Coda or equivalent as a default, not an occasional tool
  • Awareness of music licensing and rights clearance
  • Fluent written and spoken English (B2+)

Nice to have:

  • Paid Social experience
  • Video production/editing experience

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Regional Director, Enterprise Sales for the Southeastern United States, you'll lead a team of Strategic Account Executives and own software sales, bookings, and revenue across the region. You'll help new and existing customers adopt GitLab's AI-powered platform for software development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk.

Reporting to the AVP, East, you'll hire and develop sales talent, set territory and industry strategies, and align your team's sales plans with GitLab's growth goals. In your first year, you'll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening customer relationships across the Southeast, and meeting or exceeding performance objectives.

GitLab is an open core software company. Our mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.

This role is fully remote and will be based in the Southeast, US.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop Strategic Account Executives serving the Southeastern US to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results.
  • Build and execute territory and industry plans based on market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive trends.
  • Establish a sales operating rhythm with clear qualification standards, pipeline hygiene, deal inspection, and accurate forecasts.
  • Own sales forecasts, territory management plans, and regional growth strategies aligned with GitLab's revenue goals.
  • Track and report on team performance metrics, addressing gaps through coaching and changes to regional plans.
  • Partner with Renewals, Marketing, and Sales Operations to manage pipeline health, renewal performance, and deal execution.
  • Recruit, hire, and onboard sales talent, and maintain a pipeline of potential future hires in the region.
  • Build an inclusive team culture through regular coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing development.
  • Enable your team on GitLab's product, pricing, AI-powered DevSecOps positioning, and industry and regulatory factors relevant to US markets.

What you'll bring

  • Progressive experience in field sales and sales operations in open source software, DevOps, or a similar software-as-a-service environment. We welcome transferable leadership and regional sales experience from adjacent software markets.
  • Success leading and developing account-focused sales teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding revenue, pipeline, and other sales performance objectives.
  • Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies, with a willingness to lead your team and participate directly in selling.
  • Commercial and analytical skills to interpret sales performance, market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics, and use those insights to improve regional plans.
  • Practical experience using customer relationship management (CRM) and sales and marketing tools, such as Salesforce, Clari, or Marketo, to manage forecasts, territories, and pipeline.

About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Job Summary

Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is building the industry’s most trusted, scalable, and fan-centric sportsbook experience. Our Internal Platforms power critical systems that support customer operations, marketing, support, risk, and data—through a combination of Java backend services, APIs, event-driven systems, and Salesforce platform capabilities.

We are seeking a Senior Java Software Engineer to build and maintain scalable services that power our internal platforms. This role is full stack focused, with opportunities to contribute to user-facing internal tools as needed.

Experience with Salesforce development and integrations is a strong plus, as many of our systems interface directly with Salesforce for CRM, workflow automation, and customer operations. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys owning features end-to-end, solving complex integration problems, and working closely with cross-functional partners.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Engineering (Primary Focus)

  • Design, build, and maintain Java-based backend services (Spring Boot or similar frameworks).
  • Develop scalable, reliable, and well-tested services that integrate with Salesforce and other internal/external systems.
  • Participate in architecture and design discussions for APIs, data flows, and distributed systems.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable code with strong unit and integration test coverage.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across services, integrations, and data pipelines.
  • Contribute to internal web applications and user interfaces backed by Java services.

Internal UI & Application Development (Nice to Have / Secondary)

  • Collaborate with frontend or full-stack engineers to support internal users across Operations, Support, Marketing, Risk, and Data teams.
  • Partner with Product and UX (where applicable) to translate workflows into intuitive internal tools.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to define clean API contracts between UI layers and services.
  • UI technologies may include Java-backed web apps, REST-driven front ends, or modern JavaScript frameworks consuming Java APIs.

Note: This role does not require deep UI specialization, but comfort collaborating across UI and backend boundaries is valued.

Salesforce & CRM Platform Integration (Secondary Focus)

  • Build and maintain integrations between Java services and Salesforce using REST APIs, events, or middleware.
  • Contribute to Salesforce development when needed, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and configuration.
  • Partner with Salesforce-focused engineers to ensure clean integration patterns, data integrity, and platform scalability.
  • Help troubleshoot Salesforce-related issues tied to backend services, UI workflows, or integrations.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, and cross-functional partners to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Operations, Support, Risk, and Data teams to ensure systems meet business and regulatory needs.
  • Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and delivery, ensuring predictable and high-quality outcomes.
  • Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and implementation details clearly to stakeholders.

Operational Excellence & Best Practices

  • Follow and help improve engineering best practices including CI/CD, code reviews, testing strategies, and observability.
  • Ensure services are performant, observable, and resilient, with appropriate logging, metrics, and alerting.
  • Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and long-term platform improvements.
  • Identify technical debt and propose pragmatic solutions.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience with Java.
  • Strong experience building backend services in a production environment.
  • Experience developing APIs and integrating services with other systems.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, data flows, and service-to-service communication.
  • Experience with Git-based workflows, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently on complex systems.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred

  • Experience contributing to internal web UIs or tooling, including:
    • Java-baced web frameworks, and/or
    • Modern front-end frameworks consuming Java APIs (React, Angular, etc.)
  • Experience working with Salesforce as an integration partner or platform:
    • Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, or Salesforce APIs
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with Java-based services.
  • Experience with:
    • Event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar)
    • Cloud environments (AWS preferred)
    • Highly available or regulated systems (gaming, fintech, payments)
  • Experience working with AI model or agent platforms, including building on or integrating agents into production workflows. Familiarity with platforms such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LangChain, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, CrewAI, or AutoGen is a plus.
  • Familiarity using AI-powered coding assistants to design, build, and test new functionality from the ground up, with the ability to move quickly while maintaining high code quality and test coverage.
  • Interest in leveraging emerging tools and workflows to improve developer productivity and platform throughput.
  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Developer) are a plus, but not required.

What We Value

  • Passion for building high-quality internal platforms that directly impact business outcomes.
  • Strong ownership mindset and commitment to engineering excellence.
  • Collaborative approach and desire to continuously learn and improve.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

raw.description:
Holman is a family-owned, global automotive services organization anchored by our deeply rooted core values and principles that have enabled us to continue Driving What’s Right throughout the last century. Our teams deliver the Holman Experience by treating our customers and each other as we would like to be treated, and creating positive, rewarding relationships all around.

The automotive markets Holman serves include fleet management and leasing; vehicle fabrication and upfitting; component manufacturing and productivity solutions; powertrain distribution and logistics services; commercial and personal insurance and risk management; and retail automotive sales as one of the largest privately owned dealership groups in the United States.

Holman is looking for a Security Engineer to work where cloud infrastructure and software development meet. You will review and design security architecture for our cloud environments, maintain our application security tooling, and work directly with development teams to threat model applications and find and fix vulnerabilities. You will also perform third-party vendor security reviews, support our work with external penetration testing partners, help secure our growing use of AI, and take part in incident response as part of the broader security team.


Principal Purpose of Position

Security Engineering

  • Review cloud security solutions and contribute to secure architecture designs for Azure and AWS environments, turning business requirements into practical security controls.
  • Provide security architecture guidance and design patterns to Infrastructure, Cloud, and Development teams.
  • Build, deploy, and maintain security infrastructure as code with Terraform, Terragrunt, ARM, and Bicep, so that controls stay consistent, version-controlled, and repeatable.
  • Perform third-party vendor security reviews: assess vendor architecture, controls, and risk, document findings, and recommend mitigations or acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to the security architecture and operation of enterprise AI platforms, including MCP gateways, LLM routers, and AI gateways. This covers access control and tool permissions, prompt injection and data leakage risks, AI usage and cost governance (FinOps), and observability and logging of AI activity.
  • Keep documentation of security controls, configurations, architecture decisions, and procedures accurate and current.

Software Security

  • Perform threat modeling with development teams on new and existing applications, and work with developers to understand vulnerabilities and architectural security issues, supporting remediation through to verified closure.
  • Support the IAM team on cloud and application identity security, including workload and managed identities, service principals, least-privilege role design, secrets handling, and application authentication and authorization patterns.
  • Administer and maintain application and cloud security tooling, including cloud security posture, runtime application security, and API security testing platforms. This covers configuration, tuning, integrations, and keeping findings accurate.
  • Help integrate security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows.
  • Work with third-party penetration testing providers to support scoping, ongoing attack surface assessment, results triage, and remediation tracking.
  • Report vulnerability exposure, remediation status, and risk to application owners and management.

Incident Response & General

  • Participate in incident response activities, contributing cloud and application security expertise to investigation, containment, and remediation.
  • Lead specific initiatives or workstreams when delegated.
  • Share knowledge with peers and developers on secure design and coding practices.
  • Stay current on cloud and application threats, attack techniques, and security technologies, and recommend improvements to Holman's security posture.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Relevant Work Experience

  • 5–7 years of combined information security and technical engineering experience, with significant time in cloud security, application security, or both.
  • Strong experience securing Microsoft Azure and Amazon AWS environments in cloud-native and hybrid architectures.
  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining infrastructure as code with Terraform (Terragrunt a plus), ARM, and/or Bicep.
  • Ability to read and reason about application code in at least one of .NET, Python, Ruby, or Node.js, well enough to explain a vulnerability and its fix to a developer.
  • Strong working knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE), and secure software development practices.
  • Working knowledge of cloud and application identity: Entra ID and AWS IAM, managed identities and service principals, RBAC and least privilege, and OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect.
  • Experience operating application and cloud security tooling, such as CNAPP/CSPM (e.g., Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca Security, CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security), application security testing (e.g., Contrast Security, Checkmarx, Veracode, Snyk, Black Duck Seeker), and API security (e.g., APISec, Salt Security, Traceable, 42Crunch, StackHawk).
  • Experience with manual application testing tools such as Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP.
  • Experience performing third-party vendor security assessments.
  • Familiarity with edge, WAF, and CDN platforms such as Cloudflare, Akamai, Fastly, or Imperva.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and the Microsoft 365 suite, including Entra ID and Intune.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, and ISO 27001/27002.
  • Strong scripting ability in Python or PowerShell.
  • Clear communicator who can explain technical risk to developers, vendors, and management.

Preferred

  • Defensive security experience: incident response, EDR, SIEM investigation and query languages (e.g., KQL, SPL), or detection engineering.
  • AI security experience: securing LLM-based applications and agents, MCP servers and gateways, or LLM routers, with familiarity in OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, or NIST AI RMF.
  • Experience with cloud FinOps practices and observability platforms (logging, metrics, tracing), particularly as applied to AI and security workloads.
  • Container and Kubernetes security experience (e.g., AKS, EKS), including image scanning and runtime protection.
  • Experience working with penetration testing, PTaaS, or crowdsourced security testing providers.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, GDPR, NYDFS Part 500, and TISAX. Compliance is owned by a dedicated GRC team; this role supports implementing the technical controls behind it.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, GIAC (GCSA, GWEB, GCIH, or similar), OSCP, AWS Security Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500).

Education and/or Training

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Partner with the best

raw.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.


About the Role

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to define, position, and scale Leviathan, Armada’s AI Factory platform, one of Armada's flagship products.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and GTM with a primary focus on translating Leviathan’s capabilities into clear, differentiated value for enterprise and public sector customers deploying AI at the edge.

You will also be responsible for building the category narrative, economic story, and commercial motion for Leviathan, targeting infrastructure investors, sovereign governments, energy companies, and enterprise buyers deploying AI in disconnected environments.

This is a hands-on, operating PMM role, not a pure content or launch function. You will deeply understand how Leviathan works (AI infrastructure orchestration, distributed compute, deployment, and lifecycle management across cloud and edge environments) and turn that complexity into compelling positioning, messaging, and GTM execution.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, is comfortable with highly technical products, and wants meaningful ownership over how a category-defining AI edge platform is understood, sold, and adopted.

Location: United States (Flexible)

What You’ll Do

Product Marketing & Platform Positioning (Primary Focus)

  • Own end-to-end positioning and messaging for Leviathan (AI Factory), including the category narrative and economic value story that holds up in investment and board-level conversations
  • Build and evolve a category-defining narrative for AI Factory platforms, and continuously refine positioning strategy as the market matures
  • Translate technical capabilities (AI orchestration, infra, deployment, lifecycle management) into clear customer value propositions

Define ICPs, buyer personas, use cases, and customer journeys across Leviathan’s distinct customer profiles:

  • Infrastructure investors and developers (e.g., neoclouds)
  • Sovereign governments
  • Energy and industrial operators
  • Defense and public sector programs

Partner with Product and Engineering to shape:

  • Roadmap narratives
  • Platform packaging
  • Feature positioning
  • Lead platform and feature launches with high internal readiness and strong external clarity
  • Analyze competitive AI infrastructure, edge, and platform trends to define clear differentiation

AI Factory Use Cases & Vertical GTM

  • Develop use case-led narratives for AI Factory deployments across industries, including:
  • Public sector & defense
  • Energy (oil & gas, utilities)
  • Mining
  • Telecommunications
  • Manufacturing
  • Map Leviathan capabilities to real-world AI deployment challenges:
  • Limited connectivity
  • Data sovereignty
  • Security
  • Distributed operations


Translate and message around key buying drivers, including:

  • Sovereign AI requirements
  • Power economics
  • Speed of deployment
  • Air-gapped and high-security environments
  • Offtake compute access
  • Support verticalized GTM motions in partnership with Sales and Solutions Engineering

Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement

Build high-impact sales enablement assets explaining

  • What Leviathan is
  • Where it fits in the AI stack
  • Why it wins

Develop

  • Messaging frameworks
  • Pitch decks and narratives
  • Solution briefs
  • Competitive battlecards
  • Develop collateral and messaging that supports Armada’s offtake partner model, clearly articulating how access to a curated compute offtake network reduces buyer risk and accelerates investment decisions

Partner with Sales, SEs, and Customer Success to:

  • Drive pipeline creation
  • Support deal progression and win rates
  • Ensure consistent, technically accurate messaging across all GTM teams
  • Support technical documentation and top-of-funnel initiatives (demand generation, website, events) to ensure consistent and compelling messaging across the funnel

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing

Bring customer and field insights into:

  • Positioning updates
  • Messaging evolution
  • Product roadmap influence
  • Support analyst briefings and market education around AI infrastructure and edge AI platforms

Market & Customer Insight

  • Engage directly with customers to understand:
  • AI deployment challenges
  • Buying criteria
  • Adoption barriers

Track the competitive landscape across:

  • AI infrastructure platforms
  • Edge computing solutions
  • Distributed systems
  • Help shape how the market understands Armada’s AI Factory vision and differentiation

What Success Looks Like

  • Clear, credible messaging that demystifies AI Factory's value
  • Sales teams confidently articulating value in complex, technical AI buying cycles
  • Product launches that drive measurable adoption and engagement
  • Strong pull from Product, Sales, and SE teams as a trusted GTM and narrative partner

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in product marketing or related roles
  • Experience marketing technical platforms or infrastructure (AI, cloud, networking, or edge)
  • Proven ability to translate complex systems into customer-centric messaging
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with Product and Engineering
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

Preferred Qualifications

Background in:

  • AI/ML infrastructure
  • Distributed systems
  • Networking or edge computing
  • Technical pre-sales or engineering

Familiarity with:

  • AI deployment pipelines
  • Hybrid / edge cloud environments

Experience selling into:

  • Enterprise
  • Government
  • Regulated industries
  • Exposure to early-stage or high-growth platform companies

Why This Role at Armada

  • Own how a category-defining AI Factory platform is positioned and scaled
  • Deep partnership with Product and Engineering at the frontier of AI deployment
  • Opportunity to shape an emerging market
  • Clear path to senior PMM or GTM leadership roles

Impact

This role is critical to shaping how Leviathan is understood in the market, from category narrative and economic framing to technical positioning and commercial adoption.

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the on-target earnings salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to the salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost)
  • Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA)
  • Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k)
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO)
  • 14 paid company holidays per year

#DA-1

Compensation
$121,120—$151,400 USD

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.
