raw.excerpt: About Us:YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B.
raw.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

About The Role:

YipitData is seeking a Head of Quant Revenue to lead one of the company’s most important strategic growth initiatives. This leader will own the strategy and commercial execution for our Quant business, managing a small team of new-logo sellers and Business Development professionals responsible for expanding and renewing existing accounts.

This is more than a sales-management role. The Head of Quant Revenue will define how we approach the market, identify the segments and use cases where we can win, shape our go-to-market strategy, and build the operating infrastructure required to scale an already successful business. This person will work closely with Product, Research, Client Strategy, Marketing, and senior leadership to translate market insight into growth.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking, commercial judgment, people leadership, and exceptional operating discipline. They move quickly, thrive in ambiguity, and are energized by building.

What You’ll Own

  • Quant revenue strategy: Develop and execute the commercial strategy across systematic funds, quantamental investors, and quantitative teams
  • Full customer lifecycle: Lead new-logo acquisition, product evaluations, account expansion, pricing, renewals, and retention across the Quant business
  • Team leadership: Manage, coach, and develop a high-performing team spanning new-business sellers and account-focused Business Development professionals
  • Go-to-market execution: Own the rollout of new Quant products and use cases, including market segmentation, positioning, packaging, pricing, and sales enablement
  • Business performance: Maintain a clear view of pipeline health, forecast accuracy, conversion, customer retention, and the leading indicators required to achieve team targets
  • Commercial excellence: Coach the team on discovery, qualification, account planning, negotiation, and complex trial led sales while maintaining pricing integrity
  • Strategic account development: Build senior relationships across priority accounts and help the team uncover long-term expansion opportunities
  • Market and product insight: Develop a deep understanding of quantitative investment workflows and translate customer feedback into actionable recommendations for Product and Research
  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner closely with Client Strategy, Product, Research, Marketing, and company leadership to solve business challenges and accelerate growth
  • Scalable operations: Identify gaps, test new approaches, and build the processes, systems, and organizational structure needed to scale efficiently

What We’re Looking For

  • A successful revenue leader with experience managing complex, consultative B2B sales and account-growth motions particularly with the systematic end-market
  • A track record of building and scaling teams, consistently delivering against ambitious revenue targets, and developing high-performing talent
  • Experience selling data, research, technology, feeds or other sophisticated products to quantitative investors & researchers
  • The ability to establish credibility with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, data strategy teams, and senior investment leaders
  • Exceptional intellectual curiosity and a genuine desire to understand customers, markets, products, and the technical details behind them
  • Strong strategic judgment paired with the operational discipline to turn ideas into measurable execution
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, forming hypotheses, running experiments, and adjusting quickly as new information emerges
  • A commitment to perfecting the craft of selling and raising the standard for the broader team
  • A highly receptive approach to feedback and a demonstrated commitment to continuous self-improvement
  • The initiative, urgency, and stamina to operate at the pace of a rapidly growing business
  • Strong executive communication and the ability to build trust across functions and levels of leadership

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and develop a team of sellers, setting strategy and execution plans to achieve revenue goals for the segment
  • Act as a primary driver of revenue growth by selling YipitData’s feed products into systematic investment funds
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities through proactive outreach and your existing network
  • Collaborate with internal product teams to tailor solutions that address clients’ specific data needs
  • Manage the complete sales process — from prospecting to contract execution — ensuring exceptional client experience
  • Represent YipitData at relevant conferences, industry events, and client meetings to strengthen our presence in the quant community

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You are a proven revenue leader with experience managing high-performing account management & new logo teams
  • You have 10+ years of leadership experience selling complex products into the quant end-market
  • You have 6+ years of experience in quota-carrying roles
  • Skilled in client relationship management, with a track record of driving renewals, expansion and new logo development
  • Adept at navigating complex organizations to uncover new revenue opportunities
  • Passionate about building a team culture that prioritizes growth and curiosity
  • You have experience managing the holistic life cycle of a client relationship from inception to onboarding, quarterly business reviews, renewal, and upsells
  • You have experience selling into quant funds, negotiating contracts with sophisticated procurement teams, and liaising with various stakeholders
  • Have a deep understanding of how to sell into this end market, the different personas and buying criteria
  • You have a track record of not only meeting but exceeding sales goals
  • With a high EQ, you are sensitive to clients’ needs and quickly develop client relationships
  • You are intellectually curious and willing to go deep on our customers, products, and market
  • You can move fluidly between setting long-term strategy and driving day-to-day execution
  • You create clarity in ambiguous situations, take initiative, and move quickly from insight to action
  • You hold a high bar for yourself and your team, actively seek feedback, and continuously refine your craft
  • You invest deeply in developing others while building a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement
  • You know how to take a business with demonstrated traction and build the strategy, team, and operating engine required to scale it

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • Base Salary + Variable Compensation: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $200,000 This role is eligible for variable compensation, with on-target earnings (OTE) of up to $400,000. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.
  • The compensation package also includes equity.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Holman is a family-owned, global automotive services organization anchored by our deeply rooted core values and principles that have enabled us to continue Driving What’s Right throughout the last century. Our teams deliver the Holman Experience by treating our customers and each other as we would like to be treated, and creating positive, rewarding relationships all around.

The automotive markets Holman serves include fleet management and leasing; vehicle fabrication and upfitting; component manufacturing and productivity solutions; powertrain distribution and logistics services; commercial and personal insurance and risk management; and retail automotive sales as one of the largest privately owned dealership groups in the United States.

Holman is currently accepting applications for the position of Manager- Information Security & Compliance


Principal Purpose of Position:

  • Develops and maintains a security program and executes initiatives that address identified risks and security requirements.
  • Develops and maintains a security focused governance, risk and compliance program.
  • Maintains security organizational profiles, data inventories, threats and risks for Holman companies.
  • Advises management on best practices, current trends, and pertinent changes in internal/external threats and opportunities in a timely and anticipatory manner. Presents, influences and executives on action plans.
  • Develop new and proposes changes to policies and procedures to ensure operating efficiency and regulatory compliance.
  • Provides security communication, awareness and training for audiences, which may range from senior leaders to field staff.
  • Consults with Technology and the Business to ensure security is factored into the evaluation, selection, installation and configuration of hardware, purchased software, developed software and vendors.
  • Plans and conducts assessment including but not limited to organizational, compliance, risk, program, system, policy, incident response and general security.
  • Manages the organization’s response during Information Security Incidents
  • Monitors compliance of information security policies. Communicates and reports infringements to Senior Management.
  • Manage a staff of information security professionals, hire and train new staff, and conduct performance reviews. Provide leadership and coaching which include technical and personal development programs.

Relevant Work Experience:


  • 5-7+ years of Information Security experience.
  • 3+ years in a management\leadership role.
  • Strong experience in developing and executing security architecture and strategies. This includes strategic, tactical and project level plans.
  • Strong experience with common information security frameworks. Examples include: International Standards Organization (ISO) 2700x, the IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL), Control Objectives for Information and Related Technology (COBIT) frameworks, NIST 800-53 and Center of Information Security Critical Security Controls.
  • Familiarity with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, including, but not limited to, the U.S. Sarbanes-Oxley Act, FTC Data Safeguards, Payment Card Industry (PCI), EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).
  • Working knowledge of various technology tools used to manage and perform security and compliance functions.

Education and/or Training:


  • Four year college degree or demonstrated equivalent experience as determined by department management.
  • Security certifications such as CISMP/GIAC/CISA/CISM or ISACA is a plus.

We will never stop striving for improved diversity, equity, and inclusion because we are successful together when we feel trusted and supported. It’s The Holman Way.

Die KI-basierte mobile Anwendung von Breathment bietet den Patient*innen digitale Rehabilitation von zu Hause aus.   • Formulierung von medizinisch-wissenschaftlichen Zusammenfassungen und Veröffentlichungen

Qualifikation

Description

About Us

Gambit is the AI-native resilience platform that ensures digital continuity never expires. It unifies governance across cloud, backups, security tools, and IaC, mapping applications, identifying gaps, and validating recovery paths in real time. Gambit turns resilience assumptions into business certainty before an incident ever occurs.

﻿The Opportunity

As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you own a book of roughly 9 to 15 enterprise accounts end to end, from kickoff through renewal, and you do it independently: your work does not get reviewed before it reaches a customer. You make sure each customer actually gets more resilient with Gambit, can prove it to their board and regulators, and renews and grows.

The difference from the level below is judgment. You handle multi-cloud estates, regulated customers, difficult executive conversations, and ambiguous findings without a safety net, and you mentor newer TAMs while making the team's playbooks better. You do not carry a quota; you carry retention, adoption, posture improvement, and the trust of the accounts you own.

About the Role

  • Onboarding. Confirm success criteria in writing, drive the implementation plan, and validate business application mapping, criticality tiering, and RTO and RPO targets with the customer.
  • Posture advisory. Translate Gambit findings into prioritized remediation plans tied to business impact, engineering effort, and risk retired, and advise on backup policy, immutability, isolation, and clean recovery paths.
  • Compliance evidence. Build control-level evidence packages for internal audit, external auditors, and regulators across DORA, NIS2, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST.
  • Executive reviews. Own the quarterly business review with executive sponsors, and produce posture assessments and cost-of-remediation analyses verified against real data.
  • Escalations and renewal risk. Own escalations end to end, including severity-one events; maintain a risk register and renewal readiness assessment for every account; and hand expansion signals to the Account Executive with the technical justification already built.
  • Team and product. Mentor newer TAMs, improve the team's playbooks and templates, and represent customers to Product and R&D with evidence-backed demand.

Requirements

  • 7+ years in technical account management, customer success engineering, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or post-sale technical delivery, with at least 3 years owning enterprise accounts directly.
  • Deep working knowledge of at least one major cloud, with hands-on experience across backup and disaster recovery: retention, immutability and WORM, replication, restore point hygiene, and RTO and RPO planning, applied to real enterprise environments rather than in theory.
  • Experience supporting an enterprise customer through an audit or compliance review, producing evidence mapped to controls under at least one of DORA, NIS2, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST, plus a working understanding of infrastructure as code and how drift happens in practice.
  • Comfortable querying APIs, working with JSON, and building your own analyses without waiting on someone else, with growing use of AI tooling to speed up customer-facing work.
  • A track record of retention and expansion across a book of enterprise accounts, including at least one at-risk account you stabilized.
  • Credible in front of CISOs and infrastructure leaders without support from leadership, with executive-facing deliverables you personally built.
  • Experience mentoring or reviewing the work of peers, and contributing improvements that others on your team adopted.
  • Comfort operating without established process, four years of college-level courses in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, and openness to up to 20% travel.

﻿NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience at a cyber resilience, backup and recovery, data protection, CSPM, or observability vendor, or with platforms such as Veeam, Rubrik, Cohesity, or Commvault
  • Prior hands-on experience as a cloud, infrastructure, SRE, or security engineer
  • Experience working with agentic AI tooling or MCP-based integrations in a customer-facing context

﻿

﻿Benefits - Why Gambit?﻿

At Gambit, we believe great work starts with great people — and we’re building a team of smart, driven, genuinely great co-workers who enjoy doing big things together.

Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • OTE ranging from $230,000 - $260,000 (80/20 split)
  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • A $350 work-from-home stipend to create a setup that helps you do your best work
  • Work alongside smart, supportive, and collaborative co-workers who are excited to build something meaningful together

﻿Pay Transparency Disclosure

﻿Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified. For roles that are available to be filled remotely, the pay range is localized according to employee work location.

﻿EEO

Gambit Security is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Cloud Platform Engineer to join our Runway team. In this role, you will help design, build, and maintain the infrastructure and developer tooling that powers our engineering organization. You will play a key role in advancing our Kubernetes-based platform, maturing our GitOps practices, and driving infrastructure-as-code adoption across the business.

This is a hands-on technical role suited to someone who thrives at the intersection of infrastructure, automation, and developer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Kubernetes Platform Management — Operate, maintain, and improve production-grade Kubernetes clusters across cloud environments; manage cluster lifecycle including upgrades, scaling, and reliability.
  • GitOps & Continuous Delivery — Own and extend our ArgoCD-based GitOps workflows; develop and maintain Application Sets, manage sync policies, and enforce deployment standards across environments.
  • Infrastructure as Code — Write, review, and maintain Terraform modules to provision and manage cloud infrastructure; enforce IaC best practices including module reuse, state management, and drift detection.
  • Platform Reliability — Monitor platform health, respond to incidents, conduct post-mortems, and drive improvements to availability, performance, and observability.
  • Developer Enablement — Collaborate with application teams to onboard services onto the platform; create documentation, runbooks, and self-service tooling that improves developer productivity.
  • Security & Compliance — Implement RBAC, network policies, secrets management (e.g., Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator), and ensure infrastructure meets security and compliance requirements.
  • CI/CD Integration — Integrate platform capabilities with CI pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Tekton) to support end-to-end delivery workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in a platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE role
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments (EKS, GKE, or AKS preferred)
  • Demonstrable experience with ArgoCD or comparable GitOps tooling (Flux, etc.)
  • Proficiency in Terraform for cloud infrastructure provisioning; familiarity with remote state, workspaces, and module design
  • Experience working with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Comfortable writing scripts and automation in Python, Bash, or Go
  • Familiarity with Helm for Kubernetes package management
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, ingress, service mesh concepts
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to document systems clearly and collaborate across teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd, Cilium)
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code tools such as OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno
  • Exposure to observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki)
  • Knowledge of Crossplane or other Kubernetes-native IaC approaches
  • Contributions to open-source projects or internal platform tooling
  • Experience with multi-cluster or multi-region Kubernetes architectures
  • Relevant certifications: CKA, CKAD, AWS Solutions Architect, HashiCorp Terraform Associate

The Digital Assets Coordinator is responsible for day-to-day work involved with setting up and maintaining Penn Foster Group course content in the various systems used to deliver that content to learners, including the Student Information System, the Learning Management System, source file archives, project schedules and information dashboards, and all other systems, tools, and applications. This position is responsible for meeting deadlines and managing time and priorities efficiently.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Complete and maintain SIS builds for assets, lessons, courses, and programs.

◦ Entering and verifying data used for course setup and delivery.

◦ Assign, record, and track unique numbers for assets of all types.

◦ Prepare and deploy audio, PDF, and video files for delivery through online courses.

  • Set up technical aspects of LMS course connections to ensure interoperability with various systems for seamless course delivery.
  • Leverage data analytics and SQL to cross-reference, track usage, identify trends, and optimize asset management.
  • Solve issues through collaboration, open communication, and creative problem-solving.
  • Learn new programs and platforms quickly, drive continuous improvement, share knowledge and lessons-learned with team.
  • Create and provide regular reports on personal and team-assigned workflows.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: Online-learning systems experience is required. Proven experience being highly organized and process-driven. Experience working and communicating with technology and instructional design teams is preferred.
  • Computer Skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript experience is required. Experience with Anthology Student, Instructure Canvas, D2L Brightspace, Atlassian Jira and Confluence, and Microsoft 365 is preferred. SQL, Git, and Tableau experience is a plus.
  • Certificates & Licenses: None

• Other Requirements:

◦ Ability to work in a fast-paced, production-based environment.

◦ Forward-thinking; someone who learns and adapts quickly.

◦ Ability to prioritize assignments and be flexible and respond to changes in those priorities.

◦ Collaborative and professional work ethic.

◦ Must have a love for creating great products.

Working Conditions & Hiring Process

  • U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role.
  • Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, and similar activities. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed.
  • On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply.
  • Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement.
  • Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law.
  • Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

About Us: At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by bringing together Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable learners to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future.  Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market.

At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way.
We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most.
Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be.
If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you.

What you will do

  • You will join a cross-functional team that owns metrics collection and ingestion end to end, from the agent running on customer hosts and Kubernetes nodes to ingestion and processing in the Sysdig backend.
  • Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will solve performance, scalability and correctness problems across the whole pipeline.
  • You will lead technical design for features across the agent and backend, and collaborate with product and design on specifications and timelines.
  • You will be part of a team whose main goal is to work together to build the best product we can. We enjoy what we do and we always aim to get better.
  • You will take part in an on-call rotation to handle urgent issues.

What you will bring with you

  • Advanced coding skills, with 5+ years of professional experience in at least one of Rust, Go or C/C++, and willingness to learn and work across different technologies.
  • Solid systems-programming background: Linux internals, processes, control groups, networking and file I/O. Experience with eBPF, kernel-level instrumentation or container runtimes (containerd, CRI-O, Docker) is a strong plus.
  • Experience building performance-sensitive software that runs on customer infrastructure: resource-bounded, robust to partial failures, and safe to run privileged.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems: horizontally scalable services, and/or event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with observability tools and telemetry is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes is a strong plus. Experience with cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.

What we look for

  • Collaboration: The ability to excel in a cross-team environment, contributing to both technical and product discussions.
  • Growth Mindset: A willingness to participate in professional development to stay current with industry trends.
  • Communication: Fluency in English.

When you join Sysdig, you can expect

  • Extra days off to prioritize your well-being
  • Mental health support for you and your family through the Modern Health app
  • Great compensation package
The annual compensation range for this full-time position is between €54,000 and €68,000. Actual offers may be higher or lower than this range based on a variety of factors, including your work location, job-related experience and education.

We would love for you to join us! Please reach out even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description. We can always explore other options after starting the conversation. Your background and passion will set you apart, especially if your career path is different.

About the Role

We're looking for an Account Executive in North America to get midsize and large organizations, who feed their employees frequently, to use DoorDash for business for all their meal needs. Reporting to a Sales Manager, you’ll be focused on building new pipeline, leading the full sales cycle, closing and launching deals with prospective organizations while promoting the DoorDash brand.

About the Team

Our mission is to promote growth in local economies by building connections with businesses across the nation and promoting the DoorDash platform. You’ll focus on leading the sales cycle and closing partnerships with prospective organizations while promoting the DoorDash brand.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Help organizations feed their employees on a frequent basis

  • Hunt for new business and build a pipeline of qualified leads

  • Lead the full sales cycle while closing deals with mid to large sized organizations

  • Leverage tools like Outreach and LinkedIn to consistently engage prospects

  • Conduct deep discovery calls with prospects and get them excited about the DoorDash platform

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 3+ years of experience working in a high volume inside or outside sales environment

  • You have experience selling to Medium to Large business

  • You have managed many full sales cycles and have been in a closing and lead generation sales role

  • You are genuinely curious about people, local businesses, and technology

  • You have a dynamic personality with a customer-focused mindset

  • You are creative, persistent, and passionate about sales

  • You can navigate sales and internal tools quickly (Salesforce, Outreach, Sales Navigator, Google Apps)

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants and sales commission. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

Join our Bioprocessing team as a Field Applications Specialist-(Chrom/TFF) and play a key role in supporting the successful implementation and application of downstream processing technologies that help accelerate the development and production of innovative therapies for better health for more people. Working closely with customers and internal stakeholders across the Mid-Atlantic/ Southeast territory, you will act as a trusted technical partner, providing application expertise, troubleshooting support, and workflow recommendations that enable customer success. Based in a remote work environment with customer-facing responsibilities across the region, you will contribute directly to the adoption and optimization of Sartorius downstream processing solutions.   • Execute application trials, validation activities, proof-of-concept studies, and customer training by designing, coordinating, and documenting customer-specific evaluation plans, onboarding activities, and outcomes to drive successful implementation

  • Provide monthly territory activity reports and updates to management

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs

Salary range is $90,000-$116,530 (depending on qualifications), plus a sales incentive plan, and car allowance.

Our mission is to deliver efficient, scalable, and sustainable solutions to businesses across multiple industries. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a strategic and hands-on Head of Accounting to lead our team.

Position Overview

The Accounting Manager will oversee all accounting functions, ensuring accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and compliance with regulatory requirements. This role is both strategic and operational, requiring leadership experience, technical expertise, and the ability to support a growing business in a dynamic industry.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead and manage the accounting department, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management
  • Partner with executive leadership to support strategic financial decisions
  • Develop and implement accounting policies, procedures, and best practices

Financial Reporting & Compliance

  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes
  • Prepare and review financial statements in accordance with GAAP
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations
  • Coordinate audits and manage relationships with external auditors

Operational Accounting

  • Manage general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, payroll, and fixed assets
  • Oversee revenue recognition and cost accounting specific to container operations
  • Monitor cash flow, working capital, and financial performance

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Evaluate and improve accounting systems and workflows
  • Lead optimization and administration of NetSuite ERP, including configurations, reporting, and integrations
  • Implement automation and scalable processes to support growth
  • Ensure data integrity across financial platforms

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Participate at the annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting processes
  • Analyze variances and provide actionable insights to leadership

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA preferred)

  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and financial reporting standards
  • Required: Proven, hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP (implementation, optimisation, and reporting)
  • Experience in logistics, manufacturing, or asset-heavy industries preferred
  • Proven ability to scale accounting operations in a growing company
  • Advanced proficiency in financial systems and ERP platforms

Work Environment

  • Experienceworking with U.S.-based companies
  • Work schedule 8:00 am to 5:00 pm PST Mon - Fri

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to shape the financial future of a growing company

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Senior Director of Sales – Public Sector Strategic is responsible for leading and accelerating revenue growth across Lumen’s most strategic Public Sector customer portfolio. This executive leader owns sales strategy, execution, customer relationships, and overall business performance across assigned strategic segments, which may include SLED East, and other Strategic Investment Portfolio’s within the Public Sector Segment at Lumen Technologies.

Operating within highly regulated and complex Public Sector environments, this leader possesses deep expertise in government procurement requirements, acquisition frameworks, funding mechanisms, customer mission priorities, and multi-stakeholder decision-making processes. The Senior Director guides strategy and execution across sophisticated customer ecosystems, translating evolving customer, technology, compliance, and procurement requirements into measurable business outcomes.

This leader serves as a senior executive partner to customers navigating technology modernization, network transformation, cybersecurity, cloud, and mission-critical connectivity needs.

The Senior Director partners closely with Public Sector leadership, business development and capture teams, solution engineering and architects, product management, customer success, operations, marketing, public policy, finance, legal, and delivery organizations to develop differentiated, outcome-based solutions that advance customer missions while driving sustainable and profitable revenue growth aligned to Lumen's strategic objectives.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Create, orchestrate, and execute multi-year customer growth strategies across Lumen's most important Public Sector customers while leading the transition from product-centric selling to outcome-based, platform-led solutions.
  • This leader serves as the senior executive accountable for strategic account planning, executive engagement, ecosystem alignment, and long-term customer value creation across Lumen's most critical Public Sector relationships.
  • Own strategic account planning across the assigned portfolio, including multi-year customer growth strategies, executive engagement plans, whitespace identification, competitive displacement strategies, and customer modernization roadmaps.

  • Identify market trends, customer priorities, competitive dynamics, and emerging government technology requirements to inform sales strategy.
  • Establish a disciplined operating cadence around pipeline generation, opportunity progression, forecasting, and performance management.
  • Partner with solution architecture and technical teams to translate customer mission requirements into differentiated Lumen solutions.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop high-performing sales leaders and sellers while establishing a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.
  • Ensure sales activities comply with Lumen policies, government contracting requirements, and applicable regulatory and ethical standards.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of sales and business development experience, within telecommunications, technology, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or related industries.

  • Experience with large government contract vehicles and channel/partner ecosystems.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed teams and large strategic portfolios.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex enterprise organizations.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing sales teams.

Role Description:

Being a Product Manager at Defense Unicorns is more than just being part of the sparkliest Product team in defense tech. It means taking radical ownership over real products that make a real impact on real people. At Defense Unicorns, our mission is to make software a strategic deterrent, and our Product Management team clears the path.

In this role, you’ll report to the Director of Product and work with teams who deliver outcomes that are critical business enablers and directly support both our missions and other internal teams. raw.description:
Years from now, history will look back at this moment as a landmark for the human race—the moment when generative AI began to change everything. Luckily, you happen to be living through it. Now what?

If you’re one of those rare people driven to add their intellectual energy to the relentless momentum of technological advancement, consider Loka your optimal leverage point.

Loka, a globally distributed tech consultancy based in Silicon Valley, is looking for a Junior Backend Engineer to grow with our team. You’ll work side by side with experienced engineers on real client projects, helping design and build backend applications that are fast, reliable and secure. If you have a foundation in Python and/or Node.js and you’re eager to learn, you’ll get hands-on experience across a variety of projects, with mentors who care about helping you level up.

We count more than 100 certified specialists, technical experts and PhDs among our teammates, all of whom contribute their brilliance to serving our clients as well as to mentoring junior colleagues. We work entirely remotely, test new ideas with an in-house incubator called LokaLabs, observe local holidays and take every other Friday off (really). We’re as proud of our culture as we are of our projects. You will be too.

The Role

  • Build backend components like APIs, serverless functions, queue systems, and data storage services, with guidance from senior engineers as you learn the ropes.
  • Join design discussions to learn how architectural decisions get made, asking questions and sharing ideas as your understanding grows.
  • Pick up security and data-protection best practices and apply them in your day-to-day work.
  • Write clean, well-tested code and clear documentation, with code reviews that help you sharpen your skills.
  • Join conversations with technical leads and clients to see how requirements are gathered and projects are delivered, and share updates on your own work.
  • Grow along Loka's career track, with clear expectations and support as you build your skills, independence, and confidence.
  • Report to a Backend Lead who will mentor you and support your development.
  • Explore new tools and techniques, with room to experiment and bring fresh ideas to the team.
  • Collaborate with teams across Machine Learning, Data Engineering, and more, getting exposure to how different parts of a system fit together.
  • Take ownership of your tasks and see them through, knowing your team has your back when you need help.

Required Hard Skills

  • 1 to 2 years of backend development.
  • Fluency in Python or Node.js (TypeScript).
  • A solid computer science foundation.
  • Understanding of API/Web communication protocols (OpenAPI, gRPC, etc.).
  • Understand concurrency concepts in APIs/Web.
  • Capable of working container-first.

Not Required but Nice to Have

  • Languages: Go, Typescript, PHP, Ruby.
  • Frameworks: Django, FastAPI, NextJS, Express, Laravel, RoR.
  • Databases: PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MySQL, Redis.
  • Understand traditional and serverless architectures.
  • Experience working with AWS.
  • Experience working with and building CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with DevOps tools ((AWS CDK, CDKTF or Terraform).
  • Experience with generative AI tools and services.
  • Experience with observability tools and stacks.

Additional Requirements

  • Excellent English: As a global team we work entirely in English for meetings, customer calls and business communications
  • CV written in English

Personality Profile

  • Curious: You want to learn and grow across different industries with a modern tech stack.
  • Autonomous and positive: You thrive on a fully remote, globally distributed team.
  • Team player: You enjoy a collaborative approach.
  • Adaptable: You operate with a startup mindset and move at a startup pace.

Benefits

  • Every other Friday off (26 extra days off a year)
  • Remote and flexible
  • Explore and Relocation programs (three months work abroad or full international relo)
  • Paid sick days and local holidays
  • Business English classes program
  • Continuous Learning Support
  • Fitness and/or Mental Health Subscriptions
  • Access to LokaLabs™, our internal research and development program
  • Defined career path

Your achievements matter to us! Be sure your CV, LinkedIn and GitHub profiles are up to date, written in English and accurately reflect your experience.

raw.title: Remote Billing Specialist
raw.excerpt: In the United States, one in five adults experience a mental health illness and over 12 million people have thoughts of suicide.
raw.description:
In the United States, one in five adults experience a mental health illness and over 12 million people have thoughts of suicide. Mental health crises can be some of the most difficult times in a person’s life, and over 17 million people seeking behavioral health care experience a delay in accessing care. Willow Health is on a mission to significantly improve this experience by expanding affordable access to high-quality, evidence-based intensive behavioral health care.

In order to make this mission a reality, we are building a virtual crisis care program that provides personalized, recovery-oriented care for people experiencing behavioral health crises. Willow Health offers patients immediate access to evidence-based virtual crisis psychotherapy, medication management, certified peer coaching, care management, and around the clock crisis coverage, while working to connect patients to the most appropriate next level of care. Our co-founding team of Cityblock and Oscar alums has two decades of collective experience working in healthcare and healthcare tech, and we are backed by Andreessen Horowitz.

As Willow Health continues to grow and expand into new markets, we are seeking an experienced Billing Specialist to support accurate, timely, and compliant billing across our payor mix.

This role will be responsible for managing day-to-day billing activities across the revenue cycle, including claim submission, claim follow-up, denial resolution, payment review, and accounts receivable management. The Billing Specialist will work closely with Revenue Cycle leadership to identify billing issues, resolve payor-related barriers, and ensure services are appropriately reimbursed.

The ideal candidate is an experienced medical biller who can work independently, investigate complex billing issues, understand payor requirements, and take ownership of claims through final resolution.

Day to Day Responsibilities

  • Review claims for accuracy and completeness prior to submission, including patient demographics, insurance information, provider information, coding, modifiers, place of service, and other billing requirements.

  • Submit clean claims to commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care payors.

  • Monitor claim status and proactively follow up on unpaid, underpaid, rejected, and denied claims.

  • Research and resolve claim denials and rejections, including identifying root causes, making necessary corrections, submitting reconsiderations or appeals, and tracking claims through resolution.

  • Work accounts receivable and aging reports according to established follow-up timelines and priorities.

  • Review payor remittances and Explanation of Benefits/Explanation of Payment documentation to identify payment discrepancies, denials, recoupments, and other issues requiring follow-up.

  • Identify underpayments and reimbursement discrepancies and escalate or pursue resolution as appropriate.

  • Correct and resubmit claims when billing errors or payor requirements are identified.

  • Communicate with insurance companies regarding eligibility, claim status, authorization, reimbursement, and other billing-related issues.

  • Maintain clear and complete documentation of billing follow-up and actions taken.

  • Identify recurring denial patterns, payor issues, or workflow problems and communicate trends to Revenue Cycle leadership.

  • Collaborate with clinical, operations, credentialing, and revenue cycle teams to resolve issues affecting claim submission or reimbursement.

  • Maintain working knowledge of payor billing requirements and changes impacting reimbursement.

  • Support billing-related audits, reconciliations, and other revenue cycle initiatives as needed.

Success in this Role Will Be Measured By:

  • Timely and accurate submission of clean claims.

  • Effective follow-up and resolution of outstanding accounts receivable.

  • Reduction and timely resolution of claim denials and rejections.

  • Accurate identification and recovery of underpayments.

  • Thorough and consistent documentation of billing activity.

  • Ability to independently research and resolve payor and claim issues.

  • Identification of recurring billing trends and opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes.

Our Ideal Candidate Has:

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on medical billing and accounts receivable experience.

  • Strong experience working claims across the full billing lifecycle, from initial submission through final payment or resolution.

  • Experience billing commercial insurance, Medicare, and Medicaid.

  • Strong knowledge of claim submission, rejection resolution, denial management, appeals, accounts receivable follow-up, and payor reimbursement.

  • Working knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, modifiers, place-of-service requirements, and standard healthcare billing terminology.

  • Experience using payor portals, clearinghouses, and electronic health record/practice management systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to research complex billing issues and independently determine appropriate next steps.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies or errors that may impact reimbursement.

  • Ability to prioritize a high-volume workload and consistently follow claims through resolution.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfort working independently in a remote, fast-moving environment.

  • An openness to and ability to respond to constructive feedback.

  • A desire to improve mental health care delivery.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Medical billing experience within behavioral health, psychiatry, or mental health services strongly preferred.

  • Experience billing psychotherapy, psychiatric evaluation, crisis services, and evaluation and management services.

  • Experience working within a multi-state healthcare or telehealth organization.

  • Experience with both fee-for-service Medicaid and Medicaid managed care.

  • Experience identifying denial trends and contributing to process improvements that improve clean claim rates and reimbursement.

  • CPC, CPB, or other relevant billing/coding certification is a plus, but not required with equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Previous experience working remotely.

  • Be a cultural carrier who embodies our values:

  • Safety above all else. We operate in a space with life and death repercussions, and every member of our team takes that responsibility seriously. We all look for and call out patient safety concerns.

  • Maximize measurable impact. We put our patients first. We are tenacious about doing good, and we have the outcomes to prove it. Our work is guided by measurable hypotheses that we test and re-evaluate.

  • Build inclusively and equitably. We are committed to decreasing the systemic inequalities in healthcare and to building an organization where a diverse group of patients and employees can thrive. We seek to understand and learn from differences rather than minimize them.

  • Stakes determine speed. Where the stakes are low, we optimize for quick learnings and progress. Where the stakes are higher, we are more thoughtful and methodical. Where safety is a concern, we optimize for zero errors.

  • Constellations, not stars. We believe a well functioning team is worth much more than a collection of individuals, and we invest in bringing out the best in each other. We are kind, loyal, and direct.

  • Honor commitments; honor yourself. We do our best work when we are fulfilled, our core needs are met, and there is joy along the way. We are clear about what we can and can’t do so that we can honor our commitments and fulfill them excellently.

  • Empowerment and empathy. Wherever possible, we empower others rather than decide for them. When we make decisions that affect others, we seek their perspective and minimize harm done.

Benefits

  • PTO includes sick leave, certain federal holidays, and vacation

  • Wellness and Internet stipend

  • 401K

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

This role requires permanent residence in the United States.

The Clinical Specialist works closely with the surgical team members to provide clinical product assistance to the surgeon by being familiar with the surgical procedure, instruments, supplies, and equipment.

The Clinical Specialist will train the surgical team on instrument preparation prior to cases and during the surgical procedure. This role will manage inventory needs in the account and any accompanying administrative requirements.

What We Offer:

You will experience constant learning and dynamic challenges to help you grow and be the best version of yourself.

raw.description:
The Global Campus Professor are focused on exceptional learning experiences that emphasize innovative, high quality teaching, a deep commitment to student learning and success, and the cultivation of a supportive and caring academic community. Lead Faculty are in 12 month, ranked, career track positions, not eligible for tenure, with core duties to teach asynchronous undergraduate and graduate courses to adult learners; lead the development of programs and courses; supervise and mentor associate faculty; support specialized program accreditation efforts, including NAEYC accreditation and continuous alignment with professional standards; and serve students and the institution to ensure continued improvement toward critical student success goals.


At the heart of our institution is a deep commitment to a Culture of Care, an ethos that emphasizes proactive, compassionate, and responsive engagement to ensure every student feels supported and empowered to succeed. UAGC programs are intentionally designed to bridge academic learning and workforce relevance, equipping students with practical skills and disciplinary expertise that prepare them for meaningful career advancement and lifelong learning.


Lead Faculty contribute to this commitment through continuous program improvement, accreditation and assessment activities, and the development of high quality learning experiences aligned with relevant professional and disciplinary standards.


Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.


Duties and Responsibilities:


Teaching


Lead Faculty demonstrate a passion for helping students achieve their goals, applying disciplinary and professional knowledge in effective practices in teaching, assessment, and student engagement for online, asynchronous courses.


  • Deliver high-quality, engaging online instruction.
  • Connect the learning experience to workforce skills and professional advancement.
  • Foster a supportive and inclusive learning environment for adult learners.
  • Prioritize student learning, achievement, and timely feedback.
  • Maintain strong communication with students and respond promptly to inquiries.
  • Ensure academic integrity and uphold university policies.
  • Collaborate with academic support teams to enhance student experience.

Learning Leadership


The UAGC online educational model is built around a "quality at scale" approach, in which a centralized, expertly designed curriculum ensures consistency, rigor, and excellence across all course sections. All faculty teach from a shared course shell, allowing them to focus on delivering high-impact instruction and individualized support.


  • Supports NAEYC accreditation efforts.
  • Develops and improves courses and innovative teaching practices in collaboration with instructional designers, assessment specialists, and other experts.
  • Develops and improves course material,s including texts, media, assessment tools, and other innovative instructional modalities.
  • Review, support, and mentor instructional quality of associate faculty.
  • Leads continuous improvement of curriculum and instructional design, with a focus on relevance, rigor, and accessibility.
  • Collaborates with other departments such as student success, student affairs, library, writing center, access and wellness, academic advising, and career services to create, monitor, and improve initiatives for a holistic student support experience.
  • Supports students’ sense of connection to the university in an online environment.

Service


  • Attends and actively participates in department, college, and university meetings.
  • Engages in shared governance activities and committees.
  • Participates in search and hiring committees.
  • Supports accreditation and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Mentors and supports faculty and staff.
  • Collaborates on university student success and other initiatives.
  • Participates in NAEYC self-study process.

Additional Information:


Recommendations for appointment and faculty rank are made by department faculty and the College Dean and approved by the Vice Provost for Global Campus Academic Affairs, guided by standards of achievement in teaching and service at each rank, including the the following expectations:


  • Global Campus Assistant Professor (terminal degree, or master’s degree with substantial professional and / or college teaching experience)
  • Global Campus Associate Professor (terminal degree and 4 years full-time college teaching experience)
  • Global Campus Professor (terminal degree and 8 years full-time college teaching experience)

Distribution and expectations of duties, including teaching load, vary annually depending on department needs.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:


  • Ability to create inclusive, engaging, and supportive online learning environments that foster student success and belonging.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and compassionately adult learners of varying academic preparedness levels.
  • Ability to align academic content with workforce needs and industry trends to ensure program relevance and graduate preparedness.
  • Skill in using educational technology and learning management systems to deliver high-quality online instruction and feedback.
  • Ability to interpret student success data and use insights to improve teaching practices and curricular design.
  • Ability to effectively balance teaching, service, and administrative responsibilities in a complex online learning environment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the NAEYC Professional Standards and Competencies for Early Childhood Educators, including experience applying the standards to early childhood curriculum, assessment, program development, or continuous improvement.
  • Knowledge of the NAEYC Professional Standards and Competencies for Early Childhood Educators, including experience applying the standards to early childhood curriculum, assessment, program development, or continuous improvement.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a capacity to foster student engagement and clarity in a remote learning context.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and balance competing responsibilities within a flexible, evolving work environment.

Minimum Qualifications:


  • Masters degree in Early Childhood Education, Child Development, Child and Family Studies, Curriculum and Instruction, Elementary Education, or a closely related field from an accredited institution.
  • Evidence of promise or experience demonstrating adequate training, depth of knowledge in a particular specialty, and capacity to undertake high-quality teaching and service.
  • Familiarity with best practices in teaching and learning, including curriculum development assessment strategies, especially in virtual environments.
  • A collaborative and student-centered approach to leadership and instructional support.
  • Commitment to a student-centered Culture of Care, including proactive outreach, timely feedback, and individualized support.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Earned doctorate and applied professional experience in in the field.
  • Experience supporting NAEYC higher education accreditation, accreditation reporting, self study development, or continuous program improvement.
  • Experience contributing to a strategic vision, increased student success, and growth.
  • Experience working with adult, non-traditional, post-traditional learners.
  • Experience teaching in on-ground and online higher education, including experience in faculty development, instructional design, and continuous improvement.

Outstanding U of A benefits include health, dental, and vision insurance plans; life insurance and disability programs; paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays; U of A/ASU/NAU tuition reduction for the employee and qualified family members; retirement plans; access to U of A recreation and cultural activities; and more!

The University of Arizona has been recognized for our innovative work-life programs. For more information about working at the University of Arizona and relocations services, please click here.

raw.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

We are seeking a data-driven, highly organized Marketplace Operations & Experimentation Specialist to join our Marketplace team and report to the Product Manager for Marketplace. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

The Marketplace is where shoppers discover stores, products, and deals inside the Sezzle app. Our team runs a lot of features, and there's almost always something being tested. You'll be the person who knows what's live, who it's live for, and how it's performing.

This is an operations role with a strong product and data lens. You'll launch and track A/B tests, keep an eye on our shopping partners, and turn results into clear recommendations on what we do next. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, design, and partnerships. If you like running a lot of experiments at once and keeping every one of them organized, this role is for you.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.666 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Experimentation

  • Set up, QA, and launch A/B tests across Marketplace features. Make sure targeting, variants, and tracking are right before anything goes live.
  • Monitor running tests, flag issues early, and call results once they reach significance.
  • Keep a single source of truth for every test: what's live, who sees it, and what we learned.

Partner & Marketplace Operations

  • Create and manage placements, promotions, coupons, and offers across the Sezzle app.
  • Set up and manage cashback programs in our internal admin tools.
  • Onboard new online stores into the marketplace and activate their store domains, so more stores are shoppable in the app.
  • Keep a clear map of which user and merchant segments see which features, placements, and offers.
  • Run regular QA audits, work through user-reported issues and broken links, and set up alerts so problems get caught before users notice.

Reporting & Process

  • Benchmark our shopping experience against competitors and bring new ideas for placements, deals, and offers that get more users shopping.
  • Document test plans, results, and processes, and find parts of the workflow that can be automated with AI.

What We Look For

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 1 to 3+ years of experience in operations, experimentation, or product analytics.
  • Highly organized. You can run many tests and workstreams at once without anything slipping.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, with teammates across the business and external partners.
  • Strong analytical skills. Comfortable with SQL and dashboards, and able to read A/B test results (lift, significance, sample size).
  • Comfortable in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift.
  • Detail-oriented with a QA mindset. You catch the targeting mistake before it launches.
  • Daily user of Claude or a similar AI tool. You use it to analyze data, write queries, draft docs, and automate repetitive work, and you can walk us through real examples.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with A/B testing or feature flag tools, such as Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or Firebase.
  • Experience with affiliate, cashback, or advertising partnerships.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience with mobile apps and product analytics tools, such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Financial Controller to oversee month-end financial reporting and quality assurance across a portfolio of Australian business clients.

This is a review-focused role where you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial information. Working closely with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and a Sri Lanka-based development team, you will provide financial oversight, review management reports, and contribute to the continuous improvement of automated finance processes.

Rather than focusing on transactional accounting or bookkeeping, you will act as a key financial reviewer, identifying discrepancies, validating financial results, and ensuring clients receive accurate, insightful reporting.

About the Client

You will be working with an Australian financial services and technology-driven organisation that delivers outsourced finance operations to businesses across the construction, trades, professional services, and broader services sectors.

The organisation combines accounting expertise with technology-enabled financial processes to provide comprehensive financial management services, including accounts payable, reconciliations, month-end reporting, and financial oversight.

Operating on a proprietary platform built using Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365, the business places a strong emphasis on automation, accuracy, and operational efficiency.

You will collaborate with finance professionals in Australia and a technology development team in Sri Lanka, contributing to an environment where financial expertise and software innovation work closely together.

Ideal Profile

Essential Qualifications & Experience

  • Professionally qualified Chartered Accountant (CA Sri Lanka, CA ANZ, or equivalent).

  • Strong working knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards.

  • Hands-on experience using Xero for accounting and financial reporting.

  • Proven experience reviewing financial records and reports across multiple client accounts or portfolios.

  • Strong understanding of month-end close processes, including reconciliations, journals, accruals, and balance sheet reviews.

  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound financial judgement, and identify discrepancies or irregularities in financial information.

  • Excellent written English communication skills, particularly in preparing clear, professional commentary for clients.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Previous experience in an accounting practice, outsourced finance function, or similar professional services environment.

  • Familiarity with accounting platforms such as MYOB, Dext, ApprovalMax, or equivalent solutions.

  • Experience collaborating with software development teams on financial process automation.

  • Exposure to Australian taxation and regulatory compliance requirements.

Responsibilities

Financial Review & Month-End Close

  • Review and validate month-end financial close activities across a portfolio of Australian client accounts.

  • Examine reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and balance sheets to ensure accuracy and completeness.

  • Identify inconsistencies, financial discrepancies, and potential reporting issues, ensuring appropriate corrective actions are taken.

  • Provide an independent second-level review of client financial records to maintain strong financial controls and reporting quality.

Management Reporting & Financial Commentary

  • Review management reports prepared for clients, ensuring financial information is accurate, relevant, and clearly presented.

  • Prepare insightful written commentary explaining financial performance, key movements, and areas requiring attention.

  • Ensure management reporting delivers meaningful financial insights to support informed business decisions.

Payment Review & Financial Controls

  • Review payment runs to verify accuracy and completeness before they are submitted to clients for authorisation.

  • Maintain appropriate financial oversight and contribute to consistent quality assurance across client portfolios.

  • Support the integrity and reliability of financial review processes.

Finance Systems & Process Automation

  • Collaborate with the Sri Lanka-based software development team to enhance automated accounting and financial workflows.

  • Provide financial expertise to help define process requirements, expected outcomes, and appropriate validation controls.

  • Identify potential weaknesses or inaccuracies in automated processes and recommend improvements.

  • Support the development of scalable, accurate, and efficient financial management solutions.

Leadership & Financial Oversight

  • Work closely with the CFO to maintain reporting accuracy and financial control standards across client accounts.

  • Provide financial oversight and continuity during the CFO's absence.

  • Collaborate with finance and technology colleagues to strengthen operational processes and financial reporting standards.

🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
