raw.description:
Builders FirstSource is seeking an experienced SAP Functional Analyst - Fiori & SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) to support our enterprise-wide SAP S/4HANA transformation and analytics strategy. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring that SAP Fiori applications, dashboards, and analytical solutions effectively support business processes and decision-making. The analyst will be responsible for gathering and prioritizing business requirements, managing a functional backlog, configuring and optimizing SAP Fiori solutions, supporting SAP Analytics Cloud reporting, and partnering with our dedicated ABAP development team to deliver high-quality solutions. This position plays a critical role in driving user adoption, ensuring solution quality, and enabling data-driven decisions across the organization.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Partnership & Requirements Gathering

Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to understand operational processes, reporting needs, and analytical requirements. Translate business requirements into functional specifications and actionable development stories. Evaluate standard SAP Fiori applications and recommend solutions that align with business objectives. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reporting, and user experience across SAP S/4HANA processes.

SAP Fiori Functional Ownership

Configure and maintain SAP Fiori Launchpad roles, catalogs, groups, spaces, pages, and navigation structures. Support implementation and optimization of standard and custom SAP Fiori applications. Collaborate with security and technical teams to ensure proper authorization and user access. Validate application functionality and ensure seamless integration with SAP S/4HANA business processes.

SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) & Reporting

Gather requirements for operational, financial, and executive reporting solutions. Partner with business teams to design and optimize SAC dashboards, reports, and analytics. Evaluate existing reporting solutions and recommend enhancements that improve usability and business value. Support the development of new reporting capabilities aligned with organizational priorities.

Project Delivery & Backlog Management

Own and manage a prioritized backlog of SAP Fiori and SAC enhancement requests. Work closely with the ABAP development team to define scope, clarify requirements, and support timely delivery. Create and maintain functional specifications, process documentation, and acceptance criteria. Coordinate testing efforts and manage solution readiness throughout the project lifecycle. Track project status, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.

Testing, Training & Change Management

Develop and execute unit testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Validate report outputs, business calculations, and application functionality. Troubleshoot issues and coordinate resolution with technical teams. Develop training materials, process documentation, and user guides.

Stakeholder & Leadership Communication

Provide regular updates to business stakeholders, project teams, and leadership. Communicate project progress, priorities, risks, and delivery timelines. Build strong relationships across business and technology teams. Advocate for business priorities while maintaining alignment with enterprise strategy.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience. 3+ years of SAP functional analyst experience supporting SAP business processes. Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Fiori. Demonstrated experience and understanding of Order to Cash, Supply Chain, and/or Record to Report Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications. Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes within SAP environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) dashboards, reporting, and analytics. Experience supporting large-scale SAP S/4HANA implementations or rollouts. Experience supporting enterprise reporting and analytics initiatives. Experience leading or participating in user acceptance testing (UAT). Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of SAP Gateway, OData services, and Fiori architecture. Familiarity with SAP security concepts, roles, and authorizations. Basic understanding of ABAP debugging and technical development processes. Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments. Experience supporting manufacturing, construction, distribution, or building products industries.

COMPETENCIES

Drive continuous improvement of the Fiori user experience and adoption across the enterprise. Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders. Drive adoption and optimization of SAP Fiori and SAC solutions. Maintain a clear, prioritized backlog aligned with business value. Deliver high-quality solutions through strong collaboration with ABAP developers. Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet business expectations. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership. Contribute to the successful rollout and long-term optimization of SAP S/4HANA across Builders FirstSource.

WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL ACTIVITY

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Subject to both typical office environment and outside locations with temperature and weather variations. Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 pounds. Occasional travel may be required.

InRule Technology®, Inc. is a PE-backed SaaS company with hundreds of customers in more than 40 countries. We are trusted by some of the world’s largest banks, insurance companies, healthcare organizations, and governments for mission-critical applications. By making automation accessible, InRule increases productivity, drives revenue, and delivers exceptional business outcomes.

About the role

As a Technical Writer, you will co-own documentation for InRule's products and maintain our public docs site. This is a collaborative role working alongside the documentation team. This is a highly self-directed role: you'll identify what documentation needs to be created or improved, plan the work, execute it, and measure its impact. You'll write new technical documentation and release notes, translate complex ideas from engineers and product managers into content that's clear for different audiences, and continuously look for ways to make our documentation more accessible across the total product experience to both internal and external users. You'll sit within the Product team, collaborating closely with product managers and engineers. At InRule, we view docs as a solution. On this team, you will not be confined to the role of writer, but instead use your product knowledge and technical writing skills to improve the success of our customers, support user journeys, enable internal teams, and strengthen company messaging. You'll need to be a strong communicator who's comfortable asking questions, locating information, and taking initiative.

What you'll do

  • Documentation & Writing
    • Write and maintain technical documentation across InRule's products.
    • Write release notes that clearly communicate new features, changes, and fixes to customers.
    • Translate complex technical concepts from engineers and product managers into documentation that's accessible to business users, developers, and internal teams.
    • Maintain and improve the structure, organization, and usability of the docs site.
  • Project Ownership & Planning
    • Identify documentation gaps and improvement opportunities across the product suite, and independently plan and prioritize the work.
    • Own projects end to end: scoping, execution, and follow-through.
    • Measure the impact of documentation projects.
  • Collaboration & Communication
    • Partner with product managers and engineers to gather accurate, up-to-date information for documentation.
    • Communicate progress and updates on documentation initiatives across teams.
    • Work cross-functionally within the Product organization to align documentation with product releases and priorities.
  • Accessibility & Continuous Improvement
    • Evaluate and improve the accessibility of documentation for both internal and external audiences.
    • Stay current on documentation best practices and tooling to continuously improve how InRule delivers information to users.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in technical writing, preferably within a SaaS or B2B software environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, English, Technical Writing, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience writing for multiple audiences, including technical and non-technical users.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible content.
  • Experience with tools such as Confluence, Jira, GitHub, Docusaurus, and writing Docs as Code is a plus.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently to identify, plan, and complete projects.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • The opportunity to build and shape a premium support function with measurable customer impact.
  • A collaborative culture with close partnership across Support, Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.
  • Professional growth within a scaling SaaS organization.

raw.description:
Description

About Us

Gambit is the AI-native resilience platform that ensures digital continuity never expires. It unifies governance across cloud, backups, security tools, and IaC, mapping applications, identifying gaps, and validating recovery paths in real time. Gambit turns resilience assumptions into business certainty before an incident ever occurs.

﻿The Opportunity

As a Staff Technical Account Manager, you own our most strategic and technically complex accounts: a deliberately small book, carried deep. You run each relationship from kickoff through renewal and are the person a customer's security and infrastructure leadership calls first.

You also set the standard for the function. You build the playbooks, templates, and analyses the rest of the team runs on, act as the technical backstop other TAMs escalate to, and are expected to see what the function is missing and go build it. You do not carry a quota; you carry retention, adoption, posture improvement, and the trust of the accounts you own.

About the Role

  • Onboarding. Define success criteria in writing, drive the implementation plan, and validate business application mapping, criticality tiering, and RTO and RPO targets with the customer.
  • Posture advisory. Turn Gambit findings into remediation plans tied to business impact, engineering effort, cloud cost, and risk retired; advise on backup policy and clean recovery paths; and facilitate recovery readiness and tabletop exercises.
  • Compliance evidence. Build control-level evidence packages across DORA, NIS2, SOX, SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, and NIST 800-53 Rev 5.
  • Executive reporting. Own the quarterly business review, and produce posture assessments, peer benchmarks, and cost-of-remediation analyses for a CISO audience, verified against real data.
  • Escalations and growth. Own escalations end to end, including during the customer's own incidents; maintain a risk register and renewal readiness assessment; and support commercial conversations as the technical trusted advisor.
  • Build the function. Create the playbooks, templates, and reusable analyses the team operates on, mentor other TAMs, and represent customers to Product and R&D with ranked, evidence-backed demand.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in technical account management, customer success engineering, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or post-sale technical delivery, with at least 4 years owning enterprise or strategic accounts directly.
  • Expert-level depth in at least one major cloud and working fluency in a second, with a track record of designing or validating recovery for business-critical applications across hybrid, multi-cloud enterprise estates, including leading real recovery tests, not just reviewing them.
  • Direct experience taking a regulated enterprise customer through an audit or regulatory assessment, producing control-level evidence that held up in front of auditors or regulators under at least one of DORA, NIS2, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST, and the ability to read and critique infrastructure as code to find the source of drift.
  • Self-sufficient with data: you query APIs, work in JSON and GraphQL, build analyses in notebooks, and use agentic AI tooling or MCP-based integrations to produce customer-facing analysis without engineering support.
  • A measurable record of retention and expansion on strategic, high-revenue accounts, including turning around at least one at-risk enterprise account, and the ability to walk through it with numbers.
  • Trusted in front of a CISO, a board-level audience, and an auditor without preparation from leadership, with executive deliverables you personally built that drove a customer decision.
  • Built playbooks, templates, or programs adopted across a team or function, served as the escalation backstop for other account managers, and represented the customer function in cross-functional forums with Product, Engineering, and Sales leadership.
  • Supported a customer through a live ransomware event, major outage, or real recovery.
  • A bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, and openness to up to 25% travel for customer and industry events.

﻿NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience at a cyber resilience, backup and recovery, data protection, CSPM, or observability vendor, or with platforms such as Veeam, Rubrik, Cohesity, or Commvault
  • Prior hands-on experience as a cloud, infrastructure, SRE, or security engineer

﻿Benefits - Why Gambit?﻿

At Gambit, we believe great work starts with great people — and we’re building a team of smart, driven, genuinely great co-workers who enjoy doing big things together.

Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • OTE ranging from $260,000 - $290,000 (80/20 split)
  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • A $350 work-from-home stipend to create a setup that helps you do your best work
  • Work alongside smart, supportive, and collaborative co-workers who are excited to build something meaningful together

﻿Pay Transparency Disclosure

﻿ֿJob level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified. For roles that are available to be filled remotely, the pay range is localized according to employee work location.

﻿EEO

Gambit Security is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

raw.description:
About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making 'net new' ad placements. How we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off -- it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

About the Role:

Wunderkind is looking for a top-performing Programmatic Sales Director to work a specified list of agency, trading desk, brand and DSP accounts across Washington and the greater DC area. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of revenue growth and has a book of healthy, strong relationships across the Washington region.

Day In The Life:

As a Programmatic Sales Director you will drive demand for Wunderkind display & video ad inventory from agencies & advertisers across DC agency and brand accounts, ultimately meeting/exceeding revenue goals by:

  • Developing a holistic understanding of the Wunderkind product offering and how its differentiation can best serve your clients' needs
  • Building relationships with multiple layers of decision makers in the programmatic buying cycle (in-house marketers, agencies, and trading desks)
  • Developing and executing effective sales strategies to qualified targets
  • Working hand-in-hand with account managers to ensure accounts are being serviced properly and revenue is maximized
  • Acting as liaison between the market and our internal team to ensure our product continues to evolve with buyers' needs

Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree plus experience related to digital media or digital advertising
  • At least 8+ years experience required in online programmatic advertising sales, of which at least 5 were in a sales role.
  • Ownership and growth of the largest/most strategic territory within the assigned pod to deliver on team and individual revenue targets
  • Extensive experience in the programmatic industry with a track record of successfully impacting business growth
  • A robust network of contacts across the buy side with whom you’ve built rapport and trust
  • Experience working with DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, and other optimization platforms is a plus
  • Experience selling CPA, CPC, and CPM marketing campaigns
  • Motivated, tenacious, and resourceful
  • Persuasive and compelling
  • Comfortable in a high-growth environment where roles and responsibilities may shift
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for the marketing technology space and a healthy dose of humility

The base salary range for this role is $135,000.00 to $155,000.00 and the role attracts on-track variable earnings of up-to-equal value. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. raw.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer, Network & Zero Trust, to own the network pillar of Sezzle's zero-trust program: every connection explicitly allowed, authenticated by service identity, and attributable after the fact — across our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, and the paths between them.

You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.

This is an engineering role: you will write the policies, the tooling, and the rollout automation yourself, and you will carry changes through other teams' services without breaking delivery. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and detection and response, and with the platform and IAM teams on service identity — your network controls are what their work relies on, and your telemetry is what their detections run on.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows — flow analysis, policy generation from observed traffic, drift review — that let the team segment a large estate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own east-west segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters: design the segmentation model, derive network policies from observed traffic, and keep every workload reachable only through explicitly allowed, identity-bound paths — a default that holds as the estate grows, not a one-time project.
  • Deliver identity-aware transport — design and roll out mutually authenticated, encrypted service-to-service connections (mTLS), so that authorization decisions rest on verified service identity.
  • Keep a live map of the network: VPC peerings, tunnels, cross-account links, and every public entry point — built from cloud APIs and reconciled continuously, so every path into production is known and justified.
  • Own segmentation of production and the cardholder-data environment: implement and enforce the CDE and high-trust-tier boundaries, review every peering and public exposure against them, and run segmentation testing with the security team.
  • Partner with IT on private access: evaluate and help deliver per-application access (ZTNA) for engineers and operators reaching production systems.
  • Own network telemetry: flow logs east-west and north-south, with enough identity on both ends that "who talked to what, when" is answerable in minutes — and feed it to our SIEM for the detection team.
  • Own cluster admission control and hold the line on drift: workload admission policy (pod security, image provenance, network policy), security groups and firewall rules declared in git, applied only through the IaC pipeline, with admission control at the gate and drift detected and reverted automatically.
  • Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.
  • Participate in threat modeling and design reviews for anything that changes how traffic flows, and in the on-call rotation for the controls you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments.
  • Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages.
  • Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs.
  • Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).
  • Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.
  • Ability to write real code (Go, Python, or Bash) for tooling and automation, not only configuration.
  • Ability to investigate directly with packet captures, flow logs, and system-level data.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS network requirements — segmentation, scoping of the cardholder-data environment, segmentation testing.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Cilium / eBPF in production, including Hubble or equivalent flow observability.
  • mTLS at fleet scale, including certificate lifecycle — service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium service mesh) and workload identity standards such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — flow analysis, policy generation, drift review.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying ZTNA / identity-aware proxy products. ● Policy-as-code and admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, conftest).
  • Experience with network detection — IDS/IPS, anomalous-flow and lateral-movement detection — and with containment during incidents.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and with FFIEC-style examination expectations for network security. ● Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or other regulated environments.

About You:

  • You'd rather close a path than document it - an allow-list that exists in production beats a diagram of how the network should look.
  • You change other teams' systems without breaking them - you roll out in observe mode first, measure, and earn the right to enforce.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

raw.description:
Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Manager, Member Journey & Knowledge Management owns two primary outcomes: the health of the Member Services knowledge base, and a complete, accurate picture of the end-to-end member journey — its processes, policies, and pain points. The ability to own and influence both, are paramount to the role.

This role documents and maps how the member journey actually works today, keeps the knowledge base that describes it accurate and trustworthy, and uses both to identify where Product can meaningfully improve the member experience, from the perspective of efficiency/effectiveness as well as automation where possible.

This is a deep, focused ownership role. Success means the knowledge base is clean and trusted for both human and AI agents, the journey is fully mapped and understood end-to-end, and Product team has a clear, evidence-based view into where to invest next.

What you'll do:

Knowledge Base Health & Governance

  • Own the OneImaging knowledge base as the single source of truth.
  • Own knowledge content lifecycle: identify and remediate outdated, duplicate, conflicting, or orphaned content.
  • Establish and maintain the governance framework for content ownership, review cycles, approvals, and retirement.
  • Define and maintain knowledge architecture: taxonomy, tagging, and organization to keep content findable.
  • Monitor knowledge health: accuracy, freshness, duplication, content gaps, and search effectiveness.
  • Ensure content is structured to support both human agents and AI-enabled support tools.
  • Build reporting and dashboards that give leadership ongoing visibility into knowledge base health.

End-to-End Member Journey Processes & Policies

  • Own documentation of the full member journey encompassing every process and policy a member touches from first contact through resolution.
  • Partner with Business Owners and Product SMEs to validate that documented processes reflect actual practice.
  • Ensure that when a process or policy changes, it's reflected consistently across all documentation and the knowledge base.
  • Build and maintain visual, end-to-end process maps of the member journey across systems, teams, and handoffs.

Product Enablement for Member Journey Improvement

  • Serve as the Member Services voice into Product: translate journey pain points, knowledge gaps, and operational friction into clear product opportunities.
  • Analyze journey data, member feedback, and knowledge base usage to identify where product changes would most improve the member experience.
  • Maintain visibility into upcoming product changes that affect the member journey and assess their downstream impact on processes and knowledge.
  • Partner with Product to validate that shipped changes improve the member experience as intended.

About you:

Required Experience

  • 5+ years in knowledge management, business process management, or journey/process mapping — preferably within Digital Health, Health Insurance, Radiology, or Tech-Enabled Healthcare Services.
  • Proven experience owning a knowledge base end-to-end, including governance practices (ownership, review cycles, accuracy standards, retirement).
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining process maps (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro) for complex, cross-functional workflows.
  • Experience partnering with Product teams to translate operational or process insights into clear requirements or opportunities.
  • Comfortable working without direct reports — able to drive outcomes by influencing SMEs, Product, and Operations partners.
  • Experience with knowledge base and CRM/support platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Notion).
  • Highly self-directed, with the ability to build governance and mapping standards from first principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in radiology, medical imaging, or diagnostic services — clinical coordination, patient access, or operations.
  • Familiarity with radiology workflows: prior authorization, imaging order management, payer-specific protocols, provider network coordination.
  • Experience structuring knowledge content for AI-enabled support tools.

Who You Are

A systems thinker who instinctively maps how work actually flows before trying to fix it.

  • Treats a messy knowledge base or an undocumented process as something to solve, not just flag.
  • Keeps the member at the center of every process, policy, and product conversation — always asking “what does this feel like for the person on the other end?”
  • Believes affordable, transparent healthcare access matters, and wants their work to be part of how OneImaging delivers on that promise.
  • Data-driven but human-centered: uses journey and knowledge data to find problems, and judgment to prioritize fixes.

raw.description:
Standort: München, remote innerhalb Deutschlands

Art: Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, jeweils mit Perspektive auf eine langfristige Partnerschaft

Warum diese Rolle

Wir bauen Software, mit der echte Unternehmen arbeiten. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen und schnellen Teams, in dem du als Product Owner die Produktvision und die Umsetzung von Anfang bis Ende verantwortest, statt ein Backlog abzuarbeiten, das jemand anderes vorgekaut hat. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Engineers zusammen, steuerst KI-gestützte Entwicklungsabläufe und bringst Features innerhalb weniger Wochen vom Konzept in die Produktion.

Diese Rolle ist für jemanden, der in Systemen, Nutzen für die Anwender und operativer Klarheit denkt, nicht nur in Jira-Status.

Ehrlich gesagt: KI im Jahr 2026

Wir entwickeln schnell mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen (Cursor, Claude, Copilot usw.). Als unser Product Owner musst du selbst keinen Produktivcode schreiben, aber du musst verstehen, wie KI-native Entwicklung Lieferzyklen, Aufwandsschätzung und Scoping verändert.

Die KI-Werkzeuge können Code schreiben, aber sie wissen nicht, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen, wie Abläufe über Unternehmen hinweg zusammenhängen oder welche Kompromisse für unsere Architektur sinnvoll sind. Genau für dieses Urteilsvermögen suchen wir dich. Die Messlatte ist nicht „Kannst du eine User-Story-Vorlage ausfüllen?“. Die Messlatte ist: Kannst du eine unübersichtliche betriebliche Realität in glasklare Produktanforderungen übersetzen, konsequent priorisieren und Entwickler wie KI-Assistenten effizient dahin lenken, das Richtige zu bauen?

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • Du verantwortest Roadmap und Backlog: Du definierst, schneidest und priorisierst Features vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.

  • Du übersetzt übergeordnete Geschäftsziele in präzise, umsetzbare Anforderungen und Datenmodelle, mit denen unser Engineering-Team und unsere KI-Werkzeuge arbeiten können.

  • Du sorgst für reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern, Entwicklern und Anwendern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du steuerst Sprints, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und hältst das Tempo hoch, ohne unnötige Bürokratie.

  • Du prüfst ausgelieferte Features gegen die Akzeptanzkriterien und achtest auf hohe Qualität, gute UX und echten geschäftlichen Nutzen.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Produktprozesse mit unserem Wachstum weiter, hältst Feedbackschleifen kurz und die Developer Experience reibungslos.

Unser Stack und unsere Arbeitsweise

  • Methodik: agil, Lean Product Development, kurze Iterationen, wenig Bürokratie

  • Technologie: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres, Cloudflare

  • KI-native Werkzeuge: Cursor, Copilot und Claude Code als fester Bestandteil unserer Entwicklung

  • Kommunikation: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du sprichst fließend „Tech“ und verstehst, wie moderne Software unter der Haube gebaut wird.

Anforderungen

Was wir suchen

Must-haves

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Owner, Technical Project Manager oder Product Lead in der Softwareentwicklung.

  • Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gutes Englisch (mindestens C1), unverzichtbar für die Abstimmung mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und dem Team.

  • Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis: Du kennst moderne Web-Stacks, Datenbanken (Postgres) und APIs und weißt, wie Softwarearchitektur funktioniert.

  • Vertrautheit mit KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ihren Auswirkungen auf Produktplanung und Tempo.

  • Leidenschaft für Klarheit: Du schreibst knappe Spezifikationen, Edge Cases und Akzeptanzkriterien, die keine Fragen offenlassen.

  • Selbstständige, pragmatische und proaktive Arbeitsweise.

Nice-to-haves

  • Hintergrund in Softwareentwicklung oder Informatik.

  • Erfahrung in Start-ups oder in schnellen, erfahrenen Produktteams.

  • Praxis mit modernen Kollaborations- und Projektwerkzeugen (Linear, Notion, GitHub Projects).

Uns sind dein Urteilsvermögen beim Strukturieren und dein Umsetzungstempo deutlich wichtiger als die Länge deines Lebenslaufs.

Benefits

So arbeiten wir

  • Kleines, erfahrenes Team: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern und Engineers. Deine Entscheidungen zählen vom ersten Tag an.

  • Flexibel: remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Standort München. Wichtig ist uns verlässliche Erreichbarkeit zu den üblichen Geschäftszeiten.

  • Wenig Bürokratie: klare Verantwortlichkeiten, schnelles Feedback, keine endlosen Abstimmungsrunden.

Was wir bieten

  • Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, je nachdem, was besser zu dir passt.

  • Eine Vergütung, die deiner Erfahrung entspricht, als Gehalt oder als Tages- bzw. Stundensatz.

  • Die langfristige Perspektive, unseren Produktkern zu verantworten.

  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und unmittelbare Wirkung auf ein echtes Produkt, das von aktiven Unternehmen genutzt wird.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns eine kurze Nachricht über dich, deinen Hintergrund und deine Verfügbarkeit, dazu deine Gehaltsvorstellung oder deinen Tagessatz sowie dein LinkedIn-Profil oder Portfolio. Erzähl uns von einem komplexen Produkt oder Projekt, das du erfolgreich vom Chaos zur Klarheit geführt hast.

Kein Aufsatz nötig. Wir sehen uns jede Bewerbung an und antworten allen.

raw.description:
Position Overview

Giffen Consulting Ltd. (Giffen) is looking for Structural Design Contractors to assist our engineering team. We are looking for an contractors with a mining and heavy industrial background to join us.

About Us

Giffen is a Canadian company, with offices in Vancouver, BC, and Toronto, ON. that provides fit-for-purpose engineering and project delivery solutions, specializing in the mining, utility, and heavy industrial sectors.

At Giffen, we take pride in our ability to deliver flexible strategies that are tailored to the specific needs of our clients. We value relationships above all else – within our team and with our clients. We hold our team to the highest level of accountability to ensure we provide tailored solutions to successfully execute our clients’ projects.

We believe that open communication is the key to fostering reliable and lasting relationships within our company and with those we conduct business with.

Key Responsibilities

The contractor will be able to:

  • Providing structural design and drafting support
  • Develop 3D models using Advanced Steel and integration into RISA
  • Prepare drawings for reinforced concrete and structural steel using Advanced Steel
  • Analyze designs of structures, building envelope systems, and structural components while adhering to established guidelines and client specifications
  • Interpreting complex drawings that incorporate interfacing civil, structural and architectural design requirements with piping, mechanical, and electrical disciplines
  • Prepare material take-offs
  • Reviewing and performing quality checks of project documents prior to issue for scope and presentation against project standards and specifications
  • Provide input on tendering, contract administration, schedule, and budget to ensure projects are completed to specification
  • Write and review technical reports, specifications, and construction specifications
  • Collaborate with vendors, clients, and other key stakeholders

Qualifications + Experience

  • Diploma in Structural Engineering Technology or equivalent from an accredited university or college
  • 7+ years of progressive experience as a Structural Designer on Mining / Heavy Industrial Projects
  • Familiar with greenfield and brownfield projects
  • Experience in Structural, Concrete and Platework design plant layout with crushing, grinding, materials handling, flotation, CIL/CIP, slurry, pumping, slurry agitation, particle size classification and separation would be highly regarded  
  • Familiar with structural BIM and analysis software like Revit, Advanced Steel and RISA is considered an asset
  • Knowledge of industry standards, regulations, and codes of practice
Salary: Contract Rates

Role Mission:

The Custom Recruitment Assistant is responsible for creating and implementing a Custom Recruitment plan on allocated Qualitative and Quantitative projects and executing the related Custom Recruitment tasks, ensuring their successful delivery within the provided budget and timelines. The Custom Recruitment Assistant liaises with other stakeholders of projects to increase number of internal completes delivered and ensure panel growth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Including, but not limited to the following:

  • Have an excellent understanding of Custom recruitment strategies for quantitative and qualitative studies; collaborate with Project Stakeholders to best utilize available options for maximum results.
  • Demonstrate complete confidence on using all recruitment platforms and tools, such as the MR System, Dotmailer, Call Center, LinkedIn, ClickSend, DNUK, Rekru, Confirmit/Decipher…
  • Attend IKO and project related meetings with PMs for projects assigned and share notes on agreed plan of action
  • Build a custom recruitment plan for assigned projects always keeping in mind the needs of the client
  • Liaise, when necessary, with other teams to maximise internal sample resources via phone recruitment, segmented emails, and other custom recruitment solutions
  • Ensure Custom Recruitment tasks allocated are completed in line with timelines stipulated by the client
  • Proactively seek alternative Custom Recruitment strategies and provide ideas to improve response rate and reduce costs in each project
  • Have a good understanding of the M3 sampling, emailing and reporting tools to ensure they are used to the best of their capabilities in supporting project delivery
  • Deploy Custom Recruitment campaign resulting in new registrations
  • Coordinate Custom recruitment efforts for live projects to maintain the knowledge and experience on market research recruitment for quantitative and qualitative studies
  • Follow processes to ensure same panellists are not over-targeted by custom recruitment actions
  • Report any quality issues on project to line manager

Education and Training Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred
  • Relevant coursework in market research or healthcare preferred, but not required

Minimum Experience:

  • 0 – 1 year of market research experience

Knowledge, Skill, Ability:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated knowledge of English grammar rules
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel) and quick learner of new technologies/software
  • Must have basic math skills, with the ability to calculate incidence rate, response rates profit, etc.
  • Interest / natural curiosity or previous experience /exposure within the healthcare space
  • Exhibit strong critical thinking skills and take initiative to improve skills and troubleshoot proactively with PM using all available resources to support project success
  • Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives
  • Self-motivated and able to (re)prioritize tasks throughout the workday
  • Exceptional time management, organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to multitask

Must be willing to work in UK shift hours

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About M3- A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

  • Unterstützung bei der Dokumentation studienrelevanter Informationen

  • Enge Abstimmung mit dem Studien- und Projektteam

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung als Study Nurse, Studienkoordinatorin oder Clinical Research Nurse

  • Erfahrung in klinischen Studien, idealerweise randomisiert-kontrollierten Studien (RCTs)

  • GCP-Zertifikat

  • Kommunikationsstärke und freundliches Auftreten im Umgang mit Studienteilnehmerinnen

  • Strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

  • Hohe digitale Affinität und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Remote-Studien oder Telemedizin

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Benefits

Vollständige Remote-Arbeit.

Wir freuen uns über eine kurze Nachricht mit Ihrem CV sowie Informationen zu Ihrer Verfügbarkeit und Ihrem Stundensatz.

Optional können Sie uns anstelle eines Anschreibens gerne ein kurzes Video (1–2 Minuten) mit einer kurzen Selbstvorstellung senden – das hilft uns, einen ersten Eindruck zu gewinnen.

raw.excerpt: About Stride Stride helps independent workers access health, dental, and vision benefits.
raw.description:
About Stride
Stride helps independent workers access health, dental, and vision benefits. Stride is now part of Integrity, expanding the resources and capabilities available to the workers we serve.
Position Details
● Seasonal W-2 employment beginning October 12, 2026
● All Enrollment Operations Specialists are expected to remain through the December 31, 2026 CCA enrollment deadline. After December 31, the team will be reduced in phases based on enrollment volume and business needs, with individual assignments anticipated to end on January 15 or February 5, 2027.

● $23.00 per hour

  • 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, 8:00am–4:00pm PST
    ● Non-exempt and overtime eligible; additional hours may be available or required during peak periods based on business needs
    The Role
    We are looking for detail-oriented professionals to join our Enrollment Operations team during Open Enrollment.
    This is a high-trust operational role responsible for accurately processing insurance enrollment activity and resolving issues that can directly affect a consumer's coverage. The work requires strong judgment, attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to follow established processes in a high-volume environment.
    Experience with ACA health insurance enrollment, Healthcare.gov, or state-based marketplaces such as Covered California is strongly preferred.
    Responsibilities
    ● Review and process consumer enrollment, termination, and cancellation requests
    ● Identify and resolve enrollment errors, discrepancies, and missing information
    ● Follow established processes for handling enrollment activity and sensitive consumer information
    ● Contact consumers when additional information or action is required
    ● Research issues and coordinate with internal teams when appropriate
    ● Escalate complex or high-risk issues with clear documentation
    ● Maintain accurate records of enrollment activity and communications in Zendesk or similar systems
    ● Identify recurring issues and communicate trends or process gaps to management
    ● Support the Enrollment Operations team during periods of high volume
    Qualifications
    When reviewing resumes, we'll look for experience that indicates:
    ● Experience managing detailed, process-driven work in which accuracy and timely execution were essential
    ● Experience identifying discrepancies, researching issues, and determining or coordinating the appropriate next step
    ● Experience following established processes and handling sensitive or confidential information
    ● Experience maintaining accurate records and documenting actions and communications in business systems
    ● Experience communicating directly with consumers or customers and coordinating with internal teams to resolve issues
    ● Experience working independently in a high-volume environment with changing priorities
    ● Experience using technology and digital tools to manage workflows, records, and communications, including learning new systems as needed
    Preferred Experience
    We'll prioritize candidates with resumes that indicate:
    ● Experience in health insurance operations, broker services, member support, or enrollment processing
    ● Experience with ACA enrollment, including eligibility, plan selection, or coverage changes
    ● Experience using Healthcare.gov or state-based marketplaces such as Covered California
    ● Experience using Zendesk or a similar CRM or support platform
    ● Experience working in a high-volume Open Enrollment environment
    ● Experience working effectively in a fully remote environment
    ● Experience in a startup, small business, or similarly fast-paced environment where you were expected to take ownership and wear multiple hats
    What We'll Assess During the Interview
    During the interview process, we'll assess:
    ● Critical thinking and problem-solving - the ability to assess a situation, identify relevant information, and determine the appropriate next step
    ● Attention to detail - the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
    ● Judgment, discretion, and accountability when handling sensitive information and enrollment activity
    ● Process discipline and independence - the ability to work with limited guidance while following established processes precisely
    ● Written and verbal communication - the ability to document actions clearly and communicate effectively with consumers and internal teams
    ● Comfort in a high-volume environment with changing priorities
    ● Technical learning agility - the ability to learn and navigate new systems quickly
    ● Ownership and adaptability - the willingness to take responsibility for work and respond effectively to new or unfamiliar tasks
    What Success Looks Like
    You process enrollment work accurately, consistently, and on time. You take ownership of your work, recognize when something is wrong, document your actions clearly, and escalate issues appropriately.
    Accuracy is critical in this role. Small enrollment errors can have significant consequences for consumers, and we expect every team member to treat that responsibility seriously.

About Integrity

Integrity is one of the nation’s leading independent distributors of life, health and wealth insurance products. With a strong insurtech focus, we embrace a broad and innovative approach to serving agents and clients alike. Integrity is driven by a singular purpose: to help people protect their life, health and wealth so they can prepare for the good days ahead.

Integrity offers you the opportunity to start a career in a family-like environment that is rewarding and cutting edge. Why? Because we put our people first! At Integrity, you can start a new career path at company you’ll love, and we’ll love you back. We’re proud of the work we do and the culture we’ve built, where we celebrate your hard work and support you daily. Joining us means being part of a hyper-growth company with tons of professional opportunities for you to accelerate your career. Integrity offers our people a competitive compensation package, including benefits that make work more fun and give you and your family peace of mind.

Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Integrity is committed to meeting Americans wherever they are — in person, over the phone or online. Integrity’s employees support hundreds of thousands of independent agents who serve the needs of millions of clients nationwide. For more information, visit Integrity.com.

Integrity, LLC is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, Integrity, LLC will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

SUMMARY

Review clinical documentation and diagnostic results to extract data and apply appropriate ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes for billing, internal and external reporting, research, and regulatory compliance. Demonstrate knowledge of reimbursement methodologies and apply these to assigned charts to optimize reimbursement and/or resolve regulatory edits. Resolve error reports associated with billing process, identify and report error patterns, and, when necessary, assist in design and implementation of workflow changes to reduce billing errors

STATUS: Full-time

LOCATION: Riedman- Remote

SCHEDULE: Day shift

ATTRIBUTES

  • • Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), adheres to official coding guidelines, and keeps abreast of coding changes and interpretation of codes.
    • Complies with RRH & HIM department policies & procedures
    • Perform detailed review of Inpatient record documentation to identify & assign diagnosis & procedure codes using ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS.
    • Meets established departmental productivity guidelines with 95% accuracy on a consistent basis.
    • Utilizes Care Connect, UDS and Clintegrity systems proficiently to obtain ICD10 codes and DRG assignment.
    • Formulates compliant Physician Coding Queries when documentation is inadequate, ambiguous or unclear for coding purposes
    • Enters and/or updates data accurately including Present on Admission (POA) indicators, Point of Origin, Discharge Disposition and other identified data.
    • Manages problematic workflow edits and other technical issues to ensure timely resolution specific to coding A/R days
    • Corrects failed claim errors to billing edits, accounts misclassified and/or other errors identified through various auditing processes in a timely manner.
    • Attends RGHS, HIM Department and Coding Team meetings and training sessions as required.
    • Ensure timely reporting for external regulations
    • Completes other duties as assigned by HIM leadership.

This role supports both operational and project-based work, with responsibilities driven by business needs. As an IT Senior Systems Engineer, you will collaborate across global teams to support global infrastructure in modernizing legacy infrastructure, enhance automation, and ensure lifecycle and patching hygiene all while aligning with ITIL-based processes and standards.

About This Job

The Commercial Loan Officer – Income Property Lending (IPL) is responsible for originating, structuring, underwriting, and closing commercial real estate loans secured by income-producing properties. This role focuses on building and managing relationships with borrowers, brokers, and referral partners while identifying lending opportunities that align with the Bank’s credit standards and growth objectives. The Commercial Loan Officer serves as a trusted advisor throughout the lending process and works closely with Credit, Underwriting, Closing, Portfolio Management, and Servicing teams to deliver exceptional client service and high-quality loan production.

The IPL business focuses on financing stabilized and value-add commercial real estate assets including multifamily, office, retail, industrial, medical office, hospitality, mixed-use, and self-storage properties.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain relationships with commercial real estate investors, borrowers, mortgage brokers, and other referral sources
  • Source new lending opportunities for acquisition, refinance, cash-out, bridge, and value-add transactions
  • Analyze borrower financial statements, rent rolls, operating statements, and property cash flows to assess creditworthiness and lending opportunities.
  • Structure loan transactions that meet borrower objectives while adhering to credit policy and risk management guidelines
  • Evaluate key credit metrics including Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR), Loan-to-Value (LTV), debt yield, sponsorship strength, and global cash flow.
  • Present lending opportunities and recommendations to Credit and Executive Management
  • Negotiate loan terms, pricing, and conditions with borrowers and referral partners
  • Manage the transaction process from initial screening through funding, ensuring timely execution and an exceptional client experience
  • Coordinate with Underwriting, Appraisal, Legal, Closing, and Portfolio Management teams throughout the loan lifecycle
  • Monitor market trends, property values, and competitive lending activity within assigned territories
  • Maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities and achieve established production goals
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and credit standards
  • Support portfolio retention efforts, loan modifications, and relationship expansion opportunities as needed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Real Estate, Accounting, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in commercial real estate lending, income property lending, commercial banking, or CRE originations

  • Experience underwriting and structuring loans secured by multifamily, office, industrial, retail, hospitality, mixed-use, and other income-producing properties
  • Working knowledge of DSCR, LTV, debt yield, NOI analysis, borrower global cash flow, and commercial loan documentation
  • Established network of commercial real estate borrowers, brokers, and industry professionals preferred

raw.description:
The Associate Director, Government Pricing (GP) position is a key member of Regeneron’s government pricing team, which includes supporting the accurate calculation and timely submission of all required government price reporting.

Included in this role is responsibility for assuring compliance with all pricing and reporting requirements legislated by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), the Department of Veterans Affairs and any state legislation required price reporting. This includes a full understanding of all current legislation and staying abreast of pending legislation. Government Pricing Calculations include: Medicaid, Medicare Part B, Public Health Service (PHS)/340B, and Federal Supply Schedule (FSS), which includes: TriCare and the Industrial Funding Fee (IFF). The Associate Director will work collaboratively with Contracting Strategy supporting the overall strategy, contracting and/or payment activities.

A typical day may include the following:

  • Ability to calculate, validate and report accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual government pricing.

  • Submit and monitor State Price Transparency regulations.

  • Complete understanding of calculation reasonable assumptions and methodologies and ability to research and communicate cause of variances of results when comparing current period to prior periods.

  • Perform all necessary processes needed to ensure compliant submissions including, but not limited to G/L reconciliations, Class of Trade (COT) review, and PHS/340b eligibility review.

  • Associate Director will review calculations with Senior Management and obtain approval signoff (and executes any other required Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)) before communicating prices to the appropriate government agencies (Center for Medicare and Medicare (CMS), Veterans Affairs (VA)/Department of Defense (DOD), etc.) or internally.

  • Responsible for maintaining and updating SOP’s and reasonable assumptions, on a quarterly basis, as related to Government Programs/Pricing.

  • Monitor policies, procedures and processes supporting Government Pricing submissions and related areas to ensure ongoing compliance with external and internal requirements and guidance.

  • Understand and estimate impact of pricing and policy changes regarding government pricing.

  • Perform pricing research and analysis on special projects as assigned.

  • Ability to review and understand commercial contract language as pertaining to Best Price (BP), Average Sales Price (ASP) and FSS Tracking Customers.

  • Investigate Government pricing trends and cross channel impact. Also provide Government price inputs to the Gross to Net (GTN) team.

  • Monitor for Tracking customer violations, Bona Fide Service Fee treatments & Customer COT assignment.

  • Participate on cross-functional teams as a subject matter expert representing the Government Pricing and Contract Operations as required to evaluate and implement business strategies and initiatives.

  • Serve as a liaison with Commercial Leadership, Pricing, Trade, Brand and Accounting/Finance teams regarding a variety of issues impacting government pricing.

  • Familiar with Fair Market Value methodology while determining bona fide service fees paid to Wholesaler, Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) and Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs).

The role may be for you if:

  • Understanding of current government pricing rules, regulations, and calculations

  • Must be able to identify potential problems, conduct analysis and use judgment to determine if problem exists as well as offer up potential solutions.

  • Highly analytical, able to analyze, interpret, and convey data and its commercial impact

  • Ability to decipher calculations to determine key causes of variances.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to communicate effectively to all levels of the organization.

  • Process oriented

  • Proven ability to successfully manage competing priorities, meet challenging deadlines, and work independently and across organizations

  • Demonstrated track record of strong attention to detail; accountability and ownership of results; flexibility and adaptability in a rapidly changing environment

To be consider for this role, we expect you to have a bachelors degree and 7+ years prior experience in Government Pricing OR a related field such as finance, accounting, Medicare/Medicaid (with strong analytical skills). We also will need you to be open to traveling at times.

We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.

Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit.

Summary:

Ovation Healthcare seeks an Outpatient Coder. This role, under general direction, is responsible for coding and abstracting of diagnoses from medical records for optimal and timely reimbursement and quality reporting.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assigns ICD-10-CM codes for medical record accounts, including but not limited to diagnoses.

  • Abstracts key data elements required for billing, regulatory agencies, and other databases.

  • Reviews records for clinical pertinence and documentation to support accurate facility-based charges for services performed during the encounter.

  • Communicates with providers for clarification of documentation to ensure appropriate assignment of diagnoses, procedures, and/or facility evaluation/management (E/M) levels.

  • Reviews and resolves claim edits related to outpatient encounters to ensure compliant billing, including but not limited to medical necessity and NCCI/CCI edits.

  • Assists with resolution of simple visit coding errors related to other outpatient visits as needed.

  • Demonstrates courtesy and professionalism through interaction, appearance, attitude, and written and oral communications with visitors, co-workers, physicians, and other hospital personnel as to represent the Medical Records Services as a high-quality service area of the Hospitals.

  • Maintains patient confidentiality as required by Hospitals/departmental policy and industry/legal standards.

  • Acknowledges and supports Hospitals defined goals and approach to patient care; attends regular training sessions to improve patient and customer communications.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Skill in prioritizing and performing a variety of duties within a system that has frequently changing assignments, priorities, and deadlines.

  • Ability to impart knowledge of procedures and techniques.

  • Thorough working knowledge of ICD-10-CM and CPT coding systems, and federal/state regulations regarding reimbursement.

  • Thorough working knowledge of the hospital information system, electronic medical record systems, and encoder.

  • Working knowledge of standards for chart completion.

  • Maintains Continuing Education credits in accordance with the American Health Information Management Association's and/or American Academy of Professional Coders’ requirements based upon certification(s).

  • Performs qualitative analysis of records in accordance with regulatory standards and coding requirements using CPT/HCPCS and ICD-10-CM guidelines.

  • Working knowledge of medical-legal rules and regulations that govern the confidentiality and release of medical information with the ability to interpret and implement the standards.

  • Must maintain total confidentiality of all patient records.

  • Must be comfortable working with AR teams to resolve issues.

  • Must be able to pass a coding assessment.

  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Teams.

  • Ability to multi-task and have excellent communication skills.

  • Must meet and maintain a 95% quality accuracy rate and productivity standards.

  • Must have experience working in a remote environment.

Work Experience, Education, and Certifications:

  • RHIT, RHIA, CEDC, COC, CPC, CCS-P or CCS Credentials

  • Three or more years of Coding experience

100% Remote

raw.description:
This is technical, specialized work in the research, development, implementation and administration of all the security components of the Information Technology Department over a complex network.

This job description reflects the current assignment of essential functions and is not meant to be all-inclusive. Duties and responsibilities may be assigned or reassigned to this job at any time and may be modified to reasonably accommodate an individual with a disability or for other reasons.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Continuously monitor security alerts and notifications from various tools and platforms to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Assist in investigating and responding to security incidents, including performing initial triage and documenting findings. Manage annual incident response testing.
  • Conduct basic threat analysis and research to understand emerging threats and vulnerabilities relevant to our environment.
  • Support the configuration and maintenance of security tools and systems to ensure they are properly tuned and up to date.
  • Help identify, assess, and prioritize vulnerabilities in systems and applications, and assist with remediation efforts.
  • Maintain and update security documentation, including policies, procedures, and incident reports.
  • Assist in developing and delivering cybersecurity awareness training to staff members.
  • Support compliance efforts related to cybersecurity frameworks and standards (e.g., PCI, NIST).
  • Maintaining a disaster recovery strategy and procedures backup plan.
  • Software and hardware lifecycle and patch management.
  • Monitor and manage the organization’s firewall infrastructure to safeguard network traffic.
  • Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS): Oversee IDS/IPS systems to detect and respond to malicious activities and policy violations.
  • Antivirus and Endpoint Protection: Maintain and update antivirus solutions and endpoint protection tools to prevent and respond to malware threats.
  • Security Information and Event Management (SIEM): Utilize SIEM tools to collect, analyze, and correlate security event data from various sources.
  • Virtual Private Network (VPN): Support the management and security of VPNs used for remote access.
  • Email Security Solutions: Monitor and manage email security systems to prevent phishing and other email-based threats.
  • To enhance the cybersecurity awareness and skills of the IT Department and all employees across the organization.
  • Backup and Recovery Systems: Assist in ensuring the integrity and security of data backup and recovery systems.
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Audit IAM systems to control and monitor user access and authentication.
  • Monitor Centralized log management system.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (Education, Training & Experience):

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science or related field and 2 years experience in a progressively responsible position within information technology.

LICENSE AND CERTIFICATIONS: (If license(s) or certification(s) is required to practice a trade or profession, you must attach a copy. Cybersecurity certifications such as GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC) or PCI Professional Qualification (PCIP) or similar.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Technical Skills: Familiarity with security tools and technologies (e.g., firewalls, intrusion detection systems, antivirus software “Palo Alto, Symantec, Kaseya 365, Microsoft Defender). Knowledge of networking protocols and concepts.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and act decisively in high-pressure situations.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate security issues and recommendations.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining data integrity and confidentiality.
  • Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and contribute to a positive and productive work culture.
  • Ability to maintain a good and positive working relationship with all co-workers and other contacts.
  • Required to comply with all JAMCO’s policies and procedures.
  • Ability to follow all rules of telephone courtesy in all telephone communications.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT: Work in a non-climate controlled environment working closely with others and alone with light traveling required. Work involves rotating shifts and working extended workdays outside the regular working hours and on-call status; Work requires simple grasping, standing, sitting, climbing stairs and ladders, walking, carrying up to 15 pounds, and light lifting under 24 pounds. Ability to see, write, count, read, identify shade of colors, and hearing is needed to perform essential functions.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

  • 401k + matching contribution

  • HSA + matching contribution

  • Paid Time Off

  • Life Insurance

  • Employer-paid short and long-term disability insurance

  • ...and more!

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.

We will do this together — with customers, partners and colleagues. We will fight for others, not against: We will stand up for and champion everyone’s access to opportunities. The status quo is not good enough … we believe every individual and every community deserves access to financial opportunities. We are determined to support both individuals and communities in reaching a better financial future. We know that reaching this future depends on our actions today.

Like our Purpose Statement, Voya believes in being bold and committed to action. We are committed to a work environment where the differences that we are born with — and those we acquire throughout our lives — are understood, valued and intentionally pursued. We believe that our employees own our culture and have a responsibility to foster an environment where we all feel comfortable bringing our whole selves to work. Purposefully bringing our differences together to positively influence our culture, serve our clients and enrich our communities is essential to our vision.

Are you ready to join a company with a strong purpose and a winning culture? Start your Voyage –Apply Now

Get to Know the Opportunity:

The Business Solutions Consultant serves as a strategic partner to Claims Operations, Product,Technology, Compliance, Training, and Operational Readiness teams to ensure business processes, communications, system enhancements, and regulatory requirements are effectively implemented across Leave and Disability claim operations.

This role has responsibility of drafting, maintaining, and governing operational process documentation, oversight of standard claim communications, involvement in system testing and release readiness activities, compliance notifications, and business process improvements. Acting as a bridge between business, Product, Legal and Compliance and technical teams. The Business Solutions Consultant may lead cross-functional initiatives, drive release readiness efforts, and provides strategic recommendations that improve efficiency, quality, and organizational preparedness.

The Contributions You’ll Make:

  • Create and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), job aids, process maps, workflows, and other operational guides and training materials. Ensuring documentation reflects current regulatory requirements, business practices, and system functionality.
  • Create and distribute huddle notifications, release summaries, or training guides that communicate regulatory, procedural, and operational changes.

  • Some participation in claim system testing, release, and implementation activities impacting Leave and Disability operations.
  • Review and provide input on business system requirements and assess and communicate operational impacts of system changes to Claim Operations, Training and Quality partners
  • Evaluate operational processes and identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, and automation.

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and project coordination skills.
