raw.description:
DIRECTOR, AI & DATA SCIENCE

Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science | Full-Time, Salaried | Player-Coach | Reports to the Co-CEOs

Company

Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location

Remote, anywhere in the USA

Team

Six to seven individual contributors across data engineering, analytics, data science, ML, and MLOps

Education

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field required. Master’s or PhD preferred.

Compensation

$175,000 to $225,000 base

Schedule

Collaboration across time zones. Regular working-hour overlap with our Singapore Dev team and partners is required.

Travel

Required for team weeks and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are a lean company of about 60 people, so every leader here builds.

You will lead our combined Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science team of six to seven individual contributors and report directly to the Co-CEOs. This team is Seeking's central AI capability: the models, infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and continuous-learning systems the whole company runs on. Expect about half your time leading and half writing code, building models, and debugging production systems yourself.

Your first mandate is to achieve 100% AI automation of routine user-uploaded content moderation, with accuracy proven superior to our human moderators and at a lower total cost. Next is AI customer support that resolves member tickets end to end. You own both outcomes completely, from policy and data through production results.

Over time, the team will extend AI to fraud prevention, matching, member onboarding and success, marketing, monetization, retention, and product development, in partnership with the leaders who own those areas. Every initiative carries a measurable target, a named owner, and a mechanism for continuous learning. The immediate problems come first, and this role exists to solve them.

This role is for someone who manages a hands-on team today and still ships code. If your recent roles had managers reporting to you, or you plan to delegate the technical work and manage through status meetings, this is the wrong role. If you walk into ambiguity and know exactly what to do, keep reading.

What You Will Do

1. Set the foundation in your first 30 days

  • Bring Product, Support, and Operations to one written moderation policy with a single owner. When teams disagree, you run the process that settles it.
  • Inventory every production AI system with a named owner, backup, dependencies, and monitoring gaps.
  • Trace every upload from receipt through model decision, enforcement, and any human review. Quantify every path that still needs a human, with its root cause, cost, and fix.

2. Prove AI beats our human moderators, then reach 100%

  • Test the AI and our moderators on the same held-out cases, with reference decisions set by independent, policy-qualified reviewers. Report missed violations and wrongful rejections separately, with sample sizes and confidence intervals.
  • Close every gap: missing coverage, uncertain model outputs, system failures, unenforced decisions, and duplicate human review. Expand automation in controlled stages, each with a tested rollback.

3. Build systems that keep getting better

  • Every production system improves through verified feedback, independent evaluation, and controlled releases. Run a monthly learning cycle in which a new model ships only when it beats production on the same independent test.
  • Version every dataset, policy, prompt, and model so every gain can be proven and every change can be rolled back.

4. Run production AI like a business

  • Give every production AI system monitoring, alerts to a named owner, documented recovery, and regular failure drills.
  • Report results in business terms: quality, cost per outcome, revenue, efficiency, and member experience, with savings reconciled with Finance. Keep one executive dashboard and run a weekly review with the Co-CEOs.

5. Automate support, then partner across Seeking

  • Own AI customer support end to end: agents that resolve tickets and execute approved actions, such as subscription changes and eligible refunds, held to the same evaluation, rollout, and monitoring standards as moderation.
  • Once moderation and support are delivered, partner with the leaders of Marketing, Product, and other departments on fraud, matching, onboarding, monetization, and retention. Bring the Co-CEOs a ranked list of opportunities by impact on cost, revenue, efficiency, and member experience.
  • In those partnerships, department leaders own their business outcomes. Your team owns the models, infrastructure, evaluation, and learning systems, and is accountable for their performance.

6. Lead and grow the team

  • Review each person's work line by line, pair on hard problems, and give direct feedback every week. Build a growth plan for everyone, recruit strong talent, and address performance gaps early.
  • Set quarterly OKRs for the function and each direct report, with leading and lagging KPIs for every Key Result. Run the work in Jira, Confluence, and Monday.

What You Must Bring

  • A Bachelor’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field. A Master’s or Ph.D. in CS, AI, ML, Statistics, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred.
  • Seven or more years delivering production data or ML systems, including three or more years managing teams of individual contributors. You manage a hands-on team today, or did so recently.
  • Strong Python and SQL, with production code you personally wrote in the past year. You will code in the interview.
  • Production ML and architecture judgment. You have designed, built, and operated ML and LLM systems end to end, from data pipelines through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, on a major cloud platform.
  • You have done this before. You led an AI automation program in moderation, trust and safety, support, or a comparable decision system, from a measured human baseline to automated decisions at scale.
  • Evaluation rigor and continuous learning. You measure false negatives and false positives separately, report uncertainty, keep test data clean, and have built systems that improve through feedback and controlled updates.
  • Measurable business impact. You can name the cost, revenue, efficiency, or member outcomes your work moved, with the numbers.
  • Cross-functional influence. You have found AI opportunities in other departments, won over their leaders, and taken the solution from concept into production.
  • A record of mentoring engineers and scientists into stronger, more senior contributors.
  • Daily use of Claude, Claude Code, Cowork, or comparable AI tools. If someone has to explain to you why AI matters, this role is not for you.

Nice to Have

  • Production work in multi-modal or computer vision moderation, fraud detection, recommender systems, or marketing and monetization models such as propensity, pricing, and lifetime value.
  • Our stack: AWS (S3, Redshift, SageMaker, Bedrock), Looker, and Kubernetes.

Compensation

  • $175,000 to $225,000 base, commensurate with experience. Full-time, salaried, remote within the US.
  • 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision. 50% 401(k) match up to 6%. Flexible Spending Account and flexible paid time off.

How We Hire

  • Recruiter screen: code you wrote in the last 90 days, the team you manage, and logistics.
  • Practical round: live SQL and Python, plus a production architecture discussion.
  • Systems round: work through a simplified moderation workflow. Find where items fall back to humans, define an honest automation rate, and design the evaluation against human moderators.
  • Co-CEO round: treat it as a pitch. Study the product, ask sharp questions, and bring your 90-day plan for moderation and customer support.
  • References, including a former direct report.

raw.title: Senior AI Engineer (LLMs & Agentic AI)
raw.excerpt: About YouYou are a Senior AI Engineer passionate about building production-grade LLM applications and agentic AI systems.
raw.description:
About You

You are a Senior AI Engineer passionate about building production-grade LLM applications and agentic AI systems. You thrive in collaborative environments where you design, implement, and optimize AI capabilities that power conversational experiences and intelligent workflows.

You enjoy solving complex AI challenges, integrating cutting-edge LLM technologies, and continuously improving production systems through experimentation, evaluation, and engineering best practices. You're comfortable making production design decisions autonomously within a small, lightly-managed team, and defending those decisions directly to engineering leadership.

Note: This role operates under a contractor model and requires availability to work in the U.S. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT).

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices for production backend services (APIs, async I/O, typing/schema validation, error handling, and testing).
  • Strong SQL skills working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred).
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade LLM and agentic AI applications.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying MCP servers in production (server-side, consumed by other users or systems), including tool and resource definitions, context management, and multi-step orchestration.
  • Understanding of MCP transports (stdio vs. Streamable HTTP) and authentication/authorization patterns for remote servers (OAuth/OIDC, scoped and resource-level access).
  • Experience integrating hosted LLM APIs such as Anthropic and OpenAI into production environments.
  • Experience with prompt engineering, prompt versioning, fallback strategies, and cost/latency optimization, with direct ownership of these concerns in production.
  • Experience designing intent classification and routing solutions for natural language applications, resolving user intent into the correct API and data-source calls.
  • Experience building conversational AI solutions or multi-API orchestration workflows.
  • Experience developing LLM evaluation methodologies and demonstrated ability to reverse-engineer and work within a partially documented, brownfield Python codebase.
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to explain your own technical work in first-person depth under sustained technical questioning, clearly distinguishing what you personally built, what you contributed to, and what you only observed.
  • Strong spoken English (B2+) to discuss technical scenarios live with US-based stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience deploying, fine-tuning, and evaluating open-source models using Hugging Face.
  • Experience with GPU acceleration and inference optimization.
  • Experience implementing MLOps practices, including CI/CD, observability, and reproducible pipelines.
  • Experience with vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Applied NLP experience.
  • Experience building client-facing AI products.
  • AWS experience (Batch, ECS, Lambda, SQS).

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain MCP servers, tool and resource definitions, and context management capabilities.
  • Design and implement intent evaluation, classification, and routing workflows, including orchestrating resolution into the correct API and data-source calls, with aggregation across multiple sources.
  • Integrate Anthropic and OpenAI models into production environments.
  • Manage prompt versioning, fallback strategies, and LLM performance optimization.
  • Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to validate model quality and production performance.
  • Write SQL against model inputs and outputs to support evaluation and monitoring.
  • Support the backend behavior of the chat / MCP interface.
  • Work within an existing, partially documented codebase, tracing behavior and making safe, incremental changes.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and AI specialists to deliver production-ready AI solutions.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to AI platform design.
  • Continuously improve AI systems through experimentation, optimization, and engineering best practices.
  • Experience building production AI applications with Python and LLM technologies.
  • Must have personally authored/built an MCP server deployed in production and used by other users or systems (not simply integrated, consumed, or built as a local proof of concept).
  • Hands-on brownfield experience, adding significant features to a production Python codebase.
  • Experience designing and deploying conversational AI or agentic AI solutions.
  • Strong experience with prompt engineering, LLM integrations, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Strong spoken English (B2+)

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Managing modern technology has become increasingly complex. As organizations scale across clouds, endpoints, and hybrid environments, IT operations and cybersecurity often remain fragmented, creating gaps in visibility, slowing response times, and increasing risk.

Logically closes that gap.

We unify IT operations and cybersecurity into a single, accountable operating model that reduces risk, accelerates response, and strengthens resilience across the systems businesses depend on. With shared visibility, integrated workflows, and clear ownership, organizations gain greater control, fewer blind spots, and more confidence in their technology.

For more than 20 years, Logically has partnered with mid-market and enterprise organizations to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and improve resilience, acting as a true extension of their teams with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.

Logically. Cyber-First. Future-Ready.

Why Work for Us

  • A culture built on doing the right thing
  • Work at the forefront of cybersecurity and emerging technologies
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits

Job Summary:

The Financial Planning & Analysis Director acts as a strategic partner to the business, helping drive growth and optimal financial outcomes. The Director of FP&A will play a vital role in assisting with the company’s short-term and long-term financial forecasting, capital planning, pricing and process optimization, and key strategic initiatives. This role will lead the department’s strategic direction and be charged with ensuring business operations align with Logically’s vision, mission, and values.

This role requires a highly motivated professional, who will make a significant impact and is comfortable working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. This is a highly visible role and will be a key asset in the future growth of the company. 

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

Financial Planning & Reporting

  • Strategically lead the FP&A process, including partnering across the business to support Logically’s vision
  • Own the enterprise-wide annual budgeting process, rolling forecasts, and long-range strategic and capital planning
  • Maintain and develop detailed financial models that track and analyze key metrics and their impact on the company's overall performance
  • Analyze current and past trends in KPIs including all areas of revenue, expenses, and other business drivers
  • Assume responsibility for delivery of monthly consolidated financial reporting package to private-equity investors
  • Conduct scenario analysis and sensitivity modeling to support agile decision-making in a dynamic environment

Business Partnering & Strategy

  • Partner with senior management in the coordination and completion of the planning process including annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-term strategic financial planning
  • Serve as a strategic finance partner to commercial, operational and functional leaders – translating financial data into actionable insight on cost, margin, investment and growth
  • Assist in leading & creating partnerships with Accounting, HR, IT, and other cross-functional business units to report monthly expenses and headcount planning and reporting across the organization
  • Support the development of executive communications for high-level presentations for senior management, including the company executive team, board of directors, private equity investors, lenders, and other stakeholders
  • Monitor business performance against internal KPI targets and external benchmarks, and partner with leaders on corrective actions

M&A & Integration

  • Support financial due diligence, including the creation/review of financial models for any potential M&A transactions
  • Lead integration efforts for financial reporting and financial planning for acquired entities

Sales Compensation

  • Partner with Sales and HR leadership on the design, modeling and implementation of sales compensation plans that align seller incentives with company growth targets
  • Analyze the financial impact of compensation structures and provide data-driven recommendations to senior leadership
  • Assist with and manage frequent ad hoc projects to support management and business decisions

Technology, Automation & AI

  • Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools and approaches to enhance analysis quality, accelerate reporting cycles, and improve decision support
  • Lead and support finance process automation initiatives – identifying opportunities to eliminate manual, repetitive workflows and replace them with scalable, technology-driven solutions
  • Serve as a responsible steward of AI-generated outputs, ensuring accuracy, integrity and alignment with business strategy before presenting to leadership or investors
  • Drive continuous improvement of financial systems, planning tools, and reporting automation to scale with company growth

Qualifications:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline required (MBA or CPA preferred)

Experience

  • 9-11 years of experience in Financial Planning and Analysis, Finance, or Accounting
  • Proven experience working in a private equity-backed environment, including familiarity with PE reporting cadences, investor packages, and value-creation frameworks
  • Experience in a services industry business; experience with a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) is a strong plus but not required
  • Experience working with recurring revenue business models (e.g. SaaS, managed services, subscription-based businesses), including fluency with metrics such as ARR, Churn, NRR and LTV
  • Proven ability in financial modeling (NPV, ROI, Accretion/Dilution, etc.)
  • Experience supporting M&A due diligence, financial integration of entities and synergy analysis
  • Experience with sales compensation plan design and implementation preferred
  • Proven track record of building and leading financial planning processes in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

Technical Skills

  • Superior skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Proficiency in SQL; ability to independently write and execute SQL queries against financial and operational databases
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI and automation tools in a finance context – including AI-assisted forecasting, variance analysis, narrative generation, or workflow automation; ability to validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and strategic alignment
  • Experience with Salesforce (CRM) and Microsoft Business Central (ERP) a plus
  • Experience with ConnectWise (PSA system) is a strong plus, but not required
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI) preferred

Core Competencies

  • Strategic insight into the market and ability to ideate and translate customer requirements, organizational challenges, and market trends into actionable strategy
  • Success designing and implementing a strategic and operating approach, infrastructure, cadence, plan, and process – with key metrics - created to increase organizational clarity, accountability, pace, and delivery
  • Thorough understanding of methods of systems analysis and the principles, design, and procedural methods used in big data analysis
  • Ability to present financial information to a non-financial audience
  • Excellent communicator – written, verbal, and in presentations- with the ability to actively listen, navigate difficult conversations, and translate complex financial concepts for non-financial audiences
  • Builds trust-based relationships across teams and internal/external stakeholders; fosters a collaborative, team-first culture and willingly shares knowledge to develop others
  • Strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable solutions and persistently work through competing options to reach the best outcome
  • Flexible and composed under pressure, managing multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
  • Unquestionable ethics, discretion, and sound judgment in handling sensitive and confidential financial information

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle PL/SQL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise database solutions supporting high-volume transactional systems, financial applications, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical business operations. This role focuses on building scalable PL/SQL applications, optimizing complex SQL queries, developing database objects, and ensuring high availability and performance across large Oracle environments.
You will work closely with application developers, database administrators, data architects, QA engineers, and business analysts to build efficient database solutions that support enterprise applications, cloud modernization initiatives, and data integration platforms. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Oracle Database technologies, advanced PL/SQL programming, query optimization, and performance tuning while maintaining high standards for data integrity, security, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain complex PL/SQL packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and database objects supporting enterprise applications.
  • Develop highly optimized SQL queries for large transactional and analytical databases.
  • Design scalable database schemas, indexing strategies, partitioning models, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Build ETL processes and database integration components for enterprise data movement and synchronization.
  • Develop batch processing jobs and automated database workflows supporting business-critical operations.
  • Analyze execution plans, identify SQL bottlenecks, and optimize database performance for high-volume systems.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to design efficient database access patterns and API integrations.
  • Implement database security, auditing, role-based access controls, and data encryption standards.
  • Develop database migration scripts, deployment packages, and release automation processes.
  • Perform database code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and resolve complex data integrity problems.
  • Support database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Azure, or AWS.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, architecture reviews, and production support rotations.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional experience developing enterprise Oracle database solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Oracle PL/SQL including packages, stored procedures, functions, cursors, triggers, collections, exceptions, and dynamic SQL.
  • Advanced SQL development skills with complex joins, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), analytical functions, window functions, and query optimization.
  • Extensive experience with Oracle Database 12c, 19c, or newer enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle indexing, partitioning, materialized views, execution plans, and optimizer statistics.
  • Experience optimizing high-volume OLTP and OLAP database workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle SQL Developer, TOAD, SQL*Plus, or similar Oracle development tools.
  • Experience developing ETL processes and integrating Oracle databases with external systems.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Data Pump, RMAN, and database migration methodologies.
  • Experience working with Oracle Advanced Queuing (AQ), Scheduler, and database jobs.
  • Experience integrating Oracle databases with Java, .NET, Python, or REST-based enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of database normalization, data modeling, and relational database design principles.
  • Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or CI/CD pipelines for database deployment automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Database Services or Autonomous Database.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Exadata, RAC (Real Application Clusters), and Data Guard environments.
  • Experience with Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or Oracle SOA Suite.
  • Knowledge of Oracle APEX application development.
  • Experience developing financial, healthcare, insurance, retail, or government enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud migration strategies from on-premises Oracle databases to OCI, Azure, or AWS.
  • Experience with shell scripting, Python, or PowerShell for database automation.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts.
  • Oracle Database Administration or Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certifications are highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated environments requiring auditability, compliance, and data governance.

Project Environment
You will be joining an enterprise data engineering and application modernization team responsible for supporting mission-critical Oracle database platforms serving multiple business units. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise financial transaction processing systems
  • Healthcare claims and patient management platforms
  • Insurance policy administration and billing systems
  • Large-scale ERP and supply chain applications
  • Cloud migration of Oracle databases to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Regulatory reporting and compliance data platforms
  • Enterprise data integration and batch processing solutions
  • High-availability Oracle environments supporting millions of daily transactions
  • Performance optimization and modernization of legacy PL/SQL applications
This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to database architecture, PL/SQL development, SQL optimization, cloud migration, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise Oracle platforms.

About RethinkFirst

RethinkFirst was founded in 2007 with a mission to provide scalable, evidence-based autism treatment training tools and caregiver supports to an underserved population. In 2010, Rethink launched its first solution, a suite of special needs and behavior management offerings, to support K-12 education. Over time, we expanded our offerings to support the entire behavioral health community by adding solutions in the employer (RethinkCare), provider (RethinkBH), and payor (RethinkFutures) industries, and to drive whole child wellness and success in education (RethinkEd).

Today, we are proud to have almost 500 team members supporting more than 2,000 customers worldwide as we work together to strengthen our communities and help every individual reach their potential.

RethinkFirst is transforming the behavioral health landscape by inspiring and empowering individuals with behavioral health challenges and those who support them. We continue to invest in data science, analytics, and technology that improve outcomes and enable value-based care.

Job Summary

RethinkFirst is seeking a Social Media Specialist to execute organic social media programs across RethinkBH, RethinkCare, RethinkEd, and RethinkFirst. This role will translate company and business-unit priorities into clear, engaging content; manage day-to-day publishing and community activity; and use performance insights to strengthen future work. The ideal candidate is a strong writer and organized operator who understands how content should change by platform, audience, and business objective.

Job Duties

  • Manage the enterprise social media calendar across priority channels, coordinating content for multiple business lines, audiences, and campaign timelines.

  • Draft platform-appropriate copy, creative briefs, executive posts, and short-form content that make complex behavioral health, education, and workplace topics accessible and engaging.

  • Publish and schedule approved content, maintain accurate links and tagging, and complete final quality checks before posts go live.

  • Partner with Creative and Brand, Content, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and business-unit leaders to gather inputs and convert broader campaign plans into effective organic social content.

  • Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and relevant conversations; respond or route issues promptly while following brand, privacy, and escalation guidelines.

  • Track channel and content performance, identify practical insights, and recommend adjustments to topics, formats, cadence, and distribution.

  • Stay current on platform changes, audience behavior, and emerging formats, testing new approaches when they support the brand and business goals.

  • Maintain organized content, approvals, and reporting records so stakeholders have clear visibility into upcoming and completed work.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2 to 4 years of experience supporting organic social media for a company, agency, or mission-driven organization.

  • Strong writing and editing skills, with work samples that demonstrate an ability to adapt voice and format for different audiences and channels.

  • Hands-on experience with major social platforms and a social scheduling or listening tool such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or a comparable platform.

  • Working knowledge of social analytics and the ability to turn results into clear recommendations.

  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through across multiple concurrent deadlines.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with designers, content partners, subject-matter experts, and senior stakeholders in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, education technology, HR technology, or B2B software.

  • Experience developing short-form video concepts, repurposing long-form content, or supporting executive social media.

  • Familiarity with accessibility, privacy, and brand-review considerations for social content.

Location: Remote opportunities are available to candidates who reside in the following states: AL, AZ, CT, FL, GA, HI, IA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NV, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI, WY

Our commitment to an inclusive workplace

RethinkFirst is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We celebrate the unique differences of our employees because that is what drives curiosity, innovation, and the success of our business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. Note: This is a remote U.S. based role, requiring work within the East Coast Time Zone. Preference will be given to the candidates from the East coast locations.


Meet the Team

Isovalent, now part of Cisco, is the company founded by the creators of Cilium and eBPF. Cisco Isovalent builds open-source software and enterprise solutions that address networking, security, and observability needs across modern cloud-native infrastructure.

As part of Cisco Hypershield, our team develops enterprise security solutions that help organizations secure modern cloud and distributed environments. Our technical writers are embedded within engineering and work closely with engineers, product managers, solution architects, field teams, and other technical stakeholders from early product development through release.

In this role, you will primarily support Cisco Hypershield and related security and networking capabilities. You will join a small, collaborative documentation team where you can develop deep product expertise, influence documentation strategy, and help make complex technology more accessible to customers and technical users.


Your Impact

You will create, update, and maintain technical documentation for Cisco Hypershield, Isovalent technologies, and related enterprise solutions. Your work will span developer and user documentation and support security, networking, and cloud-native use cases.

  • Lead end-to-end technical documentation efforts for Hypershield networking and security solutions, including concepts, tutorials, operational documentation, technical references, training materials, and guides.
  • Partner with engineering, solution architects, product management, and other subject-matter experts to translate complex technical concepts into clear and accurate documentation.
  • Work directly with products and technical environments to understand workflows, validate documentation, and identify gaps or areas for improvement.
  • Develop content for audiences with different levels of technical experience, including security engineers, network operations teams, platform teams, field engineers, and customers.
  • Help evolve documentation practices, information architecture, and developer content standards across the team.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with peers across a geographically distributed team, with regular overlap during East Coast Time (EST/ EDT) business hours.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 15+ years of related experience; or a Master’s degree with 12+ years of related experience; or a PhD with 8+ years of related experience.
  • 8+ years of experience as a Technical Writer supporting enterprise software products.
  • Experience providing technical leadership for documentation initiatives, including driving documentation projects end-to-end, coordinating with technical stakeholders, and managing documentation deliverables across the product lifecycle.
  • Experience with networking, security, or cloud-native technologies, such as Kubernetes, Docker, Mesos, or similar container and cloud-native technologies.
  • Experience creating user guides, technical documentation, and other content for enterprise users.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including working with deployed applications, clusters, configurations, troubleshooting, or lab environments.
  • Experience with documentation frameworks and tools such as Sphinx, Hugo, Read the Docs, Markdown, or reStructuredText.
  • Experience using GitHub, Git, or similar version-control workflows for documentation.
  • Experience collaborating with engineers and other subject-matter experts to translate technical knowledge into clear, accurate documentation.
  • Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical experience.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Analyst to join our Client Insights team and play a key role in how we use data to protect and empower our merchant partners. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, product, strategy, sales, and merchant success; the models, reporting, and insights created by this individual will directly impact sales and merchant retention.

Our team is helping build the next generation of AI-driven post-purchase customer solutions, and this role will be instrumental in driving the success of these solutions. This is a high-impact role for someone who's curious, detail-oriented, and excited about turning data into action.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Serve as the analytical bridge between Sales and prospective/existing merchants; translate data and analysis into business cases, pricing models, and compelling financial narratives
  • Partner with Merchant Success to build analyses that demonstrate ROI, justify expansion, and support renewal conversations
  • Interact directly with merchants and potential merchants to understand their reporting needs; build strong relationships and leverage your analytical background and consumer data expertise to deliver a best-in-class analytics and support experience for large consumer brands
  • Analyze product data and work with the product and engineering teams to drive product improvements and help build the product roadmap

What We're Looking For:

  • 4-7 years of experience in a business analytics, business intelligence, or Technical Account Manager role
  • Understanding of consumer brands, ecommerce, and important metrics and benchmarks in the industry; ideally you have used data and analysis to drive business decisions for ecommerce companies / consumer brands
  • An exceptional communicator with the ability to talk to merchants about complex analysis and how to use the analysis to drive value and decision making
  • Experience in one or more of the following brand verticals is a plus: Jewelry, Furniture / Home Improvement, Consumer Electronics, Auto Parts, Sporting Goods, or Eyewear
  • Experience working cross-functionally to drive business and product improvement
  • Experience with SQL — you're comfortable querying large datasets, writing clean, efficient code, and understanding optimal data modeling
  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Familiarity with Tableau
  • Understanding of how to use AI to drive process improvement and efficiency across the organization
  • Strong communication skills — you can explain data clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A self-starter mindset: you ask good questions, dig into problems independently, and know when to loop others in

Expected Pay Range: $124,000 - $145,000 per year salaried*

*The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

  • Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.
  • Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.
  • Generous, flexible paid time off policy.

The Opportunity

Euna Payments is expanding its reach across the public sector, and this Account Executive role sits at the center of that growth, connecting government agencies and utilities with payment solutions that modernize how communities transact. You will own a full sales cycle, from prospecting and partner development to closing Director-level and above stakeholders, across a SLED-focused book of business. If you want to build meaningful relationships in the Govtech space while driving real revenue impact, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own your full sales cycle, managing pipeline from cold outreach through close with Director-level and above decision makers
  • Drive net new revenue by prospecting through cold calling, email, social media, and industry networking to maintain a healthy, progressive funnel
  • Build and leverage partner relationships to uncover joint opportunities and convert partner-sourced leads into closed business
  • Coordinate and customize needs-based product demos in collaboration with Sales Engineers, leading independently where appropriate
  • Represent Euna at industry trade shows and travel to develop new opportunities (up to 20% travel)
  • Record and maintain all activity and pipeline data accurately in Salesforce

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in a sales or business development role with demonstrated success selling into government or SLED markets
  • Proven ability to generate new business through multi-channel prospecting and move opportunities through a structured sales cycle
  • Comfort influencing and closing Director-level and above stakeholders in complex, consultative sales environments
  • Experience working within a CRM, Salesforce or equivalent, to manage pipeline and forecast accurately
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the organizational discipline to manage multiple active opportunities simultaneously

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience identifying, cultivating, and selling through partner or channel relationships
  • Familiarity with SaaS business models and comfort translating technical concepts for non-technical buyers
  • Prior experience working directly with cities, counties, states, or utilities

Location

This position will be remote within the United States.

AI Mindset at Euna Solutions

We believe the future of work is human + AI. At Euna Solutions, we encourage our team members to leverage AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and decision-making. We're looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment, not replace, their expertise.

If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you'll thrive here.

Life at Euna Solutions

We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and public sector champions. We've built a workplace around a straightforward idea: people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and not running on empty.

Here's what that actually looks like:

🏢 How we work

We're hybrid — three days a week in our Oakville or Atlanta offices, with standard hours on those days. What the remaining days look like depends on your role and your manager. We talk about it early in the process so there are no surprises on either side. This role is remote.

🧘 Eunafier Days

Twice a year, you get an extra day tacked onto a long weekend. We think recharging is part of doing good work — not a reward for it. Use it however you need.

🙌 Community is part of who we are

Our Engagement Committee finds meaningful ways to give back through time, donations, and shared expertise. We're invested in the places where our people actually live and work.

🤝 Philanthropy Time

We give every employee up to eight hours a year to spend on causes that matter to them. We want you to show up for your community — and we make time for it.

🎉 Real connection at scale

You won't know all 600+ people — and that's okay. What matters is building real relationships with the people you work with every day. Our culture team creates consistent opportunities for that, so work doesn't feel isolating.

📈 Room to grow

Whether you're going deep on AI, building expertise in government tech, or stepping into a bigger role, we invest in your development — through budget, mentorship, and real opportunity to move when you're ready.

About Euna Solutions

Euna Solutions® is the leading provider of purpose-built, cloud-based software designed to streamline procurement, budgeting, payments, and grants management for public sector and government organizations. Euna's AI-powered features and intelligent automation help organizations make better-informed decisions, ensure compliance, empower collaboration, and reduce administrative burden. Euna's full-cycle financial suite supports more than 3,600 organizations across North America in building trust, enabling transparency, and driving positive community impact. Recognized on Government Technology's GovTech 100 list, Euna Solutions is committed to advancing public sector innovation. To learn more, visit . Euna's privacy policy is available here.

Please visit our website: and check out our LinkedIn Pages

We believe in embracing new perspectives and optimizing impact. If you have relatable experience and relevant transferable skills but feel you may be missing a few of the requirements, we encourage you to apply! We recognize that people have unique career journeys and if you're excited about this role and know you can bring something great to the team, then we want to hear from you. Please know Euna Solutions is committed to providing a comfortable and accessible interview process for every candidate. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process (big or small), please let us know.

  • Project manage front-end content, coordinate development activities, and support QA efforts to ensure successful delivery of site updates and optimizations.
  • Ensure flawless execution of promotions through proper setup, testing, validation, and deployment.
  • Maximize utilization of all merchandising and optimization tools within SFCC Business Manager (sorting rules, search functionality, A/B testing, analytics capabilities…).

  • Collaborate closely with Ecommerce, Digital Marketing, CRM, ADX and IT teams to ensure alignment between merchandising strategies, campaigns, promotions, and customer experience initiatives.

20% dedicated to digital projects and site enhancements.

  • Partner with Digital Product Management and IT teams to define business requirements, evaluate solutions, and support the delivery of site enhancements related to merchandising.
  • Lead transversal tickets and eMerchandising initiatives within each IT release cycle managing priorities, requirements, configurations, QA, team bandwidth and delivery to ensure successful implementation of enhancements, bug fixes, and optimization opportunities.

  • Conduct post-launch analysis to measure performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Product Management on experimentation and A/B testing initiatives to ensure proper implementation.

raw.description:
Generative AI Specialist - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Generative AI Specialist
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Golang Developer to design and build high-performance backend services, infrastructure tooling, and cloud-native applications using Go. In this role you will work on systems where latency, concurrency, and operational efficiency are first-class concerns, and you will contribute to a codebase shared by engineers across multiple teams. The ideal candidate will combine strong Go expertise with broad systems knowledge, including network programming, container ecosystems, and distributed system design. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement performant backend services and APIs in Go, with strong attention to concurrency, error handling, and resource management.
  • Build cloud-native applications using Go and Kubernetes-native libraries, applying idiomatic Go patterns, well-defined module boundaries, and operational hooks that make the resulting services easy to deploy and run.
  • Develop CLI tools, Kubernetes controllers, and custom operators for internal platforms, designing clear command surfaces, robust error handling, and reconciliation logic that operates safely in long-running environments.
  • Implement gRPC and REST APIs with appropriate observability and security.
  • Profile and optimize Go applications for memory, GC, and goroutine behavior, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Integrate with messaging systems (Kafka, NATS) and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis, etcd).
  • Build comprehensive automated tests, including unit, integration, and benchmark tests.
  • Implement structured logging, metrics emission, and distributed tracing throughout services so that operators and on-call engineers have the signals they need to diagnose issues and reason about system behavior.
  • Lead code reviews and uphold engineering standards in Go projects.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Contribute meaningfully to internal Go libraries, shared platform tooling, and reusable patterns that accelerate development across multiple engineering teams and codify hard-won best practices.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Continuously evaluate Go ecosystem evolution and contribute to internal patterns.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time in Go.
  • Strong understanding of Go concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels, contexts).
  • Hands-on experience building production gRPC and/or REST APIs in Go.
  • Experience with Kubernetes-native development (client-go, controller-runtime).
  • Solid experience with relational and key-value data stores.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and networking fundamentals.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and container-based deployment.
  • Excellent debugging and performance-engineering skills.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Open-source contributions to Go-based projects.
  • Experience writing Kubernetes operators or controllers.
  • Familiarity with eBPF, service mesh, or low-level systems programming.
  • Exposure to security-sensitive Go projects (cryptography, auth).
  • Experience with WASM, Tinygo, or embedded systems.

raw.description:
About Our Company:
At Infinx, we're a fast-growing company focused on delivering innovative technology solutions to meet our clients' needs. We partner with healthcare providers to leverage automation and intelligence, overcoming revenue cycle challenges and improving reimbursements for patient care. Our clients include physician groups, hospitals, pharmacies, and dental groups.
We're looking for experienced associates and partners with expertise in areas that align with our clients' needs. We value individuals who are passionate about helping others, solving challenges, and improving patient care while maximizing revenue. Diversity and inclusivity are central to our values, fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and heard.

A 2025 Great Place to Work®

In 2025, Infinx was certified as a Great Place to Work® in both the U.S. and India, underscoring our commitment to fostering a high-trust, high-performance workplace culture. This marks the fourth consecutive year that Infinx India has achieved certification and the first time the company has earned recognition in the U.S.

Location: Remote

Summary Description:
The Outpatient Surgery Coder is responsible for timely, accurate and comprehensive abstraction of outpatient surgeries in multiple specialties from the medical/record by utilizing knowledge of industry standard ICD-10 CM and ICD-10 coding. This individual must demonstrate a commitment to the organization's strategic plans, short and long-term goals and mission, vision and values by representing the company in a caring and professional manner, recognizing the coding role in the patient experience.

Job Responsibilities:
  • Utilizes technical coding expertise to review the medical record thoroughly, utilizing all available documentation to abstract physicians professional services and diagnosis codes
  • Follows Official Coding Guidelines and rules in order to assign appropriate ICD-10 CM and ICD-10 codes and modifiers with a minimum of 98% accuracy
  • Provides documentation feedback to client and or account manager
  • Maintains coding reference information
  • Reviews and communicates new or revised billing and coding guidelines and information with providers and their assigned specialty
  • Resolves pre-accounts receivable edits. Identifies and reports repetitive documentation problems as well as system issues
  • Makes appropriate changes to incorrectly billed services, adds missing unbilled services, provides missing data as appropriate, corrects CPT and ICD 10 codes and modifiers
  • May collaborate with Patient Accounting, and other operational areas to provide coding reimbursement assistance; helps identify and resolve incorrect claim issues and may assist with drafting letters in order to coordinate appeals
  • May work with Revenue Cycle staff and Account inquiry unit staff as requested,
  • Assists in obtaining documentation (notes, operative reports, etc.). Provides additional code and modifier information
  • Meets established minimum coding productivity and quality standards for each encounter type based on type of service coded.
  • May perform other duties as assigned
Skills and Education:
  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • Required AHIMA or AAPC Certification
    • CPC, COC, CCS, or CASCC preferred
  • Experience with Epic
  • 2+ years of experience in outpatient surgery coding in multiple specialties
  • Ability to work independently and within a team atmosphere
  • Advanced and proficient knowledge of ICD-10 CM and ICD-10
  • Self-motivated and passionate about our mission and values of quality work
  • Must have professional level skills in MS products such as Excel, Word, Power Point.
  • Must be able to type proficiently and with an effective pace
  • Proficient application of business/office standard processes and technical applications

Company Benefits and Perks:
Joining Infinx comes with an array of benefits, flexible work hours when possible, and a genuine sense of belonging to a dynamic and growing organization.

  • Access to a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan.
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Paid Holidays.
  • Additional benefits, including Pet Care Coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and discounted services.
If you are a dedicated and experienced Outpatient Surgery Coder ready to contribute to our mission and be part of our diverse and inclusive community, we invite you to apply and join our team at Infinx.
